title: HCM – AI Engineer – LLM/NLP (Hybrid Working)
company: Vexere.com - Vietnam's largest online bus ticketing platform
location: Área metropolitana de Ciudad Ho Chi Minh
duties:
AI Engineer – LLM/NLP (Hybrid Working)

Vexere: Revolutionizing Travel and Transportation in Vietnam

We are a Vietnamese technology company aiming to revolutionize the travel and transportation industry. As the largest online bus ticketing platform in Vietnam, we help millions of travelers make unforgettable journeys. Recently we expanded to airlines, trains, and vehicle rentals in order to provide our customers with the best options for their travel plans.

Vexere’s Culture

Vexere members believe our organization exists to solve pressing societal problems. Our company culture emphasizes community spirit, mutual support, and open communication. We encourage all members to express ourselves, contribute ideas on products and strategies, and strive to become future leaders.

Vexere’s Vision

Vexere aspires to be a constantly growing and innovative business. We foster a strong culture of learning and development, aiming to leverage our technological strengths to continue revolutionizing the transportation and tourism sectors across Southeast Asia.

We are rebuilding every customer and employee touch-point as an AI-native experience. That ranges from booking a flight/bus/train seat to automating sale processes or leave requests. Engineers here get clear goals, full context, and the freedom to ship quickly while keeping reliability and safety paramount.

Responsibilies

Major projects you will tackle

- Omni-channel customer chatbot that handles FAQs, after-sales, and ticket booking for bus, flight, train, and vehicle-rental verticals—across text and voice.
- Department-specific assistants for HR onboarding, finance invoice queries, operations incident triage, IT help-desk, and more—each powered by shared LLM components and n8n triggers.
- Company-wide automation hub built on n8n, including reusable nodes and guard-rails that let non-technical teams create flows safely.
- Multimodal expansion that blends text, speech, and images so customers can, for example, upload a ticket photo or speak a booking change request.
- You will fine-tune foundation models, fuse retrieval with LLM reasoning, and iterate in Vietnamese, English, and other languages.

What You Will Do

- Design, implement, and continually improve our multi-agent framework. Build and refine agent components such as short- and long-term memory stores, planning/reflection loops, agent-to-agent messaging, and specialised prompt templates that let multiple agents collaborate on complex tasks.
- Select and adapt OpenAI, Gemini models, Llama, Mixtral or better—using LoRA or full fine-tuning—so the models speak our brand voice in multiple languages.
- Build and optimise retrieval-augmented pipelines, keeping latency below two seconds and hallucinations under five percent.
- Craft prompts, refusal rules, and jailbreak tests; automate factuality, safety, and multimodal hallucination checks in CI.
- Package models with Docker and serve them through FastAPI or gRPC behind vLLM, Triton Inference Server, or Text-Generation-Inference; add monitoring with Grafana / Prometheus for latency, drift, and GPU cost (for later milestones).
- Pair daily with Conversation Designers, MLOps engineers, Automation engineers, and business stakeholders; publish model cards, data sheets, and rollback plans.

Requirements

Must-have qualifications

- 1+ years of experience shipping NLP or generative-AI systems to production.
- Strong Python and PyTorch skills plus heavy use of Hugging Face (Transformers, PEFT, Datasets).
- Practical knowledge of vector databases such as milvus, pgvector, Qdrant, or Pinecone and hybrid-search techniques.
- Demonstrated ability to raise containment or reduce hallucinations through data-driven experiments.
- Solid engineering habits: Git, code reviews, unit and integration tests, CI/CD pipelines.
- Clear spoken and written English; Vietnamese fluency is a bonus.

Nice-to-haves

- Hands-on experience with Rasa, Dialogflow CX, or ASR/TTS pipelines for voice bots.
- Deep GPU-performance tuning, including quantisation, KV-cache optimisation, or custom Triton kernels.
- Familiarity with multi-agent frameworks such as PydanticAI, CrewAI, LangGraph or others.
- A privacy-by-design mindset and working knowledge of GDPR or PDPA compliance.

Benefits

- Competitive salary + KPI-based quarterly bonuses.
- Hybrid Working
- Clear career progression with opportunities for advancement to key positions based on your capabilities.
- Special discounted bus tickets for employees and their families.
- Comprehensive periodic health check-up policies.
- Participation in social insurance, health insurance, and unemployment insurance according to Vietnamese labor law after the probationary period.
- 12 days of annual leave, with an additional day added every 3 years (convertible to salary).
- Vibrant and dynamic working environment with a friendly and supportive team that shares knowledge and assists each other.
- Training and development opportunities in negotiation, communication, work management, interpersonal skills, and software technology.
- Free parking and allowances: Marriage, Newborn baby and others are applied.
- A spacious pantry fully equipped with a coffee maker, microwave, milk, tea and more.
- A wide range of sports and social activities: badminton, pickleball, football, etc.
- Other perks to be discussed during the interview.

For More Information, Please Contact Us Via

- Send your Resume to email: [email], with title: Fullname – Applied Position
- Phone/ Zalo: [số điện thoại] (Mr. Nhân)

Office Location: Vexere Trading and Services Co., Ltd. – 2nd Floor – Building H3, 384 Hoang Dieu, Ward 6, District 4, HCMC

Working Hours: 8:30 am – 6:00 pm from Monday to Friday, and Saturday morning.

duties:
About our Team:

Our team is responsible for creating a brand of new digital financial platforms and apps that are highly reliable and scalable using modern engineering practices. You will be joining a project which talented software engineers in our Digital Bank Build team who is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the new digital banking platform and the customer channels. As part of the team, you will be responsible for implementing software features, involve in technical designs, and writing tests to ensure the high-quality delivery of the product. We're looking for top engineers out there! During the interview process, we will test your coding and design skills to assess your experience and depth of knowledge. Don't worry our interview process will be fun!

Responsibilities:

- As a backend engineer, you will be working within a specific problem where you will design, develop, and deploy backend services with a focus on scalability, high availability, and low latency
- Drive the efficient delivery of change through analysis, definition, and documentation of requirements whilst identifying potential solutions using agile delivery frameworks
- Solve complex technical and business problems and learn new technology and frameworks
- Be part of a team that will take full responsibility for the features you own
- Design, develop, test, deploy, monitor, and improve, you are responsible for the full life-cycle of your product - build it, own it

Requirements

You will be a perfect match if your profile ticks some below items:

Must-have:

- A pragmatic mindset
- Outstanding problem-solving ability, eagerness to learn, and curiosity
- A few years of software development experience with one or more general-purpose programming languages
- Strong database and schema design for large-scale applications
- Adaptable attitude and personality that is ready for continuous change
- Collaboration and culture fit in the Agile experience will be an advantage
- Good English skills

- Experience in developing distributed systems on top of micro-services architecture, event-driven architecture using Java, Spring and Spring boot, Kafka, Redis, etc. is a big plus

- Experienced in automated testing frameworks is a plus
- Good English listening and speaking is a big plus
- Experience working in the banking and the financial domain is a plus

- Meal and parking allowance are covered by the company
- Full benefits and salary rank during probation
- Insurances such as Vietnamese labor law and premium health care for you and your family
- Learning and Development: Access to SMART goals, technical seminars, conferences, career talks, and overseas training to accelerate your career advancement and ensure continuous growth.
- Values-driven, international working environment and agile culture
- Overseas travel opportunities for training and working related
- Internal Hackathons and company's events (team building, coffee run, blue card...)
- 13th-month salary and performance bonus
- 15-day annual + 3-day sick leave per year from the company
- Work-life balance 40-hr per week from Mon to Fri

Internet connection
GIMP or Photoshop CS 5.x or any version supporting grouped layers
A text editor or IDE capable of editing WordPress code, Notepad++

Independently Work From Anywhere (WFA) you want: our offices, your home, PJ’s Coffee, coffee shop, beach, it's up to you

Working with our Diverse and Inclusive TRG community with colleagues WFA from across the globe
Strong culture to support your learning development and growth
Multiple (12+) networking/collaboration/learning/training events each month
Training and certification support
Free access to our library (1000+ books), multiple online training portals/ universities/ academies

duties:
Welcome to SMG Vietnam! SMG Swiss Marketplace Group simplifies lives with innovative online marketplaces in Automotive, Real Estate, General Marketplaces, and Finance & Insurance. Recognized among the 2023 Asia & Vietnam Best Workplaces, we attract top digital talent to create exceptional user experiences for Switzerland. Guided by our core values—Better Together, Aim High, and Act Responsibly—we drive innovation and meaningful change. This job refers to our Real Estate brands, Homegate and Immoscout24, the largest real estate portals in Switzerland, with more than 15 million visits per month and more than 100,000 listings. We provide all users looking for a property with a transparent overview of the entire range of listings without them having to tediously visit different platforms. In addition to great products such as the mortgage or price calculator, we also offer editorial articles on topics such as housing and financing. We are looking for a Junior/Mid Fullstack Engineer to help us build the future of the Swiss real estate market by contributing to our cutting edge, cloud based, technology stack. You will get to collaborate and access the wealth of knowledge and experience from a community of amazing engineers who come from all parts of the globe and are ready to share their expertise and aid you in your path to fulfilling your potential. Join our dynamic team, located in six countries (Switzerland, Serbia, Vietnam, France, Germany, and India), where creativity thrives. Together, we tackle challenges, celebrate successes, and keep learning and growing.

Our tech stack: Frontend: Vue.js with TypeScript, Backend: Node.js and TypeScript, following a serverless microservices architecture in an AWS cloud environment (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, S3, etc.), Monitoring: Datadog, Documentation: Backstage.

Your Mission: Building and experimenting: Writing clean, modular code within a modern, serverless architecture, with a focus on refining and experimenting with functionality. Collaborating and creating: Working closely with a talented team of engineers to design, develop, and deliver features that make a real impact on users. Learning and applying: Gaining hands-on experience with AWS Serverless, CI/CD, and other cutting-edge tools like AI/Datalake, continuously enhancing skills along the way. Contributing to innovation: Bringing fresh ideas to improve both software and processes, always looking for opportunities to push boundaries. Your responsibilities will evolve as we grow.

Qualifications: What will you bring to the ride? Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. 1+ years of experience in Software Development. Experience with TypeScript/JavaScript, with proficiency in at least one of the following: Comfortable with Vue.js or React.js, and capable of building modern web applications. Experience with Node.js backend development, including implementing synchronous and asynchronous services. Some exposure to AWS services and a Serverless Technology Stack. Strong sense of ownership and responsibility for what the team builds. Before blindly adding code to a codebase, be able to identify problematic areas and refactor them with maintainability and stability in mind. Curious, open-minded, and enthusiastic about growing in a collaborative team environment. Ability to use AI tools to assist with coding is a plus. We value the skills you bring and your ability to learn quickly, so don’t worry if your career path has been unique.

Additional Information: What do we offer? Competitive Benefits: Attractive salary, full pay during probation, 13th-month bonus, and full social insurance contributions. Generous Leave: 21+ annual paid days off, 24 days for learning & sharing, and flexible working hours with no overtime. Health & Wellness: Premium private insurance for you and your family, free food, and access to various classes and clubs. Growth Opportunities: Personalized development plans, yearly education budgets, regular Hackathons, and potential travel to Switzerland and Europe. Modern Work Environment: Hybrid model, top-tier equipment, and a friendly, agile, and transparent culture. Supportive Onboarding: Comprehensive assistance to help you settle in. Recruitment Process: We believe hiring is a two-way street, where both parties get to know each other. Here's what you can expect: Initial screening call with HR – A brief conversation to understand your background and expectations. Meeting with the Hiring Manager – A deeper discussion about the role, your experience, and how we work. Technical Assessment – A hands-on assessment of your skills, conducted via live coding and system design exercises. Casual Meeting with Director – An informal conversation to align on vision, culture, and goals.

At SMG Vietnam, we value diverse perspectives and individual growth. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement. Together, we embrace differences, nurture potential, and celebrate success. Apply now to take this opportunity, send us your detailed CV and feel free to add any supporting documents we need to look at in order to understand that you are the perfect fit.

skills: Angular; TypeScript; JavaScript; CI/CD; React; Node.js; AWS; Azure; .NET; Java; Python
duties:
We are looking for a talented Senior Angular Developer to join our software development team. You will participate in international projects, developing high-quality user interfaces, integrating with backend systems, and ensuring optimal performance for our products. Open for both Fresher and Experienced candidates who are passionate about web technologies and eager to grow in a dynamic and professional environment.

For Fresher-level candidates, we offer a clear training roadmap and hands-on mentorship to help you build strong foundations and grow your career.

1. Technical Skills
Experience:
• Minimum 3–5 years of experience in software development using Angular.
• Hands-on experience in real-world projects utilizing the Angular framework, UI development, and backend API integration.
Frontend Development:
• Proficient in AngularJS/Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and libraries like RxJS, NgRx.
• Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and the MVC pattern.
• Skilled with tools such as Webpack, Angular CLI, and package managers (npm, yarn).
Integration & Development:
• Experience working with RESTful APIs, GraphQL, or similar protocols.
• Familiar with the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including architecture design, unit/integration testing, and CI/CD deployment.
• Ability to design responsive user interfaces and optimize web performance.
Nice-to-Have:
• Experience with other frameworks such as React, React Native, Vue.js, or Node.js.
• Knowledge of microservices, cloud services (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), or backends like .NET, Java, Python.

2. English Skills
• Fluent in English (both spoken and written) to collaborate with international teams and clients.

3. Soft Skills & Responsibilities
Teamwork:
• Work in Agile/Scrum teams alongside Scrum Masters and cross-functional development groups.
• Participate in product design, technical assessments, and code reviews to ensure code quality.
Leadership:
• Capable of leading small teams, mentoring junior/mid-level developers, or acting as a Tech Lead.
• Provide technical solutions, improve development processes, and ensure non-functional requirements are met.
Problem-Solving:
• Strong analytical thinking, system architecture design, and complex issue resolution.
• Research and apply new technologies to enhance project outcomes.

4. Education & Experience
• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields.
• 3–5 years of experience in technology companies, preferably with international or outsourcing environments.

*** Application Requirements
• Detailed CV outlining past experience and completed projects.
• Relevant certifications (if available).

Why you'll love working here
Benefits:
• Working hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM, Monday to Friday
• Flexible working model: Mainly on-site, with remote work flexibility when needed (not a fully remote position)
• Competitive Salary: 20 – 35 million VND/month
• Full insurance in accordance with the law
• Paid leave, 13th-month salary
• Team building activities, skill development training
• Professional and dynamic working environment with career growth opportunities.

duties:

YÊU CẦU CÔNG VIỆC
• Thành thạo C/C++, hiểu cơ bản về quản lý bộ nhớ, đa luồng.
• Có kinh nghiệm phát triển phần mềm trên Linux.
• Có kiến thức căn bản về media playback (video/audio), các giao thức HTTP, socket, và streaming (HLS, DASH).
• Sử dụng được các công cụ debug như: gdb, logcat, valgrind.
• Làm việc nhóm tốt, giao tiếp rõ ràng, chủ động.
• Biết đọc tài liệu kỹ thuật, tư duy hệ thống, có khả năng tự tìm hiểu và debug.
• Từng làm UI với DirectFB hoặc thư viện đồ họa nền framebuffer là lợi thế.
• Ưu tiên có hiểu biết về FFmpeg, GStreamer, tối ưu playback

QUYỀN LỢI
• Gói thu nhập năm tương xứng với năng lực (13 tháng lương, nghỉ mát...)
• Làm việc trong môi trường năng động, chuyên nghiệp có nhiều cơ hội thăng tiến
• Cung cấp trang thiết bị đầy đủ để phục vụ công việc
• Văn hóa doanh nghiệp đa dạng, phong phú; các hoạt động tri ân, chăm lo đời sống tinh thần Cán bộ nhân viên và người thân, Teambuilding, Ngày hội văn hóa, các Câu lạc bộ...
• Tham gia đầy đủ các chế độ theo Luật lao động hiện hành (BHXH, BHYT, BHTN, ngày phép)
• Khám sức khỏe định kỳ, nghỉ hè hàng năm; Gói bảo hiểm sức khỏe chuyên biệt FPT Care
• Được tham gia các khóa đào tạo, nâng cao nghiệp vụ thường xuyên
• Hưởng các gói ưu đãi cước khi sử dụng dịch vụ của FPT Play.

title: Software Engineer – Mining Machine & Mass Production
location: 3 Nguyen Luong Bang, Tan Phu Ward, District 7, Ho Chi Minh
duties:
We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join our mining machine development team. The ideal candidate will have solid experience in embedded Linux firmware, ASIC-based mining software, and mass production environments. You will play a key role in building reliable, high-performance firmware that powers cutting-edge cryptocurrency mining machines.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and maintain firmware for embedded Linux platforms (e.g., CGMiner or similar mining frameworks)
- Design and implement firmware for MCU-based power supply control systems
- Collaborate with the hardware engineering team to ensure seamless system integration
- Perform software quality assurance (QA) and stress testing prior to mass deployment
- Conduct diagnostics and failure analysis during production and post-deployment
- Perform thermal simulation and analysis to optimize heat dissipation and cooling systems
- Ensure firmware stability, scalability, and performance in mass production environments
- Contribute to the automation of software testing and deployment pipelines.

Your skills and experience
Job Requirements
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
- Direct experience with ASIC-based mining software development or optimization.
- Proven experience in mass production of mining machines or embedded systems.
- Solid understanding of blockchain protocols and cryptocurrency mining mechanisms.
- Experience with embedded Linux and mining tools such as CGMiner, BFGMiner, or equivalents.
- Familiarity with power management ICs, thermal control, and cooling system optimization.
- Proficiency in MCU firmware development (e.g., STM32, ESP32, or similar).
- Ability to conduct and interpret thermal simulations using relevant tools.
- Experience in automated software testing frameworks for embedded systems is a plus.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to work in fast-paced environments.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in hardware-software co-design.
- Knowledge of production-line testing and debugging tools.
- Understanding of reliability engineering for high-uptime systems.

Why you'll love working here
- Competitive salary based on experience and skills.
- Professional working environment with a clear promotion roadmap.
- Salary review and performance bonus every year.
- Full social insurance, health insurance, and travel allowances.
- Opportunities to work on advanced semiconductor projects with cutting-edge 5nm and 2nm technologies.

title: Fullstack Developer (NodeJS,ReactJS - Middle/Senior Level)
location: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
skills: Python; Node.js; MySQL; PostgreSQL; SQL; AWS; GCP; Terraform
duties:
We are looking for a full-stack web developer to join our team with NodeJS/ReactJS experience with a strong background in API design, databases, performance, scalability, security, etc.
Location: Ho Chi Minh, Da Nang, Hanoi

What You'll Be Doing
- Working on Web and Mobile products for a diverse range of clients and industries
- Working and pair programming with other developers to build applications with Python/Node.js and ReactJS
- Designing & implementing back-end API using Python/Node.JS
- Working with Product Owner to convert business requirements into technical designs
- Cooperating with UI Designer to implement modern minimalist designs into production
- Applying proven technologies and best practices to level up your technical skills: NestJS, Redux
- Learning new languages and frameworks to improve yourself and stay current in an ever-changing environment

Requirements
Must have
- Require a minimum of 4 years of experience with Node.JS
- Require a minimum of 2 years of experience with ReactJS or similar such as Svelte, VueJS, AngularJS
- Require relevant knowledge of relational database systems such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server
- Experience with Extreme Programming methodologies such as Test-Driven Development, Refactoring, and Continuous Integration
- Experience with Agile Process and Scrum Methodologies
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Nice to have
- Experience with serverless architecture, eg AWS Lambda, GCP Cloud Function, etc
- Experience with security, performance, scalability
- Experience with NoSQL, Message Queue
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation

Benefits
- Three days remote every week and four full remote weeks per year
- Gold level Health Insurance coverage from Bao Viet Insurance, a yearly complete Health Check and social insurance
- All office benefits and full salary during probation
- Flexible working time starting anytime up to 10 AM working Monday - Friday with no overtime and a long lunch break
- Allowance for everything: meals, parking, petrol, along with unlimited snacks and nice coffee every day
- Choose from a brand-new Mac or PC device
- Salary review twice a year with opportunities for promotions and spot awards
- 12 days annual leave per year, with all days not taken paid out in cash, plus 2 sick leave days.

- Yearly company trip, monthly activities, and other Celebrations for special days in the year, such as Women's Day, YEP, and Christmas
- Employee-led clubs within the company; games teams, sports teams, etc
- Modern open-space office with comfortable workspace, a PS4 games room, and chill-out areas.

location: 106 Nguyen Van Troi Street, Ward 17, Phu Nhuan, Ho Chi Minh
duties:

- Experience in applying various testing methodologies effectively.

duties:
ABOUT ESOFT
Esoft is one of the world’s leading real-estate tech companies specializing in property presentations, image processing, 3D visualization, and online marketing of properties worldwide.
Our customers are real estate agents and property-marketing companies in Europe, US, and Australia who rely on us for our fast service, our innovative solutions, and high and consistent quality. The company was founded in 2000 in Denmark and our platform in Vietnam has been operating since 2007. We currently employ more than 800 people in our offices in Vietnam, Denmark, Sweden, and Norway.
To learn more about our company’s business and culture, please visit our website.

At Esoft, we encourage all applicants from minorities, women, the people with disabilities and all other qualified applicants.

THE POSITION
As a Senior Frontend Developer at Esoft Systems, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing user interface components using React. In this critical role, you will be the central decision-maker for all frontend technology choices, ensuring that our applications are robust, scalable, and user-friendly. You will collaborate closely with our backend developers, and product managers to deliver top-tier solutions.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Lead the design and development of complex web applications using React.
Make critical decisions on frontend technology stack, frameworks, and tools to ensure optimal performance and maintainability.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features.
Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability.
Develop and enforce best practices for frontend development, including coding standards, testing, and documentation.
Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and technologies to ensure Esoft Systems remains at the forefront of frontend development.

REQUIREMENTS
Fluent in verbal and written English
Equivalent to at least 3-5 years of professional experience as a frontend developer, working with React.
Strong experience with state management libraries (e.g., Redux, NgRx).
Proficient in modern build tools and package managers (e.g., Webpack, Babel, npm, yarn).
Familiarity with RESTful APIs and integration with backend services.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, agile environment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Experience with TypeScript.
Knowledge of responsive design principles and mobile-first development.
Experience with testing frameworks and tools (e.g., Jest, Cypress).
Previous experience in a leadership or mentoring role.

MINDSET & ATTITUDE
Be a team player, work toward the common goal of the team, is willing to support other colleagues
Eager to learn the new technologies
Have good mindset, attitude & commitment

Why you'll love working here
We are a diverse crowd of doers and thinkers who work 24/7 from our offices in Denmark, Sweden and Vietnam, all of us towards the same goal – creating outstanding solutions and the best customer experience.
Our purpose is to make it easier to market real estate. For nearly 20 years, we have worked passionately to help realtors all over the world by delivering reliably image solutions and great marketing tools.
Joining us, you’ll have an opportunity to continue building your career in an international and successful company with market-leading, innovative solutions. In every business unit and in every office around the world, Esoft has always been driven by a strong team spirit and an even stronger sense of pride. We strive to provide an interesting workplace, where people work and interact across cultures and time zones. We cherish creativity and innovation, and we invest in training and development of employees.
Also, you will join a dynamic and international environment anchored in a strong company culture that encourages and fosters creativity, innovation, respect and equality. Our values - quality, credibility, openness, innovation, care, and passion – are based on a belief that we can make a difference – for each other and our clients. Our award-winning CSR policy and high employee ethics are proofs that we walk the talk.

WHAT WE OFFER
We are looking to build a long-term relationship, and you will be part of a team that is in a very exciting development phase.
We offer a competitive salary and benefit package including an attractive incentive plan, other activities like: Team building, company trip, Year End Party…that fit the selected candidate’s experience and qualifications.
Additional benefits include 13th and 14th month salary as per regulations set forth in our staff manual. Insurance contributions as regulated by the law.
Besides fully participate in SIUIHI, we offer private health insurance including family members as per regulations set forth in our staff manual; Annual health check as well as meals (co-sharing) consumed in the company’s canteen.
Training activities are carried out both at a corporate as well as individual level.

skills: JAVA; SQL; JavaScript; Git; Azure; AWS; CI/CD; MySQL; .Net; Kubernetes; React
duties:
JOB DESCRIPTION
- Work as software developer on the web-based application product in JAVA- related and open-source technologies
- Upgrade existing functionalities and create new ones using data-driven insights.
- Implement and deliver new customer project development with high quality.
- Participate in all phases of the development cycle.
- Actively join planning meetings.
- Implement new features according to business specifications.
- Write unit/functional/integration tests and perform unit testing.
- Conduct code reviews for other team members.
- Automate maintenance work through development.
- Respond to and resolve IT support requests from employees via phone, email, or service request system

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
- Good command of English (both written/verbal) is essential
- 3+ years for middle, 5+ for senior of experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining Java-based applications (Spring Framework) with JSP frontend
- Able to analyze, design, develop new functionalities, and provide maintenance or issue fixes.
- Experience in enterprise-scale projects using: Oracle PL/SQL; MyBatis; Java (Spring Boot/Spring Framework); JSP (JavaScript / JQuery); Git (Git Runner)
- Proficient in tools/technologies: Azure, AWS, Redis.
- Familiar with development tools: DBWeaver, Oracle SQL Developer, Eclipse, IntelliJ IDEA, Git, Gradle, Maven, CI/CD tools
- Database experience in Oracle, MS SQL Server, or MySQL – with strong SQL, stored procedures, functions, schedulers, etc
- Familiar with debugging, performance tuning, deploying, maintaining, and monitoring complex Java web applications
- Solid understanding of OOP, design patterns, and coding standards

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Experience with:
- AWS
- MS .Net / .Net Core
- Kubernetes
- React.js
- Nginx
- JUnit
- Jasper Report
- ElasticSearch & Kibana (ELK)
- Grafana
- Prometheus (monitoring/alerts)

BENEFITS
- Salary: up to 60M
- Probation salary is 100% of official salary
- 13th-month salary and performance review twice a year
- Bonus for special occasions each year (Labor Day, National Day, Solar New year, Lunar New Year)
- Project Bonus
- IT Certificate allowance
- Health Care Insurance
- Social, health and unemployment Insurance following Government policy
- Enjoy company summer trips and other team building activities held monthly and quarterly
- Work five days per week with flexible check-in time
- Professional, creative and dynamic working environment

Mô tả công việc:
- Chịu trách nhiệm Lập trình phần mềm, các module tích hợp dựa trên các sản phẩm, giải pháp, nền tảng lõi nhằm đáp ứng đầy đủ và tổng quan cho các yêu cầu cụ thể của khách hàng doanh nghiệp.
- Tham gia vào các công đoạn khác của Tích hợp hệ thống Phần mềm từ Thiết kế, kiến trúc phần mềm, kiến trúc tích hợp; Phân tích thông tin, yêu cầu; Phát hiện và sửa lỗi phần mềm; Kiểm thử và tối ưu phần mềm.
- Tham gia xây dựng, soạn thảo và trình bày các giải pháp (solution), đề xuất (proposal), bài thuyết trình (presentation), chứng minh giải pháp (POC) phù hợp đáp ứng các yêu cầu cụ thể của khách hàng và các gói thầu được giao.
- Chịu trách nhiệm tư vấn thiết kế và triển khai các giải pháp về Tích hợp hệ thống (System Integration) cho khách hàng doanh nghiệp và tổ chức viễn thông
- Đánh giá, Tích hợp & Tối ưu các thành phần phù hợp vào hệ thống tổng thể đáp ứng cho các yêu cầu vận hành và quản lý của khách hàng.

Yêu cầu ứng viên:
- Tốt nghiệp Đại học chuyên ngành Công nghệ thông tin, Khoa học máy tính,...
- Tối thiểu 02 năm kinh nghiệm về phát triển phần mềm.
- Yêu cầu ngôn ngữ: C#, ASP.NET, MVC, .NET framework , Entity Framework, OOP.
- Hiểu biết về python/nodejs là lợi thế
- Yêu cầu kiến thức về JavaScript, CSS, HTML, bootstrap, Ext.js.
- Xây dựng Web Service và tích hợp API.
- Kinh nghiệm về làm việc với API, SOAP, Rest.
- Kinh nghiệm về sử dụng ứng dụng quản lý source: git, bitbucket .....
- Kinh nghiệm với SQL và / hoặc cơ sở dữ liệu quan hệ / hoặc cơ sở dữ liệu NoSQL là một lợi thế.

Quyền lợi:
- Thời gian làm việc: 08h00-17h00 (từ thứ 2- thứ 6)
- Phúc lợi: chế độ lương hấp dẫn,chế độ phúc lợi khác theo Luật lao động và chính sách của công ty.
- Được tham gia đầy đủ BHXH theo quy định nhà nước và gói bảo hiểm sức khỏe cho nhân viên.
- Cấp Laptop làm việc.
- Du lịch hàng năm, các hoạt động nội bộ mỗi tháng.

Floware is a leader in building innovative software to transform the way people live, play, work, and learn. - Cam kết, ham học hỏi.

- Khám sức khoẻ định kỳ, BHXH, nghỉ lễ theo qui định.

As our Senior Full-stack Web Developer, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the future of web development and AI technology. - AI Utilization: Leverage advanced AI tools and methodologies, such as generative AI frameworks, vector/graph databases, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and large language models (LLMs), to boost development efficiency and code quality.

Your skills and experience

- Experience:
- Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in full-stack web development, with a proven track record of building scalable and resilient web applications.

- Proficient in Python, with experience in frameworks such as Flask or Django.
- Strong understanding of modern programming languages like Go, Rust or Move.

- Understanding of vector and graph databases, RAG, and working with multiple LLMs is a plus.

- Strong foundation in modern software design principles and test-driven development.
- Proven ability to quickly adapt to new technologies and methodologies in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to break down complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights.

- End-of-year Tet bonus.

- A balanced 40-hour work week with flexible hours.
- Professional Growth:
- Continuous learning opportunities, such as internal workshops and industry conferences.
- A collaborative and dynamic work environment that fosters innovation and creativity.
- Work Environment:
- A vibrant, modern office space in Ho Chi Minh City (District 10 and Thao Dien Area) or Da Nang.
- Remote work options are available for senior employees with a proven track record of success.

Join Us
If you’re excited about the challenge of building AI-powered, scalable web applications and shaping the future of technology, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now to join a team that values innovation, collaboration, and the relentless pursuit of excellence.

location: 431 Hoàng Văn Thụ, Phường 4, Tân Bình, Hồ Chí Minh, Vietnam
duties:
Are you looking to be more than just an ordinary Data Scientist? Do you have what it takes to see where you can improve the lives of others through a great and intelligent system to solve issues and improve life? Do you want your products to be used by millions of users in the world and know immediately how much they love your work?

As a Data Scientist with us, you will utilize a variety of data mining and analysis techniques to generate insights and develop algorithms/models, aiding in product enhancement and informed decision-making across countries. Your ability to turn data into business results and work effectively with diverse teams is crucial. Your passion for machine learning and research will be key in driving better business outcomes.

This role offers a challenging yet enriching experience in a fast-paced startup environment, revolutionizing the logistics industry with your expertise and passion for technology.

Key Responsibilities:
- Develop and implement machine learning, deep learning, and LLM-based solutions to address complex logistic challenges.
- Handle and analyze large datasets with a keen eye for detail.
- Collaborate across various AI subfields, including tabular data, NLP, and MLOps.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business challenges and objectives, translating complex data into actionable insights.
- Contribute to the development and infrastructure of AI projects.
- Work on the entire AI project lifecycle, from problem definition to deployment and monitoring.
- Proactively propose solutions, conduct independent research, and seek guidance when necessary.
- Communicate complex ideas clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing.

Your skills and experience

Education: Bachelor’s degree in any field, preferably with a combination of software engineering and statistical/mathematical skills.

Experience: 2+ years of experience in a Data Scientist or similar role.

Skills and Abilities:
- Strong proficiency in machine learning, deep learning, and LLMs.
- Familiarity with various AI subfields (tabular data, NLP, MLOps).
- Comprehensive understanding of the AI project lifecycle.
- Self-driven and capable of independent work.
- Detail-oriented with a natural intuition for data.
- Strong analytical and data-driven mindset.
- Basic knowledge of data warehouses, databases, ETL/ELT, and SQL.
- Excellent presentation and communication skills.

Personality Traits:
- Genuine curiosity and enthusiasm for applying algorithms to solve problems.
- Strong affinity for AI and a natural state of 'flow' when working with it.
- High motivation and a growth mindset to overcome challenges.
- Comfortable working in a dynamic and fast-paced professional environment.

duties:

- Xây dựng và duy trì hệ thống backend sử dụng PHP hoặc Node.js phục vụ game hoặc web-app.
- Thiết kế và triển khai RESTful API / Webhook phục vụ giao tiếp giữa frontend (Cocos2d-JS/WebView) và server.

- Kinh nghiệm tối thiểu 1 năm với PHP (Laravel là lợi thế) hoặc Node.js.
- Có kinh nghiệm với hệ sinh thái AWS, đặc biệt: S3, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB.

- Biết thêm GraphQL là lợi thế.
- Hiểu cơ bản về frontend: JavaScript, Cocos2d-JS, Unity WebGL.

location: Datalogic Vietnam LLC. F04, Lot I-4A, Saigon High Tech Park, Long Thanh My Ward, Thu Duc, Ho Chi Minh
duties:
The Software Engineer collaborates with colleagues to define requirements for software solutions and tools aimed at device’ configuration and management, analyzes such requirements, develops the software that realize them and the automatic tests that verify such functionalities.

He / she participates in design reviews, evaluates new application components and upgrades, writes recommendations on risk mitigation, understands, and recognizes quality software architecture and contributes to its definition, manages Android application’s maintenance, evaluates possible improvement of the software designs.

There may be also a collaboration with application engineers, field service engineers, technical support engineers and commercial teams to solve technical issues or to address new business needs.

Main Responsibilities:
To discuss with team requests for new features or software modules to be developed
To define and document functional requirements of needed developments
To develop and debug software applications, mainly using Kotlin, Android development tools
To apply software engineering and programming best practices
To analyze, understand and refactor existing source code
To have experience in SW optimization and event-based programming
To be familiar with Agile SW development

Your skills and experience
Technical Skills:
Good knowledge of the Android ecosystem
Proficiency in Kotlin, Android development tools and best practices (e.g. MVVM, JetPack, Android Studio, Gradle, …)
Good knowledge of Kotlin/Java SE for Linux and Windows is plus
Development experience with Web UI / web applications / cloud services is plus
Good knowledge of the testing best practices in Android (unit testing, mocking, …)
Familiarity with RESTful APIs and JSON
Basic knowledge about database
Understanding of patterns and concepts
Familiarity with different designs and architectural patterns
In-depth knowledge of code versioning tools such as Git
Understanding of CI/CD process

Education: Bachelor’s degree relating to Software Engineering or Computer Science

Nice to have: experienes of Kotlin/Java SE for Linux and Windows, Web UI / web applications / cloud services

Strong knowledge and skills improvement through practical training and technical experience
Career promotion with proven capabilities
Opportunity for overseas training (US, Europe, etc.)

- Experience with microservices architecture.

Tốt nghiệp chuyên ngành CNTT hoặc chuyên ngành liên quan.

Thu nhập thoả thuận dựa trên năng lực ứng viên.
13 tháng lương, package 2000$/năm và các chế độ thưởng theo dự án, mức độ thành công của các sản phẩm nghiên cứu.
Được hưởng 12 ngày nghỉ phép và 15 ngày nghỉ hưởng nguyên lương gồm 11 ngày nghỉ lễ tết, 3 ngày nghỉ mát và 1 ngày sáng tạo hàng năm.

title: AI Developer
location: 30 Nguyễn Thị Diệu , District 3, Ho Chi Minh
duties:
Coder Trove is seeking an AI Developer to join immediately working on a FinTech application. Working closely with our team you will be given regular training and support, and work in a fun and friendly team environment.

Your role:
- Develop, optimize, and deploy AI modules for business process automation, focusing on Large Language Models (LLMs) and agent-based systems.
- Design and implement machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) models to support LLM agents and related applications.
- Create automation solutions tailored to invoice financing and other business needs, ensuring scalability and reliability.
- Integrate AI solutions into existing infrastructure in collaboration with cross-functional teams, ensuring seamless deployment and performance.
- Conduct data preprocessing, feature engineering, and exploratory data analysis to prepare high-quality datasets for model training and evaluation.
- Stay at the forefront of AI and ML advancements by exploring and experimenting with the latest technologies and methodologies.
- Document project workflows, model architectures, and key development milestones for knowledge sharing and process transparency.
- Collaborate with the Project Manager and team to fulfill additional project-related tasks as needed.

Your skills and experience
- Having a degree in Computer Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related field is helpful but not required.
- 1–3 years of hands-on experience in AI/ML development.
- Proficiency in Python and frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
- Solid understanding of machine learning algorithms and data structures.
- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
- Good English communication skills, both written and spoken.
- Proven ability to analyze business data models and manage training/fine-tuning processes.
- Previous work with international teams and using English for communication;

Nice to Have (But Not Required):
- Hands-on experience with Python frameworks like FastAPI, LangChain, or LangGraph.
- Experience with the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) to support integration and deployment of AI solutions within web-based systems.
- Familiarity with OpenAI APIs or other Large Language Model providers and their integration into business solutions.
- Strong background in ML/DL frameworks (e.g., PyTorch) and experience in deploying production-grade AI models.
- Experience with Agile/Scrum;

Why you'll love working here
- A 13-month salary bonus.
- 13 days of paid leave and 10 days of sick leave.
- WFH as needed.
- High-quality health insurance and health check-ups.
- Company trips.
- Regular team events with office food delivered twice a week; extra drinks and snacks are always available.
- Support for training and certifications to improve your skills.
- A friendly management team, a flexible working environment, and opportunities for career growth.

location: Củ Chi district, Ho Chi Minhstad, Vietnam

duties:
Company Description

Welcome to SMG Vietnam! SMG Swiss Marketplace Group simplifies lives with innovative online marketplaces in Automotive, Real Estate, General Marketplaces, and Finance & Insurance. As SMG’s innovation hub, SMG Vietnam develops cutting-edge solutions in a collaborative, empowering environment. Recognized among the 2023 Asia & Vietnam Best Workplaces, we attract top digital talent to create exceptional user experiences for Switzerland. Guided by our core values—Better Together, Aim High, and Act Responsibly—we drive innovation and meaningful change.

Job Description

This job refers to our Real Estate brands, Homegate and Immoscout24, the largest real estate portals in Switzerland, with more than 15 million visits per month and more than 100,000 listings. We provide all users looking for a property with a transparent overview of the entire range of listings without them having to tediously visit different platforms. In addition to great products such as the mortgage or price calculator, we also offer editorial articles on topics such as housing and financing.

We are looking for a Junior/Mid Fullstack Engineer to help us build the future of the Swiss real estate market by contributing to our cutting edge, cloud based, technology stack. You will get to collaborate and access the wealth of knowledge and experience from a community of amazing engineers who come from all parts of the globe and are ready to share their expertise and aid you in your path to fulfilling your potential.

Join our dynamic team, located in six countries (Switzerland, Serbia, Vietnam, France, Germany, and India), where creativity thrives. Together, we tackle challenges, celebrate successes, and keep learning and growing.

Our tech stack

- Frontend: Vue.js with TypeScript
- Backend: Node.js and TypeScript, following a serverless microservices architecture in an AWS cloud environment (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, S3, etc.)

- Trình độ học vấn: Tốt nghiệp Đại học/ Cao đẳng chuyên ngành: Công nghệ thông tin, Khoa học máy tính, Thiết kế phần mềm hoặc liên quan.

+ Thành thạo Angular (từ version 9 trở lên), hiểu rõ các concepts: component, module, service, routing, reactive forms, RxJS...
+ Hiểu biết tốt về HTML5, CSS3, SASS/SCSS, JavaScript/TypeScript.
+ Có kiến thức cơ bản về UI/UX, responsive web design, RESTful API.
+ Ưu tiên biết thêm ReactJS, VueJS, hoặc framework frontend khác.
+ Ưu tiên có kinh nghiệm làm việc với Git, CI/CD, quản lý source code.
- Khả năng:
+ Kỹ năng debug, tối ưu mã nguồn, tối ưu tốc độ tải trang.
+ Kỹ năng đọc tài liệu kỹ thuật và phối hợp nhóm tốt.
+ Khả năng tự học nhanh, nắm bắt công nghệ mới.
+ Kỹ năng viết mã sạch, dễ maintain, tuân thủ guideline.
- Yêu cầu khác:
+ Ưu tiên ứng viên có sản phẩm demo / GitHub repo / đã từng làm dự án thực tế.
+ Có khả năng sử dụng công cụ quản lý dự án: Jira, GitLab, hoặc tương đương.

- Chế độ đãi ngộ
+ Mức lương: cạnh tranh hấp dẫn (sẵn sàng offer cao khi đủ năng lực) + Phụ cấp (Ăn ca: 700.000 VNĐ/tháng; Gửi xe: 120.000 VNĐ/tháng; trợ cấp máy tính cá nhân (nếu có): 300.000 VNĐ/tháng).
+ Chính sách thưởng: Thưởng Lễ, Tết, sinh nhật + thưởng dự án + thưởng thâm niên + Lương tháng 13 + các thưởng khác theo quy định Công ty tại thời điểm hiện hành.
+ Làm việc trong môi trường trẻ trung, năng động, coi trọng năng lực và khả năng sáng tạo
+ Thường xuyên tổ chức các hoạt động mini game, chương trình các ngày Lễ, Tết, sinh nhật, tham gia hoạt động Teambuilding của công ty..
- Đào tạo – Phát triển
+ Cơ hội tiếp cận và học hỏi công nghệ tiên tiến, công nghệ mới
+ Được công ty tạo điều kiện và hỗ trợ khi tham gia các khóa đào tạo, phát triển năng lực.
+ Có cơ hội làm những việc thách thức, phát huy hết khả năng bản thân.
+ Tham gia các sản phẩm công nghệ mới theo kế hoạch phát triển của công ty.
- Chăm sóc sức khỏe, đời sống
+ Bảo hiểm xã hội, bảo hiểm y tế, bảo hiểm thất nghiệp theo luật bảo hiểm.
+ Được tặng quà, thăm hỏi nhân các dịp: sinh nhật, cưới hỏi, hiếu hỉ, ốm đau...
+ Có thể tham gia các câu lạc bộ thể thao: đá bóng, tập yoga, thể dục cải thiện sức khoẻ...

TIÊU ĐỀ: Applied AI Engineer
CÔNG TY: Everfit
ĐỊA ĐIỂM: Quận Hải Châu, Đà Nẵng
MỨC LƯƠNG: Thỏa thuận

--- MÔ TẢ CÔNG VIỆC ---
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us
AI-first company shaping the future of fitness
Join a passionate global team across VN, US, & UK
Collaborative team valuing joy & creativity
The Job
About Everfit
Everfit is one of the fastest growing fitness coaching platforms in the world. We power more than 320,000 coaches across the globe with an all-in-one AI-powered platform to run and grow their businesses. In 6 years, we have become one of the leaders of the health and wellness B2B SaaS category in the US and around the world! We are at an inflection point. We are focusing our efforts to capture more of the $5.1 trillion health and fitness market by going direct to consumers. Our vision is to become the operating system for personal health, where anyone can plug in a coach, or multiple coaches, to reach their wellness goals faster, optimize their human potential, and extend their longevity.
Our team spans from San Francisco to Vietnam, with senior leaders who have built and scaled products at Netflix, Apple, Meta, Nike, Hulu, Uber, Amazon, Hypebeast, and Quibi. We are building the next unicorn to come out of Vietnam, and we are looking for a confident leader who can help us get there.
Position Overview:
As an Applied AI Engineer at Everfit, you'll work at the intersection of backend engineering and applied AI, building the scalable systems and AI-powered experiences that shape the future of fitness coaching for coaches and their clients around the world.
This is not a Backend role with AI sprinkled on top. Expect roughly 70% of your work on LLM-powered systems (agent workflows, RAG, tool calling, evals) and 30% on the core backend services that power them.
Your impact:
What you'll build
• Durable, long-running AI workflows on Temporal: scheduled jobs and multi-step agent processes that survive restarts, retries, and partial failures.
• Reliable AI pipelines with validation, retries, fallbacks, guardrails, and observability.
• Systems designed around AI-specific constraints: latency, token cost, model failures, quality.
• Production integrations with OpenAI and Anthropic models.
• The path from experiment to production: take a validated AI capability from the AI team and ship it as a service with clear reliability, cost, and quality characteristics.
• Evals and monitoring that define how AI features are measured, and catch regressions before users do.
How you'll work
• Scalable backend services in Node.js/TypeScript, with system architecture, technical design, and code review across Everfit's backend.
• Rapid experiments with emerging AI tech, turning the successful ones into production solutions.
• Day-to-day with Product Managers, AI Engineers, and QA, from technical discovery through delivery.
• Investigating production issues and improving AI workflows from real user feedback.
• Helping the broader engineering org adopt AI-native development practices.
Your Skills and Experience
• 4+ years of professional backend engineering experience.
• Comfortable communicating in English and working with an international team.
• Strong programming experience (preferably Node.js / TypeScript / Python) and backend architecture. Our core backend is Node.js/TypeScript and our AI services are Python/FastAPI; you'll work mainly in Node but should be comfortable crossing into Python when the work lives there.
• Solid understanding of REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, databases, and scalable system design.
• Strong experience with databases such as MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
• You have shipped at least one LLM-powered feature to production for real users, working directly with OpenAI or Anthropic APIs, and can talk concretely about its failure modes, evals, latency, and cost.
• You already use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex) daily, and you review what they produce with judgment about architecture, security, and edge cases.
• Comfortable experimenting with new AI tools and technologies and turning successful experiments into production solutions.
• Curious, proactive, and excited about how AI can fundamentally change software development and product experiences.
[Nice to have]
• Experience with Python / FastAPI or AI-focused backend development.
• Experience building production LLM features, RAG pipelines, or agentic systems.
• Familiarity with the stack we run in production: Pydantic/LangGraph, Qdrant for vector search, Langfuse for LLM observability, and MCP.
• Experience with AWS, Docker, message queues, or cloud-native architecture.
• Experience improving engineering productivity through AI, with measurable impact.
• Experience working with health, fitness, wellness, personalization, or recommendation systems.
• Open-source contributions or personal projects involving AI.
Why You'll Love Working Here
Compensation & Benefits:
• Full social insurance coverage and premium healthcare benefits.
• Competitive salary with 13th-month pay and performance bonus.
• Paid leave — vacation, sick leave, and maternity leave
Build Your Career with Impact:
• Be part of a mission-driven company that’s transforming human potential.
• Empower over 300,000+ coaches in more than 200 countries - including Olympic athletes, military trainers, rehab specialists, and celebrity coaches.
• Make a global impact while building a meaningful, purpose-driven career.
• Continuous training, mentoring.
• 1-2 performance reviews annually.
Work Environment:
• English-speaking, international environment promoting open communication and collaboration.
• Work alongside world-class talent from companies like Apple, Meta, Uber, Patreon, and Nike, united by a shared passion for impact and excellence.
• International team for global career growth.
• State-of-the-art equipment provided.
• Beautiful working environment near Danang's city center (Dragon Bridge) and Hanoi office.
Health & Wellness:
• PVI health insurance program and annual health check-ups.
• Active sports clubs (football, badminton, pickleball) and company retreats.
• A modern pantry designed for relaxation and social connection.
• Monthly wellness and learning workshops to recharge and grow.

duties:
Weldcom tuyển 03 chuyên viên lập trình, làm việc tại trụ sở chính số 285A Ngô Gia Tự, Long Biên, Hà Nội.

Chi tiết công việc: Lập trình các ứng dụng phần mềm phục vụ cho hoạt động sản xuất, kinh doanh của Công ty trên các nền tảng web, windows form. Cụ thể:
- Phối hợp với các bộ phận khác để đưa ra ý tưởng cho các mẫu thiết kế phần mềm, ứng dụng mới.

- Nâng cấp phần mềm và các hệ thống để đảm bảo tính bảo mật và hiệu quả hơn.
- Phối hợp với nhóm Service Desk để viết tài liệu hướng dẫn sử dụng.
- Kiểm tra và bảo trì các chương trình, ứng dụng định kỳ, tiến hành sửa lỗi khi có vấn đề xảy ra.
- Triển khai và giới thiệu sản phẩm phần mềm tới khách hàng.

Yêu cầu ứng viên:
- Tốt nghiệp từ đại học chuyên ngành công nghệ thông tin, phần mềm.
- Sử dụng một số ngôn ngữ lập trình:.NET/C#, Java, Python, Web Service.
- Có kiến thức về SQL, MSSQL.
- Lập trình với hệ CSDL: MSSQL, MySQL, Postgres, Oracle.
- Thành thạo HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, Javascript, Jquery (Ưu tiên sử dụng ReactJs).
- Kinh nghiệm sử dụng GIT như GitHub/GitLab, Docker container.
- Có khả năng phân tích, tổng hợp dữ liệu ở các nguồn dữ liệu khác nhau.
- Kỹ năng làm việc độc lập, làm việc nhóm tốt.
- Hoạt bát, siêng năng, trung thực, chịu áp lực công việc.
- Ưu tiên có kinh nghiệm triển khai các giải pháp phần mềm quản trị doanh nghiệp đặc biệt các doanh nghiệp có yếu tố sản xuất, xây dựng các phần mềm, thiết kế database, big data.

QUYỀN LỢI ĐƯỢC HƯỞNG:
- Thu nhập 15 - 30 triệu (Gồm Lương + phụ cấp + thưởng).
- Được tham gia chính sách phát triển nhân sự ưu việt: được cấp quỹ đào tạo hàng năm để chủ động tham gia các khóa học ngoài, được tham gia chương trình đào tạo inhouse.
- Bảo hiểm xã hội đóng trên 100% lương.
- Các chế độ phép năm, lễ tết,... theo đúng 100% quy định của pháp luật lao động.
- Được làm việc trong một môi trường coi trọng người lao động, văn hóa doanh nghiệp rõ nét. - Các chế độ phúc lợi đầy đủ. - Làm việc 5,5 ngày / tuần, nghỉ chiều thứ 7 và ngày chủ nhật.

Địa điểm làm việc:
- Hà Nội: 285A Ngô Gia Tự, Long Biên, Long Biên.

Thời gian làm việc:
Thứ 2 - Thứ 6 (từ 08:00 đến 17:00)
Thứ 7 (từ 08:00 đến 12:00)

Cách thức ứng tuyển:
Ứng viên nộp hồ sơ trực tuyến bằng cách bấm Ứng tuyển ngay dưới đây.

duties:
About this role
As a Full Stack Engineer, you will develop the user interfaces for and manage the full lifecycles of AI/ML application experiences.

Our global AI, Data & Analytics Division at Renesas is experiencing an increasing demand for AI and Generative AI (LLM) based solutions. Working closely with our business partners, we deliver AI solutions to help drive value for Renesas at a global enterprise scale. We are seeking passionate candidates that will thrive as part of a global team of technologists that love empowering customers, collaborating with teammates, and using the latest AI and Data technologies.

- Build and enhance user interfaces and experiences for AI solutions, including front-end and back-end systems and deploying complete applications.

- Keep up to date with the latest developments and trends in AI/ML applications and Databricks technologies.

- 10+ years of professional experience in the tech industry.
- Strong management skills, including team leadership and cross-functional coordination.

- Expertise in system/solution architecture design, with solid knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
- Ability to create and communicate technical designs using tools like Draw.io.
- Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Experience working with AI team members, or a strong motivation to learn and collaborate in AI-related projects.

Nice-to-Have Skills:
- Knowledge of DevOps practices and tools.
- Experience with frontend development using React.
- Familiarity with backend technologies, including Python, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL.

- Competitive salary/bonus based on working performance.
- Excellent training program.
- Opportunity for promotion.
- Fair assessment.
- 24/24 hour insurance package including social and medical and unemployed insurance.
- Dynamic people.
- Team-oriented environment.
- Sport activities and Annual company trip.

duties:

- Young and fun working environment
- Opportunities to study and work abroad.

- Mentor and guide team members, fostering a culture of collaboration, learning, and technical excellence (for senior roles).
- Stay updated with industry trends, continuously leveraging new practices to enhance team performance (for senior roles).

Your skills and experience
- Bachelor’s degree or higher in IT, Computer Science, or a related field.
- At least 3 years of experience in roles such as Cloud Architect, Cloud Consultant, or DevOps Engineer with expertise in AWS, GCP, or Azure.
- Familiarity with scripting languages such as Bash, Python, or Golang is a plus.
- Experience with AI/ML technologies, including Cloud AI platforms, AI Orchestrators, and DataOps, is a plus.
- Proven experience in leading technical teams or managing projects is an advantage.
- In-depth knowledge of system design, architecture patterns, and cloud best practices.
- Strong problem-solving abilities and analytical skills.
- Proficiency in English; understanding Korean is a significant advantage.

Workshop travel for the whole company once a year. Bonuses/Gifts for holidays, International Labor Day, International Women's Day, etc.

- Opportunities to work/study in Korea and abroad: With customers and projects mostly from abroad, your opportunities for training and onsite abroad will always be open!
- Other: Happy hours every Friday, Team outing monthly, join clubs like football, badminton, etc...

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (Java/ReactJS)
location: The Six8 Building: 24-26 Phan Dinh Giot, Tan Binh District, HCMC; VDB Tower: 74 Quang Trung, Hai Chau, Danang
duties:
Join Aperia Solutions, a leader in SaaS solutions for the Payments and Compliance industries. Aperia is a Texas-based fintech and managed consultancy firm that creates custom SaaS applications and other software-based solutions for the payments, banking, and processing industry. Founded in 1999, Aperia offers business intelligence, risk management, compliance, and customer intelligence platforms. With offices in Dallas, Washington DC, and Vietnam, Aperia is a fast-paced, global organization that strives to improve efficiency in compliance, risk, and customer service operations. Aperia’s clients include banks, processors, payment facilitators, merchant service providers, independent sales organizations, and government entities. A career at Aperia promises a great challenge, culture, and opportunities to forge your own path.

Job Description:
At Aperia, we thrive on innovation and the strength of our dynamic development team. We are currently seeking a Senior Full Stack Developer (Java/ReactJS) with a strong background in Java and J2EE who is passionate about modern technologies, cloud-native architecture, and secure, scalable systems. If you’re eager to push boundaries and drive meaningful impact in a fast-paced fintech environment, we want to hear from you.

Core Responsibilities:
- Full lifecycle - analysis, design, development, testing and implementation- of new or enhancements to middleware (micro) services
- Maintain middleware modules and services with code quality standards
- Keep applications free of security vulnerabilities in compliance with organization’s security policies
- Assist in troubleshooting and resolving production issues. Provide suggestions for preventative steps
- Incorporate suggestions for improvements and enhancements where meaningful
- May assist/lead in developing and maintaining technical documentation and store it in central locations (like Confluence, SharePoint) for accessible to team members.

Your skills and experience:
Technical Skills:
- 8+ years of hands-on experience in Java/J2EE development.
- Expertise in Spring, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Data, and RESTful APIs.
- Working knowledge of RabbitMQ or similar message brokers.
- Proficiency in Oracle PL/SQL.
- Strong unit testing skills with JUnit.
- Exposure to ReactJS on the frontend.
- Experience with build tools like Maven, and artifact repositories like Nexus.
- Familiarity with Postman for API testing and PCF (Pivotal Cloud Foundry).
- Demonstrated experience in addressing security vulnerabilities and managing open-source dependencies.
- Maintain high code quality using tools like SonarQube.
- Version control and CI/CD experience using GitLab.
- Proficient with Atlassian tools including JIRA and Confluence.
- Solid understanding of Linux environments

Things that will separate you from the rest:
- Experience with JIRA integration and custom workflows.
- Familiarity with logging and monitoring tools like Splunk.
- Ability to collaborate effectively with onshore and offshore teams.
- Background in the finance or banking industry.
- Strong problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills (written and verbal).

Job Type:
- Full-Time

Schedule:
- Monday to Friday

Work Location:
- The Six8 Building: 24-26 Phan Dinh Giot, Tan Binh District, HCMC
- VDB Tower: 74 Quang Trung, Hai Chau, Danang

- Highly competitive salary
- Full salary for probation & full coverage of social insurance.
- Premium healthcare for you and your beloved one.
- Monthly childcare support
- 13th-month salary.
- Annual Leave: 15 days; Paternity Leave: 6 weeks, Bereavement leave: 10 days.
- Flexible working time, focus on output (no checking time attendance)
- Various active sporty clubs: Football, Billiards, Badminton, E-sport clubs
- Frequent opportunities to travel to US headquarters from 3-6 months.

Lập trình phần mềm vận hành các thiết bị trong nhà máy sản xuất chip bán dẫn như cánh tay robot, chamber… Giao tiếp với PLC, thiết bị trường để thu thập dữ liệu từ cảm biến…
Tham gia phân tích yêu cầu, triển khai, hướng dẫn nhóm phát triển. Báo cáo công việc với cấp trên.
Thời gian làm việc: 08:30 – 17:30 (thứ 2 – thứ 6).

YÊU CẦU KỸ THUẬT:
Có từ 5 năm kinh nghiệm trở lên trong Software Developer.
Có từ 3 năm kinh nghiệm trở lên trong phát triển ứng dụng C# (WinForms, .NET framework)
Có từ 1 năm kinh nghiệm quản lý nhóm từ 2 thành viên trở lên.
Có kiến thức vững chắc về C# và OOP. Có kinh nghiệm hỗ trợ kỹ thuật, review source code.
Có kinh nghiệm về lập trình multi-thread và multi-process.
Có kinh nghiệm trong lập trình giao tiếp bằng TCP/IP socket, truyền thông công nghiệp như RS-232 …
Sử dụng thành thạo Visual Studio 2015/2017/2019.
Có kỹ năng làm việc độc lập và làm việc nhóm tốt.
Có kỹ năng phân tích, tư duy logic và giải quyết vấn đề tốt.

YÊU CẦU BỔ SUNG (LỢI THẾ):
Điểm cộng nếu thành thạo C/C++, WPF.
Có kinh nghiệm lập trình giao tiếp với PLC (Mitsubishi, Omron…)
Có kinh nghiệm về Unit Test và System Test.
Có kinh nghiệm về tối ưu hóa source-code, re-factoring source code.
Có kinh nghiệm làm việc cho khách hàng/thị trường/doanh nghiệp
Có kinh nghiệm sử dụng các công cụ: Gitlab, Redmine
Tiếng Anh: đọc và hiểu các tài liệu kỹ thuật

MỨC LƯƠNG
Lương thỏa thuận theo năng lực:
Senior: Từ 26,000,000 VND (GROSS)
Bonus: thưởng lương tháng 13 (từ 1 tháng lương trở lên)
Xét tăng lương hàng năm.

QUYỀN LỢI SỨC KHỎE
Được hưởng đầy đủ chế độ, phúc lợi theo Luật Lao Động
Được hưởng gói Bảo Hiểm sức khỏe Bảo Việt với mức quyền lợi cao. (sau 6 tháng kể từ ngày ký HĐLĐ chính thức)
Khám sức khỏe định kỳ tại bệnh viện uy tín.

CHẾ ĐỘ ĐÃI NGỘ KHÁC
Tham gia tour du lịch cao cấp hàng năm.
Phụ cấp ăn trưa, phụ cấp xăng và gửi xe miễn phí.
Được tổ chức sinh nhật, các bữa tiệc vào dịp lễ đặc biệt (Giáng sinh, Tất niên, Trung thu, ….)
Quà tết, Trung thu, ….

CƠ HỘI PHÁT TRIỂN
Được làm việc, trao đổi với các kỹ sư giỏi ở Nhật Bản.
Cơ hội thăng tiến và Onsite ở Nhật Bản.

MÔI TRƯỜNG LÀM VIỆC
Trang bị đầy đủ thiết bị phục vụ cho công việc.
Luôn được đồng nghiệp hỗ trợ, tư vấn, đào tạo trong công việc để phát triển hơn.
Môi trường năng động, vui vẻ gắn kết nhau.
Coffee, bánh kẹo, thiết bị tiện nghi luôn sẵn sàng cho mọi nhu cầu.

title: GAME DEVELOPER (MIDDLE)
duties:
VỀ CHÚNG TÔI
Archer Studio, thành lập năm 2022 bởi những chuyên gia game giàu kinh nghiệm, chuyên tâm tạo ra các tựa game mid-core và hybrid casual chất lượng cao cho thị trường quốc tế. Sứ mệnh của chúng tôi là mang đến những trải nghiệm giải trí sáng tạo và đầy cảm hứng.
Với tầm nhìn vươn tầm khu vực, chúng tôi đề cao giá trị Đam Mê - Sáng Tạo - Chuyên Nghiệp - Cống Hiến. Đội ngũ gần 60 thành viên tài năng, đa chuyên môn của Archer Studio chính là động lực để chúng tôi không ngừng đổi mới và chinh phục những thử thách mới.
Khám phá thêm tại: https://archergame.mobi

BẠN SẼ LÀM GÌ TẠI ARCHER STUDIO?
Với vai trò Game Developer, bạn sẽ chịu trách nhiệm dẫn dắt kỹ thuật, đồng hành cùng team phát triển những sản phẩm game chất lượng cao cho thị trường quốc tế.
- Phát triển và tối ưu các tính năng game trên Unity, tập trung vào thể loại 2D.
- Xây dựng và phát triển game cho công ty(tập trung chủ yếu 2D).

CHÂN DUNG ĐỒNG ĐỘI CHÚNG TÔI TÌM KIẾM
- Tối thiểu 3 năm kinh nghiệm phát triển game bằng Unity và C#.
- Thành thạo Unity cho phát triển game 2D.
- Kiến thức về cấu trúc dữ liệu và giải thuật tốt.
- Hiểu về các Design Pattern dùng trong phát triển game.
- Hiểu và áp dụng nguyên tắc SOLID trong lập trình.
- Thành thạo dựng các UI trong Unity.
- Biết sử dụng các plugin bên thứ 3 phục vụ trong quá trình làm việc: Dotween, Odin Inspector and Serializer.
- Biết cách sử sụng các hệ thống về AI Behavior trong game như Behavior Tree, Pathfinding, và Navigation.
- Thành thạo sử dụng Git trong quản lý source code và làm việc nhóm.
- Đã từng tích hợp các tính năng IAP, Ads và Analytics cho game.
- Có hiểu biết về các hệ thống quản lý asset trong game như AssetBundle, Addressable.

Nice to have:
- Từng làm các game dạng Idle.
- Biết cách xử lý, tối ưu về performance và dung lượng cho game.
- Đã từng làm việc trong môi trường Agile/Scrum.

VÌ SAO BẠN NÊN CHỌN ARCHER STUDIO?
Tại Archer Studio, chúng tôi không chỉ mang đến một công việc, mà còn là một hành trình phát triển sự nghiệp đầy hứng khởi:
- Mức lương CẠNH TRANH, không giới hạn, phản ánh đúng năng lực và kinh nghiệm của bạn.
- Thử việc 100% lương chính thức.
- Phát triển không ngừng:
- Review năng lực 2 lần/năm, lộ trình thăng tiến rõ ràng.
- Khuyến khích học tập và nâng cao chuyên môn với chế độ hỗ trợ đào tạo.
- Làm việc cùng đội ngũ nhân sự tinh nhuệ, giàu kinh nghiệm, sẵn sàng chia sẻ và cùng bạn tạo ra những sản phẩm chất lượng quốc tế.
- An tâm cống hiến:
- Đóng BHXH, BHYT, BHTN đầy đủ.
- Thưởng tháng 13 và các dịp lễ tết (Tết dương lịch, 30/4-1/5, 2/9, 8/3, 20/10...).
- Quà tặng cho các sự kiện cá nhân: sinh nhật, hiếu hỉ, sinh con, Tết thiếu nhi, Trung thu.
- Hỗ trợ khi ốm đau nằm viện.
- Khám sức khỏe định kỳ hàng năm.
- Môi trường làm việc lý tưởng:
- Thời gian làm việc: từ 8h30 - 18h00, nghỉ trưa từ 12h đến 13h30, từ Thứ 2 đến Thứ 6.
- Trang bị đầy đủ: Máy tính và thiết bị cấu hình cao.
- Nạp năng lượng mỗi ngày: Bữa trưa miễn phí, trà, cà phê, bánh kẹo thả ga tại văn phòng.
- Năng động, sáng tạo, thân thiện và cởi mở, nơi mọi ý tưởng đều được lắng nghe và trân trọng.
- Gắn kết đội ngũ: Du lịch và các hoạt động teambuilding "chất phát ngất". Công ty có quỹ teambuilding riêng cho mỗi team để gắn kết mọi người hàng quý.

BẠN ĐÃ SẴN SÀNG CHO BƯỚC TIẾN TIẾP THEO TRONG SỰ NGHIỆP CÙNG ARCHER STUDIO?
Archer Studio rất mong được làm quen và khám phá tài năng của bạn. Hãy gửi ngay CV ấn tượng nhất của bạn về cho chúng tôi qua email: [email]

title: RTOS Developer
duties:
ABOUT COMPANY
A subsidiary of the FPT Group, FPT Software is known as a leading global information technology service provider headquartered in Vietnam. With over 30,000 employees working in 83 offices across 30 countries on five continents, FPT Software consistently delivers the best solutions to more than 1000 clients, including 100 Fortune 500 companies. Placing human resources as the cornerstone of its achievements, employee experience is our top priority in continually creating an innovative, open, and enjoyable work environment for every member.

In 2023, FPT Software officially made its mark on the global billion-dollar company list. This is evidence of the talent and efforts of multiple generations of employees at FPT Software.

Why not explore your potential and embark on a brilliant journey with us?

RESPONSIBILITIES
As a Smart Meter Software Development Engineer, you will work on critical projects in developing software for smart meter systems using FreeRTOS. You will play an instrumental role in two primary projects:
• AT Command Development: Designing, implementing, and testing AT command capabilities to support smart meter functionalities and communication interfaces.
• DLMS Protocol Implementation: Developing and optimizing software modules for DLMS (Device Language Message Specification) protocol to ensure secure and efficient data exchange in smart meter systems.

Additional responsibilities include:
• Integrating and optimizing FreeRTOS for smart meter applications, focusing on real-time performance and resource efficiency.
• Troubleshooting, debugging, and maintaining high-performance, scalable code for smart meters.
• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to align software functionalities with hardware capabilities and project requirements.
• Documenting software architecture and processes to support smooth project management and ensure high standards.

Yêu cầu ứng viên
• Operating System: Strong expertise in FreeRTOS for real-time, embedded applications.
• Platform: STM32
• AT Command Parser: Experience in developing and parsing AT commands.
• DLMS Protocol: Solid understanding and experience with the DLMS protocol for secure data exchange in smart metering.
Languages
• C/C++

Quyền lợi
• Salary range: $2000 - $3500
• FPT Care insurance plan tailored for FPT employees
• Attractive annual summer vacation allowance
• Sponsored training courses for personal growth and up to 100% coverage for certification costs
• Global and inclusive workplace with monthly cross-cultural events
• International exposure and career growth across global locations
• Work-life balance benefits with a flexible leave policy and annual health check-ups to support employee well-being

Địa điểm làm việc
- Hà Nội: FPT Building, 17 Duy Tân Str., Cầu Giấy District, Hanoi, Cầu Giấy

Thời gian làm việc
Thứ 2 - Thứ 6 (từ 08:30 đến 17:30)

Cách thức ứng tuyển
Ứng viên nộp hồ sơ trực tuyến bằng cách bấm Ứng tuyển ngay dưới đây.

title: Full Stack Developer (.NET, ReactJS)
skills: .NET; JavaScript; SQL; CI/CD; HTML; CSS; React; Angular; C#; Git; Docker
duties:
Summary

Join Aperia Solutions, a leader in SaaS solutions for the Payments and Compliance industries. Aperia is a Texas-based fintech and managed consultancy firm that creates custom SaaS applications and other software-based solutions for the payments, banking, and processing industry. Founded in 1999, Aperia offers business intelligence, risk management, compliance, and customer intelligence platforms. With offices in Dallas, Washington DC, and Vietnam, Aperia is a fast-paced, global organization that strives to improve efficiency in compliance, risk, and customer service operations. Aperia's clients include banks, processors, payment facilitators, merchant service providers, independent sales organizations, and government entities. A career at Aperia promises a great challenge, culture, and opportunities to forge your own path.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated Full-Stack Developer (.NET ReactJS) to join our development team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining robust web applications across the entire stack—from front-end UI/UX design to back-end services and databases. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, high-performance solutions that meet both user needs and business objectives.

Core Responsibilities

• Design and develop responsive, user-centric front-end components using modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., ReactJS).
• Develop and maintain scalable back-end APIs and services using technologies such as .NET Core.
• Integrate front-end components with back-end logic and database systems (i.e. SQL).
• Collaborate with UI/UX designers, product managers, and other developers to define and implement solutions.
• Write clean, testable, and well-documented code.
• Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines to ensure rapid and reliable deployment of applications.
• Optimize applications for performance, security, and scalability.
• Troubleshoot and debug issues across the stack in development and production environments.
• Participate in code reviews and mentor junior developers when needed.

Technical Skills

• Minimum 3-4 years of experience as a full-stack developer using .Net Core, ReactJS and SQL.
• Proficiency in front-end technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and one or more modern frameworks (React, Angular, etc.).
• Strong experience with server-side languages such as .Net Core, C#.
• Familiarity with database technologies (SQL, NoSQL).
• Experience with RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.
• Knowledge of version control systems like Git.
• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
• Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.

Things that will separate you from the rest

• Exposure to CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Docker, GitLab CI, Maven.
• Familiarity with JIRA, Confluence, and Agile development methodologies.
• Solid understanding of HTML5 and CSS.

Education or Certifications

• Bachelor's Degree or higher, major in IT, Computer Science.

Job Type

• Full-Time.

Schedule

• Monday to Friday.

Work Location

• The Six8 Building: 24-26 Phan Dinh Giot, Tan Binh District, HCMC.
• VDB Tower: 74 Quang Trung, Hai Chau, Danang.

Benefits

• Health insurance.
• Dental insurance.
• Paid time off.
• Parental leave.
• Childcare assistance.

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. An employee may also perform other reasonable related business duties as assigned by their immediate supervisor or management. Principals only.
