duties:
Top 3 reasons to join us
- Mức lương cạnh tranh, hấp dẫn
- Môi trường làm việc chuyên nghiệp, thân thiện
- Được làm việc với các hệ thống hiện đại, tiên tiến

Job description
- Phát triển, ứng dụng, tối ưu, tích hợp mô hình AI cho các bài toán ứng dụng trong hoạt động Kinh doanh/Ngân hàng về các lĩnh vực Computer Vision, NLP...

- Coding, test metrics, service và unittest theo mô hình DevOps, MLOps
- Nghiên cứu, tìm hiểu các bài báo khoa học mới nhất về AI, ML, DL
- Với nhóm ứng viên là các bạn chuẩn bị tốt nghiệp tài năng và fresher: tham gia các chương trình đào tạo và dự án dành cho người mới để phát triển lên các vị trí chính thức.

Your skills and experience
- Tốt nghiệp Đại học các chuyên ngành: Công nghệ thông tin, Khoa học máy tính, Điện tử viễn thông, Công nghệ phần mềm, Hệ thống thông tin....
- Ưu tiên ứng viên có từ 1,5 năm kinh nghiệm tương đương
- Có kiến thức và kỹ năng về MỘT TRONG NHỮNG nội dung sau:
- Ngôn ngữ lập trình Python, C/C++
- Service/MicroService với một trong các framework FastAPI/Flask/Django
- Tensorflow/Pytorch/DGL/PyG/Onnx
- API (Restful/gRPC), Lập trình an toàn, đảm bảo & tối ưu hiệu năng
- Git và Git Flow, Docker/ Kubernete, Kubeflow/MLFlow, TritonServer/ Tensorflow Serving
- Các dạng bài toán Supervised learning, Reinforcement learning
- Xử lý Ảnh (Computer Vision)/Video/Âm thanh/Ngôn ngữ tự nhiên (NLP)
- CNN/RNN/Transformer/Attention, SVM/KNN/Clustering, GNN vv...
- Kỹ thuật Knowledge Distiller/ Model Prune, Model Quantization

Why you'll love working here
- Trải nghiệm Thu nhập hấp dẫn với gói đãi ngộ toàn diện:
- Thưởng thành tích tháng 13; Thưởng thành tích theo kết quả công việc 06 tháng, 1 năm ; Thưởng các dịp lễ tết trong năm ; Thưởng theo danh hiệu cá nhân và tập thể…
- Du lịch nghỉ dưỡng hàng năm
- Khám sức khỏe định kì
- Gói bảo hiểm sức khỏe cá nhân và người thân (MIC)
- Quà tặng và ngày nghỉ sinh nhật hưởng nguyên lương

- Được trải nghiệm các phương pháp học tập mới và phát triển năng lực theo lộ trình công danh.

- Cơ sở vật chất, không gian làm việc xanh và hiện đại.

title: Application Developer
duties:
Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers. We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs. We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?

Role Summary

As an Application Developer 3 at Keyloop, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable integrations using Boomi's AtomSphere platform. You will work closely with business analysts, solution architects, and cross-functional teams to ensure data flows seamlessly and reliably across systems and processes.

Key Responsibilities
- Collaborate with Business Analysts and Solution Architects to define and refine integration requirements and technical specifications.
- Design and implement end-to-end integration workflows using Boomi, focusing on reliability, scalability, and performance.
- Monitor and maintain existing Boomi processes, troubleshooting and resolving issues as they arise.
- Develop reusable components and templates for consistent integration practices.
- Create comprehensive documentation for integration solutions, including data mappings, error handling, and process flows.
- Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback on design and development approaches.
- Support UAT, deployments, and post-release monitoring for integration-related features.
- Mentor junior developers in integration principles and Boomi best practices.
- Coordinate cross-functional dependencies for data exchange and interface alignment.
- Recommend and implement process improvements and contribute to team standards.

Essential Skills & Qualifications
- 3+ years of hands-on experience with Dell Boomi AtomSphere, including process design, connectors, mapping, and error handling.
- Strong understanding of integration patterns, data transformation, and API design (REST/SOAP).
- Experience working with ERP, CRM, or DMS systems and integrating them via Boomi.
- Familiarity with data formats such as XML, JSON, and flat files.
- Strong debugging and problem-solving skills in an integration context.
- Experience with Boomi deployment management, version control (Git), and CI/CD practices.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across global teams.
- Comfortable working in an Agile/Scrum environment.

Preferred Experience
- Familiarity with FFLib (FinancialForce Library) or equivalent enterprise design patterns in integration-heavy Salesforce environments.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer - KYC Saas
duties:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by over 250 million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

We are looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to join our team responsible for building and maintaining the KYC platform. Join us and play a part in building the future of finance.

Responsibilities

- Implement new user-facing features in Binance’s products
- Write client-side code to create super-fast, easy-to-use, web-based applications which include website for both desktop and mobile browsers, and hybrid in-app pages.
- Optimize web applications to maximize speed and scale.
- Build libraries and frameworks that support complex web applications, speedup development efficiency and improve code quality.
- Work with stakeholders to define and prioritize technical requirements.
- Strong ownership and self-motivation. able to push things happen and get things done independently

Requirements

- 5+ years of production experience with JavaScript, and strong expertise in React.
- Proficient in state-management patterns such as Redux, Flux, or similar, with a solid understanding of their implementation.
- Proven track record of delivering high-quality UI with a focus on user experience and performance.
- Solid understanding of responsive design principles, and experience in developing cross-platform web applications optimized for both desktop and mobile devices.
- Experience with modern frontend technologies and tools like TypeScript, styled system, webpack, and related build tools.
- Familiarity with libraries such as react-query, zod, zustand, or similar tools to improve development efficiency and manage state.
- Expertise in writing unit, integration, and end-to-end tests using frameworks like Jest, Mocha, Cypress, etc., and debugging complex frontend issues with tools like Chrome DevTools.
- Expertise in Git, GitHub/GitLab, and understanding branching strategies (Git Flow, etc.) for large teams.
- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, and demonstrate leadership within the team when necessary.
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering, or equivalent industry experience.

Why Binance

- Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
- Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
- Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
- Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
- Competitive salary and company benefits
- Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)

Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

title: Nhân Viên Lập Trình Nhúng
company: Công ty TNHH Công nghệ Sao Vega
duties:
Mô tả công việc
- Tham gia phát triển phần mềm điều khiển và quản lý oạt động của vệ tinh cỡ nhỏ
- Thiết kế và lập trình phần mềm nhúng cho hệ thống OBC (On-Board Computer)
- Giao tiếp với các cảm biến và module ngoại vi (IMU, GPS, camera, transceiver RF, v.v.)
- Phát triển giao thức liên lạc giữa các module nội bộ (I2C, SPI, UART) và truyền thông mặt đất
- Tối ưu hóa hiệu suất, bộ nhớ, và mức tiêu thụ năng lượng cho phần mềm nhúng
- Viết tài liệu kỹ thuật và hỗ trợ thử nghiệm tích hợp hệ thống (SIT) và kiểm tra môi trường (TVAC, Vibration…)
- Trao đổi chi tiết hơn khi phỏng vấn.

Yêu cầu ứng viên
- Tốt nghiệp Đại học chính quy loại Khá trở lên các chuyên ngành Kỹ thuật như Công nghệ thông tin, Hàng không Vũ trụ, Khoa học máy tính, Toán – tin, Điện tử viễn thông,..
- Trình độ tiếng Anh tương đương tối thiểu 550 điểm Toeic.
- Hiểu về hệ thống nhúng, có kinh nghiệm lập trình C/C++ cho vi điều khiển (ARM, STM32, ATmega, ESP32, v.v.)
- Có khả năng đọc hiểu sơ đồ mạch điện và datasheet thiết bị
- Thành thạo các giao thức truyền thông phổ biến (I2C, SPI, UART,…)
- Có khả năng sử dụng MATLAB/Simulink để mô phỏng và thiết kế thuật toán điều khiển nhúng (control systems, signal processing, code generation)
- Ưu tiên:
- Tiếng Anh có thể làm việc được với chuyên gia nước ngoài
- Có kinh nghiệm làm việc với RTOS hoặc các hệ điều hành nhúng
- Có hiểu biết về hệ thống định thời (watchdog, scheduler, RTC, low-power modes…)
- Biết sử dụng công cụ mô phỏng và kiểm thử phần mềm nhúng
- Kỹ năng debug tốt trên phần cứng thật (oscilloscope, logic analyzer…)Tiếng Anh tốt (có thể trao đổi, tham gia đào tạo, học tập với chuyên gia nước ngoài)

Quyền lợi
- Lương: hấp dẫn, tăng lương theo thâm niên công tác.
- Thu Nhập lên Tới 30 triệu
- Thưởng: có nhiều đợt thưởng trong năm. Thưởng lễ 30-4, thưởng ngày truyền thống, thưởng 6 tháng đầu năm, thưởng ngày thành lập công ty, thưởng Tết Dương, thưởng Tết âm (thưởng năm) và các giải thưởng cá nhân khác: Tiên tiến, xuất sắc, tiềm năng, có cố gắng....
- Hỗ trợ tiền ăn trưa tại căng tin công ty.
- Có chế độ chăm sóc y tế cho nhân viên và gia đình, du lịch 1 năm/1 lần (trong nước hoặc nước ngoài) và tham gia các hoạt động vui chơi giải trí khác (sinh nhật công ty, sinh nhật các thành viên...)
- Có cơ hội được làm việc với đối tác nước ngoài, công tác và đào tạo ở nước ngoài
- Các chế độ BHXH, nghỉ thứ 7, chủ nhật, chế độ phép đầy đủ theo quy định

Địa điểm làm việc
- Hà Nội: Số 37 Phố Thi Sách, Hai Bà Trưng
- Hà Nội: 15 Trần Xuân Soạn, Hai Bà Trưng

title: Business Developer - Project
company: CÔNG TY TNHH BLUM VIỆT NAM
duties:
Job Overview
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Business Developer - Northern Project to lead and grow our project sales in the Northern region of Vietnam. The role focuses on residential and hospitality segments, with the responsibility to establish key business relationships, promote the brand, identify new opportunities, and support project execution.
Chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm một ứng viên năng động và giàu kinh nghiệm cho vị trí Nhân viên Kinh doanh Dự án khu vực miền Bắc, tập trung vào phân khúc nhà ở và khách sạn. Ứng viên sẽ chịu trách nhiệm phát triển kinh doanh, xây dựng mối quan hệ chiến lược, quảng bá thương hiệu, tìm kiếm cơ hội mới và phối hợp thực hiện dự án.

Key Responsibilities / Trách nhiệm chính
- Develop and expand the project sales channels in the Northern region (including residential & hospitality sectors)/Phát triển và mở rộng kênh bán hàng dự án tại khu vực miền Bắc (bao gồm nhà ở và khách sạn).
- Build strong relationships with developers, construction companies, and industry stakeholders through direct visits/Thiết lập và duy trì mạng lưới quan hệ chặt chẽ với các chủ đầu tư, công ty xây dựng và đối tác trong lĩnh vực dự án thông qua việc gặp gỡ trực tiếp.
- Promote brand and product portfolio to architects and interior designers/Quảng bá thương hiệu và danh mục sản phẩm đến các kiến trúc sư, nhà thiết kế nội thất.
- Identify and pursue new project opportunities/Tìm kiếm và phát triển các cơ hội kinh doanh mới.
- Coordinate with internal departments (sales support, technical, logistics) to ensure smooth project execution/Phối hợp với các bộ phận nội bộ (hỗ trợ kinh doanh, kỹ thuật, logistics) để đảm bảo dự án được triển khai hiệu quả.
- Develop long-term strategies for project business growth/Xây dựng chiến lược phát triển dài hạn cho kinh doanh dự án.
- Conduct market research and provide updates on project trends in the residential and hospitality sectors/Nghiên cứu thị trường và cập nhật xu hướng dự án trong lĩnh vực nhà ở và khách sạn ảnh hưởng đến định hướng phát triển của công ty.
- Prepare weekly and monthly reports to the Head of Hanoi Office/Lập báo cáo hàng tuần/hàng tháng cho Trưởng Văn phòng Hà Nội.

Yêu cầu ứng viên
- University degree (preferably in Architecture, Construction, or Technology)/Tốt nghiệp đại học (ưu tiên chuyên ngành Kiến trúc, Xây dựng hoặc Công nghệ).
- At least 5 years of experience in project sales or business development/Tối thiểu 5 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực kinh doanh dự án hoặc phát triển kinh doanh.
- Proven track record and existing network with decision-makers in the project business/Có kinh nghiệm và mạng lưới quan hệ với các nhà ra quyết định trong lĩnh vực dự án.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills in both Vietnamese and English/Kỹ năng giao tiếp và thuyết trình xuất sắc bằng cả tiếng Việt và tiếng Anh.
- Professional, persuasive, and service-oriented personality/Tác phong chuyên nghiệp, thuyết phục và có tinh thần phục vụ khách hàng.
- Self-motivated, eager to learn, and proactive in work/Chủ động, cầu tiến và có tinh thần học hỏi.
- Strong problem-solving and leadership skills are an advantage/Khả năng giải quyết vấn đề và tố chất lãnh đạo là lợi thế.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office and digital tools/Thành thạo các ứng dụng văn phòng và công cụ kỹ thuật số.
- Willingness to travel for business/Sẵn sàng đi công tác khi cần thiết.
- Able to work independently and in team settings/Có khả năng làm việc độc lập cũng như phối hợp nhóm hiệu quả.

Thu nhập
- Thu nhập khi đạt 100% KPI: Thoả thuận
- Thu nhập tính theo tỷ lệ đạt KPI
- Lương cứng: 20 - 30 triệu VND
- Lương cứng không phụ thuộc doanh số

Quyền lợi
- 5-day work week (Saturday & Sunday off)/Làm việc 5 ngày/tuần, nghỉ Thứ Bảy & Chủ Nhật.
- 12 annual leave days/12 ngày nghỉ phép năm theo quy định.
- 4 paid sick leave days per year/4 ngày nghỉ bệnh nguyên lương mỗi năm.
- 13th month salary bonus/Lương tháng 13.
- Full social insurance based on actual salary/Đóng BHXH, BHYT, BHTN trên lương thực tế.
- MIC personal health insurance package/Gói bảo hiểm sức khỏe cá nhân MIC.
- After completing 1- year of service, the company will provide an additional MIC personal health insurance package for the employee's spouse and children/ Sau khi hoàn thành 1 năm làm việc, công ty sẽ mua thêm gói bảo hiểm sức khỏe cá nhân MIC dành cho vợ/chồng và con của nhân viên.
- Annual premium health check/ Gói khám sức khỏe định kỳ cao cấp.
- Annual company trip & monthly team-building activities/Du lịch công ty hằng năm & team building hàng tháng.
- Training & development opportunities/Cơ hội tham gia các khóa đào tạo chuyên môn và kỹ năng.
- Annual performance & salary review / Đánh giá hiệu suất và xét tăng lương hàng năm.
- Professional & friendly work environment/ Môi trường làm việc chuyên nghiệp, thân thiện và gắn kết.
- Holiday bonuses (New Year, Labor Day, National Day)/Thưởng các dịp lễ lớn: Tết Dương lịch, 1/5, 2/9.
- Provide phone and transportation support for customer engagement.
Cung cấp điện thoại và phương tiện hỗ trợ cho việc tiếp xúc khách hàng.

- Hà Nội: Hanoi Rep. office- Trang An complex, No.1 Phùng Chí Kiên, Cầu Giấy, Cầu Giấy

- Enjoy discussions about the stability and scalability of Frontend systems

- Open-minded, honest and have a positive attitude towards people
- Good at communication skills in general and English skills in particular

- Experience in Responsive Web

- Big Plus, you can communicate basically in Korean

duties:
LG CNS is a leading IT service provider, delivering innovative solutions in AI, cloud computing, big data, and smart factory automation. Our Vietnam Build Center is expanding, and we are looking for talented Python Developers to join our growing team.

- Develop, optimize, and maintain scalable Python applications.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and deploy software solutions.
- Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code following best practices.
- Debug and troubleshoot issues to ensure application stability and performance.
- Work with databases, APIs, and third-party libraries to build robust applications.
- Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and Agile development processes.

Your skills and experience:
[Required]
- 3+ years of experience in Python development.
- Bachelor's degree
- Proficiency in Python frameworks such as Fast API
- Experience in working with ORM such as SlqAlchemy, JPA
- Experience working with DB Configuration Management such as Alembic, Flyway
- Experience in debugging in Kubernetes, Docker/Container, Cloud (AWS) environment
- Experience in AWS Cognito/AWS S3/AWS SES/AWS Lambda
- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
- Good communication skills and the ability to work in a team environment.

[Preferred]
- Experience with Resource optimization
- Experience in solving complex problems with Application and Cloud resource
- Experience in Digital Marketing domain

Opportunity
- Attractive salary and bonus will be discussed after going through CV & Interview
- Topik allowance
- Review capacity annually and adjust salary increases according to work performance.
- Health care: Premium health insurance, Annual health check-up
- Young working environment
- Good career development opportunities with interesting and challenging projects.
- English, Korean, technical, soft skills training courses.
- Opportunity to learn special courses from LG CNS, new technology and security.
- Gifts on holidays (April 30th - May 1st, September 2nd, Tet, etc.)
- Outdoor activities with company support: sports clubs, team building, happy hour parties, birthdays, travel, employee and family events, etc.
- Working hours: 8 hours from Monday - Friday (8 hours/day)

- Best remuneration: Periodically review and adjust salary once a year, PI bonus twice a year. Allowances for lunch, transportation, and phone charges. Party with the team once a year. Workshop travel for the whole company once a year. Bonuses/Gifts for holidays, International Labor Day, International Women's Day, etc.
- High-class, modern office: 5-star standard office with modern equipment, large rest and entertainment areas (game area, karaoke room, reading room, cafe counter, snack bar, etc.) Meet all members' needs, especially the office has an airy and beautiful view that is among the most beautiful in Hanoi.
- Top equipment: Each employee is equipped with the latest generation LG Gram laptop and modern large LG screen.
- Best working time: Work 8 hours/day (8:00 ~ 17:00), from Monday to Friday. No pressure to work overtime/weekends!

- Creative environment, valuing individual opinions: With a young and talented team, we always appreciate the creativity and suggestions that members make.
- Opportunities to work/study in Korea and abroad: With customers and projects mostly from abroad, your opportunities for training and onsite abroad will always be open!
- Other: Happy hours every Friday, Team outing monthly, join clubs like football, badminton, etc.

title: Cloud Security Engineer (Remote)
duties:
Resola Inc, a pioneering force in AI solutions for marketing and advertising, is seeking an experienced Cloud Security Engineer to join our innovative team remotely from Vietnam. As a crucial member of Resola's engineering division, you'll be responsible for designing and implementing comprehensive security measures that protect our cloud infrastructure while enabling innovation and growth.

About Us
We are dedicated to empowering organizations to harness the full potential of artificial intelligence responsibly and efficiently. Our diverse team of 75 employees representing 9 nationalities works in a collaborative environment where innovation meets practical business applications.

Responsibilities

- Lead security incident response efforts and conduct thorough post-incident analysis
- Develop and maintain security policies ensuring regulatory compliance
- Collaborate with development teams to implement security best practices
- Conduct regular security assessments and penetration testing
- Manage identity and access control systems
- Research and evaluate new security technologies and solutions

- Continuous learning and knowledge sharing
- Collaborative spirit and excellent communication skills

We Offer

- A flexible and supportive work environment that values work-life balance.
- Opportunities for personal and professional development.
- A dynamic, multicultural team with a passion for building great software.
- Up to 10 days of paid day off.
- Up to 16 days of public holidays per year.
- Performance and salary review every 6 months.
- Opportunity for a bonus every 6 months based on results and outcomes.

DECA is an all-in-one digital marketing platform that helps businesses of all sizes to plan, execute and optimize their online marketing campaigns. title: SQL developer
duties:
Established in 2019, Jaish Global has rapidly evolved into a distinguished solution provider in the cybersecurity space and SI integrator in Digital Transformation using Machine Learning & Artificial Intelligence. Jaish Global Consultancy is an Umbrella company certified by ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 27001. Our unwavering focus on quality and innovative niche technology solutions creates a true edge. Our commitment to excellence has positioned us as a trusted technology-driven organization, safeguarding customer businesses from the ever-evolving landscape of cyber threats and creating business values in customers' enterprise portfolios using our AI tools and services. We never stop pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are always learning, growing, and re-skilling in Technology solutions and process mapping to stay at the forefront of the industry. Our dynamic culture reflects our drive to be the best. We are providing the services to our customers keeping in view to -> Quick response to change and support for enterprise agility aligned with the business strategy -> Organizational transformation, adopting new trends in business and technology -> Organizational change to support Digital Transformation -> Organizational and operating model changes to improve efficiency and effectiveness -> Lower business operation costs Improved business productivity -> Extending the effective reach of the enterprise (e.g., through digital capability)

The Role

Role Overview

We are seeking a skilled and enthusiastic SQL Developer to join our growing data team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining databases and data solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of SQL and database principles, with a proven track record of optimizing database performance and ensuring data integrity.

Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and implement database solutions, including tables, views, stored procedures, and functions.
- Write complex SQL queries to retrieve, manipulate, and analyze data.
- Optimize database performance for speed and efficiency.
- Ensure data quality, accuracy, and consistency.
- Troubleshoot and resolve database issues.
- Collaborate with developers, analysts, and other stakeholders to understand data requirements.
- Create and maintain database documentation.
- Participate in database design and code reviews.
- Stay up-to-date with the latest SQL Server features and database technologies.
- Develop ETL processes to move data between databases.

Ideal Profile

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
- 2-3 years of experience as a SQL Developer.
- Strong proficiency in SQL (e.g., T-SQL, PL/SQL).
- Experience with database management systems such as SQL Server, MySQL, or Oracle.
- Understanding of database design principles and normalization.
- Experience with query optimization and performance tuning.
- Knowledge of data warehousing concepts.
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Preferred Skills

- Knowledge of database administration tasks.
- Familiarity with cloud-based database services (e.g., Azure SQL Database, Amazon RDS, Snowflake).
- Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
- Knowledge of scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell).

What's on Offer?

- Fantastic work culture

title: Trưởng Nhóm Lập Trình
duties:
Mô tả công việc
- Lên giải pháp, danh mục vật tư các thiết bị điện, lập bản vẽ đấu nối điện layout thiết bị, sử dụng phần mềm Eplan và Cad.
- Lập trình PLC, HMI, Lập trình Robot 2-4-6 trục (Mitsubishi, Keyence, Omron, ABB, UR robot ...) và các thiết bị tự động hóa để điều khiển máy móc trong công nghiệp.
- Lập trình điều khiển step motor, servo motor, Inverter và các thiết bị chuyển đổi Analog-Digital, các loại cảm biến và khí nén thủy lực...
- Lập trình truyền thông công nghiệp RS485, RS232, Ethernet TCP/IP, Modbus,...
- Lập trình xử lý ảnh, AI deep learning cho các ứng dụng kiểm tra lỗi sản phẩm, đọc mã vạch QR, Datamatrix, Barcode ... , nhận diện kí tự và tích hợp với robot để định vị trí sản phẩm để robot gắp đặt.
- Setup Camera Vision , lựa chọn camera, lens, đèn phù hợp để thu được hình ảnh tốt nhất và lên cấu hình vision cho từng bài toán.
- Lập trình thiết kế phần mềm máy tính, visual studio C++, C#, SQLServer,...
- Lập trình quản lý hệ thống nhà máy, server truyền thông công nghiệp, lưu trữ truy xuất dữ liệu

- Lập kế hoạch dự án, sắp xếp công việc cho các thành viên trong nhóm, quản lý chặt tiến độ dự án
- Đào tạo kỹ năng khảo sát, hướng dẫn thiết kế, lắp ráp chế tạo máy và xử lý sự cố cho các thành viên
- Giám sát, kiểm tra và chịu trách nhiệm chính về giải pháp 3D, bản vẽ 2D, bản vẽ điện, gia công, báo cáo kế hoạch, các vấn đề kỹ thuật, các vấn đề phát sinh cho từng dự án
- Tính toán đánh giá rủi ro về thiết kế, chế tạo, triển khai cho từng dự án
- Trao đổi công việc với các bộ phận liên quan, đối tác, khách hàng trong quá trình triển khai

Yêu cầu ứng viên
- Có kinh nghiệm trực tiếp thiết kế máy tự động hóa cho các Công ty làm máy hoặc Công ty FDI (ngành điện, điện tử, bán dẫn...), đặc biệt các máy yêu cầu độ chính xác cao (kết hợp robot, thiết bị đo kiểm, lắp ráp...)
- Thành thạo lập trình các dòng PLC Mitsubishi, Keyence. Điều khiển các thiết bị công nghiệp.
- Thành thạo sử dụng Biến tần, Servo và các thiết bị điều khiển động cơ khác.
- Hiểu biết về các loại truyền thông công nghiệp..
- Ưu tiên biết lập trình Vision: Python, C++ trên nền tảng ROS. Các ứng dụng liên quan tới Web-Base, Database, IOT.
- Có kinh nghiệm quản lý nhóm, quản lý chất lượng, tiến độ dự án là một lợi thế.

Quyền lợi
- Mức lương cạnh tranh, phù hợp với năng lực và kinh nghiệm
- Được đóng BHXH, BHYT, BHTN theo quy định của nhà nước
- Thưởng các ngày lễ, Tết và thưởng theo hiệu quả công việc
- Được đào tạo và phát triển kỹ năng chuyên môn
- Môi trường làm việc chuyên nghiệp, năng động và thân thiện
- Cơ hội thăng tiến rõ ràng
- Được tham gia các hoạt động team building, du lịch hàng năm

location: The Grace Tower, District 7, Ho Chi Minh
duties:
Have a good grasp of analytics and want to utilize it for B2B software solutions in e-commerce logistics? Parcel Perform is looking for an amazing team member to support us in data analytics! You have excellent statistics and analytics skills, 3-4 years of experience working with big and complex databases, you’re technically savvy and have a good grasp on query techniques? Are you also interested in e-commerce and like to take on new challenges? Help us drive Parcel Perform’s growth and join our team! We are looking for you! WE NEED YOU ON OUR TEAM! As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for compiling actionable insights from data and assisting sales, marketing, and technology teams to build data-driven processes. We at Parcel Perform will always put the customer first. We want them to get the most out of our data and showcase the endless possibilities of our service. You will be an important inflection point among their logistics data, challenges, and how our insights can support them. Your role will also involve driving initiatives to optimize the operational excellence of the data team. Such complexity can be hard, especially with a focus on good operation practices. But that is ok. We aren’t here for ease anyway. We are here for people who want to up their game.

WHAT YOU SHOULD BRING ALONG! We at Parcel Perform believe in innovation, energy, and resourcefulness for everything we do. We will not stop to deliver an outstanding product that we can be proud of and need you to help us to inform the world. You need to feel the same way about our offering and bring along the following things: - Fluent in SQL to work with large data sets and relational databases to extract insights and optimize query planners; experience with Python a plus.
- Knowledge of statistics and experience using statistical packages for analyzing datasets (e.g., Excel, SPSS, SAS)
- Hand-on experience working with real data for customer insights, business, and market analysis. Work experience with logistics data is a plus.
- Good communication skills, and the ability to translate business requirements into non-technical, lay terms.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.
- Able to work independently as well as with cross-functional teams.
- Open-minded, friendly, and strong willingness to keep learning and pushing yourself to higher and higher levels. WHAT YOU WILL RECEIVE IN RETURN! We at Parcel Perform are dedicated to being a platform for growth for all our team members, regardless of function and location. - The opportunity to work in a fast-growing, super exciting and innovative business that will revolutionize the e-commerce logistics industry. You will be the needle of success on the growth of a global product that will become a key platform behind successful e-commerce logistics worldwide.
- The ability to continuously learn and develop in an international setting with you being a critical driver behind the success of us achieving our mission.
- An environment where everybody never stops growing and focuses on succeeding - we continuously work with you on your strengths and weaknesses across many important dimensions and look at ways for you to address them and further your development
- Your entry ticket into being part of the Parcel Perform journey, where you will work with and alongside people from around the world that share the same passion and dedication.

WHO ARE WE AT PARCEL PERFORM! Parcel Perform (www.parcelperform.com) is a leading e-commerce delivery experience platform, empowering businesses to optimize the entire customer journey from checkout to delivery and returns. By unifying logistics data and providing actionable insights and intelligent automation, including leveraging AI capabilities, Parcel Perform helps businesses enhance customer satisfaction, streamline operations, and drive growth. With a global reach and an extensive carrier network, Parcel Perform is the trusted partner for ambitious e-commerce businesses, marketplaces, and 3PLs worldwide. We’re committed to continuously innovating, using data to optimize every step of the e-commerce delivery.

duties:
At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About The Role

GenAI models are improving very quickly, and one of our goals is to make them capable of addressing specialized questions and achieving complex reasoning skills. If you join the platform as an AI Tutor in Coding, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate on these projects.

Although every project is unique, you might typically:

- Generate prompts that challenge AI
- Define comprehensive scoring criteria to evaluate the accuracy of the AI's answers
- Correct the model's responses based on your domain-specific knowledge

How To Get Started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

Requirements

- You have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Software Development, Computer Science, or other related fields.
- You have at least 3 years of professional experience with Ruby
- Code review experience is a must
- Experience with AI projects is a plus
- Your level of English is advanced (C1) or above
- You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines
- Our freelance role is fully remote so, you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge

Benefits

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?
- Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments
- Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio
- Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (Java/ReactJS)
location: Área metropolitana de Ciudad Ho Chi Minh
duties:
Summary

Join Aperia Solutions, a leader in SaaS solutions for the Payments and Compliance industries. Aperia is a Texas-based fintech and managed consultancy firm that creates custom SaaS applications and other software-based solutions for the payments, banking, and processing industry. Founded in 1999, Aperia offers business intelligence, risk management, compliance, and customer intelligence platforms. With offices in Dallas, Washington DC, and Vietnam, Aperia is a fast-paced, global organization that strives to improve efficiency in compliance, risk, and customer service operations. Aperia's clients include banks, processors, payment facilitators, merchant service providers, independent sales organizations, and government entities. A career at Aperia promises a great challenge, culture, and opportunities to forge your own path.

Job Description

At Aperia, we thrive on innovation and the strength of our dynamic development team. We are currently seeking a Senior Full Stack Developer (Java/ReactJS) with a strong background in Java and J2EE who is passionate about modern technologies, cloud-native architecture, and secure, scalable systems. If you're eager to push boundaries and drive meaningful impact in a fast-paced fintech environment, we want to hear from you.

Core Responsibilities

- Full lifecycle - analysis, design, development, testing and implementation- of new or enhancements to middleware (micro) services
- Maintain middleware modules and services with code quality standards
- Keep applications free of security vulnerabilities in compliance with organization's security policies
- Assist in troubleshooting and resolving production issues. Provide suggestions for preventative steps
- Incorporate suggestions for improvements and enhancements where meaningful
- May assist/lead in developing and maintaining technical documentation and store it in central locations (like Confluence, SharePoint) for accessible to team members.

Technical Skills:

- 8+ years of hands-on experience in Java/J2EE development.
- Expertise in Spring, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Data, and RESTful APIs.
- Working knowledge of RabbitMQ or similar message brokers.
- Proficiency in Oracle PL/SQL.
- Strong unit testing skills with JUnit.
- Exposure to ReactJS on the frontend.
- Experience with build tools like Maven, and artifact repositories like Nexus.
- Familiarity with Postman for API testing and PCF (Pivotal Cloud Foundry).
- Demonstrated experience in addressing security vulnerabilities and managing open-source dependencies.
- Maintain high code quality using tools like SonarQube.
- Version control and CI/CD experience using GitLab.
- Proficient with Atlassian tools including JIRA and Confluence.
- Solid understanding of Linux environments
- Proficiency in English communication is required.

Things that will separate you from the rest:

- Experience with JIRA integration and custom workflows.
- Familiarity with logging and monitoring tools like Splunk.
- Ability to collaborate effectively with onshore and offshore teams.
- Background in the finance or banking industry.
- Strong problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills (written and verbal).

Job Type

- Full-Time

Schedule

- Monday to Friday

Work Location

- The Six8 Building: 24-26 Phan Dinh Giot, Tan Binh District, HCMC
- VDB Tower: 74 Quang Trung, Hai Chau, Danang

Benefits

- Health insurance
- Dental insurance
- Paid time off
- Parental leave
- Childcare assistance

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. An employee may also perform other reasonable related business duties as assigned by their immediate supervisor or management. Principals only.

Recruiters please don't contact this job poster. DO NOT contact us with unsolicited services or offers.

title: Backend DevOps Lead (AWS)
location: Ciudad Ho Chi Minh, Ciudad Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam
duties:
Our client (a fast-growing digital banking group) is seeking a highly skilled and motivated DevOps Lead with a strong background in software development, expertise in AWS Cloud, and a solid understanding of the banking domain. A crucial part of the role is championing and leading infrastructure as code. You will be responsible for implementing tools and processes that enable rapid software development and deployment.

Your mission is to embrace continuous integration/deployment in a delivery pipeline that will perform automated quality checks, deploy cloud infrastructure quickly, and provide operational tooling and metrics that development teams can consume. To succeed, you will have a blend of development experience and operational experience that provides a good understanding of the developers you are working with while balancing critical systems uptime.

Your responsibilities:

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and design scalable and maintainable software solutions
- Build integration solutions for seamless communication between microservices, APIs, and third-party systems
- Contribute to developing continuous delivery, automation frameworks, and pipelines to create an excellent experience for developers and customers
- Optimize database interactions and ensure data integrity across distributed systems
- Develop and enforce best practices for messaging, integration, and data pipeline architectures
- Identify and develop opportunities to improve our processes and tools for automation
- Learn new skills and help foster a continuous delivery and cloud-first mindset

Requirements

- 7+ years of experience in backend development using Python or Java, with 2+ years in a lead role
- Proficient in Apache Kafka, including Kafka Connect, Schema Registry, etc
- Expertise in building and deploying microservice and event-driven architecture, distributed systems, event sourcing, CQRS patterns, etc.
- Experience using AWS foundation services (VPC, ECS, Lambda, RDS, SNS, SQS, Eventbridge, etc..)
- Hands-on experience with tools like Kafka Connectors, Debezium, etc.
- Solid experience with application integration patterns, RESTful APIs, and messaging protocols
- Able to do hands-on, deep-dive details and work closely with team members to troubleshoot and optimize our platform
- Able to design scalability systems as well as multi-country patterns for our platform
- Knowledge of one or more AWS CloudFormation/Terraform/CDK for infrastructure provisioning
- An automation mindset with the ability to develop tooling to improve the efficiency of repeatable tasks, reliability, and performance
- Understanding cloud change management practices with an awareness of compliance and security standards
- Good skills in English and the ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with business partners and technical teams
- Demonstrate good logical thinking and problem-solving skills
- Be curious and have a self-learning attitude

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (Da Nang, Hybrid) (Visa and Relocation Package Provided)
duties:
About Nimble

We solve our client's most difficult business challenges through technology. Our company partners with the most ambitious companies around the world creating long-term impact with the work with do. If you want to grow together, work on challenging products and enjoy using the best tools and practices, Nimble is the right place for you!

Our Core Values

- Extreme Ownership: We treat our clients’ business as ours.
- Bias for Action: Execution is everything. We act swiftly, prioritize decisive moves, and maintain a strong bias for action to deliver results.
- Intensity: We tackle challenges with high energy and focus, delivering results through bold, committed actions.
- Pragmatism: We prioritize practical, straightforward solutions that deliver results, creatively tackling complex challenges with determination.
- Outcome Over Process: We always work toward impactful outcomes, driving results that matter. Processes help us repeat what works, but meaningful outcomes remain our North Star.
- Truth Seeking: We seek truth with intellectual honesty, sharp critical thinking, and fact-driven reasoning.

What You Will Do

- You will be an active member or lead a team of developers in a project squad. We have a wide range of project sizes.
- Decide which technologies are going to be used for front-end, back-end and define the overall architecture.
- Work closely with the Product Owner to make sure the backlog is efficiently planned and occasionally assist in technical discussions with clients. Most of the client interfacing is done by the Product Owner.
- Write clean, composable, and maintainable code as you develop world-class products for our clients.
- Write automated tests to build and maintain the product we build for our clients.
- Do code reviews with your squad members.
- Learn new technologies languages like Ruby, Go, or Elixir, and techniques so that you are able to adapt to the evolving needs of our clients.
- Knowledge sharing through team rituals.
- Collaborate with other team members to define the internal processes and initiatives to help the company accomplish its mission. Our handbook has been written by the whole team.

Job Requirements

- Professional web development with 5+ years of experience. Experience in Ruby, JavaScript, Go or PHP is ideal (at least one of them).
- Comfortable working both on frontend and backend.
- At least basic experience with a modern JavaScript framework like ReactJS/Redux, VueJS or AngularJS.
- Experience in writing automated tests for web applications.
- Enjoy working on challenging solutions and systems.
- Believe that building great applications is not only about delivering code that “works”, but involves thinking about reusability, maintainability, security, and performance.
- A 'Can do attitude' and a product mindset.
- Confidence in communicating in English.

Why You'll Love Working Here

- You’ll feel proud of every product we ship. We care deeply about quality, design, and doing things right—our name stands for excellence.
- You’ll be surrounded by high performers. We’re a tight-knit, ambitious team that pushes each other to grow and thrive.
- We're built differently. We’ve been profitable and bootstrapped since day one—no VC pressures, just smart, sustainable growth.
- We take pride in craftsmanship. Whether it's code, design, or delivery, we hold ourselves to a high bar—because the little things shape the big picture.
- Process with purpose. We follow agile principles not just in theory, but in practice. Our engineers work with clearly defined user stories, estimate using story points, and deliver iteratively in focused 1–2 week sprints.
- Growth is part of the job. Through regular one-on-ones, structured feedback, and a clear leveling framework, we support every team member’s growth—not just in technical skills, but in communication, collaboration, and leadership.
- Learning never stops. Access a vast library of resources like Pluralsight, PragPub, Leanpub, e-books, and more—plus a yearly education allowance to help you level up in any direction you choose.
- We’ve got your back. From day one, you’ll get private medical insurance, social welfare coverage, and a company care fund.
- We support your move. If you're joining us from abroad, we’ll take care of your visa, work permit, and provide a relocation package to help you settle in smoothly.
- Flexibility that fits. We support a hybrid workstyle, giving you the freedom to find the right rhythm between home and office life.
- Work with the right tools. We’ll set you up with a MacBook and a large external monitor so you can work comfortably and efficiently.
- A workspace that works for you with our modern office in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City and Da Nang.
- Stay fueled. Our kitchen is always stocked with drinks and snacks.
- Take the time you need. Enjoy 26 days of paid leave a year (including public holidays), plus a sabbatical month every 3 years.
- Celebrate your journey. From anniversary gifts to yearly company outings and spontaneous team activities, we make time for fun and appreciation.
- ...and more perks to make work feel better.

If you are a passionate web professional looking to make a significant impact in a growing software development company, we would love to hear from you.

Join us in shaping the future with with elevating web innovation!

We keep our recruitment process practical and straightforward.

To learn more about how we work, check our handbook named Compass, Github organization, and Medium account.

Want to see what we have built? Check our Dribbble and Behance accounts.

Want to keep in touch with us? Follow us on Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn.

Nimble is an equal opportunity employer.

- Làm việc trong môi trường theo phương pháp Scrum/Agile.
- Giải quyết vấn đề liên quan đến công nghệ, sản phẩm hoặc quy trình phát triển.
- Sử dụng thành thạo Docker trong môi trường hạ tầng.
- Tiếng Anh giao tiếp thành thạo trong môi trường kinh doanh (bao gồm viết, nhắn tin, họp).

- Front-end: TypeScript, React, Next.js
- Backend: Rust (axum), TypeScript, Node.js (Express, Fastify, NestJS)
- Machine Learning / Thuật toán: Rust, Python, OpenCV, PyTorch, TorchServe, Elasticsearch, Vertex AI
- Hạ tầng: Google Cloud, GKE, Anthos Service Mesh, Istio, Cloudflare, Argo Workflows
- Event Bus: Cloud Pub/Sub
- DevOps: GitHub, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Kustomize, Helm, Terraform, Datadog, MixPanel, Sentry
- Dữ liệu: CloudSQL (PostgreSQL), AlloyDB, BigQuery, dbt, trocco
- API: GraphQL, REST, gRPC
- Xác thực: Auth0
- Công cụ phát triển: GitHub Copilot, Figma, Storybook
- Công cụ giao tiếp: Slack, Discord, JIRA, Miro, Confluence

Phong cách làm việc:
- Hybrid (đến văn phòng ít nhất 1 lần/tuần)
Chế độ nghỉ phép:
- 12 ngày phép/năm
- Nghỉ lễ theo quy định quốc gia

- Các chế độ khác theo Luật Lao Động

- Thưởng tháng 13

- Lương + bảo hiểm đầy đủ trong 2 tháng thử việc
- Bảo hiểm sức khỏe cao cấp

- Các hoạt động nội bộ: year-end party, team building...

- Kinh nghiệm phát triển với ngôn ngữ có hệ thống kiểu tĩnh mạnh như Rust, Scala,...

Sử dụng Java phát triển các service sử dụng REST API (Java Spring Boot) trong hệ thống kiến trúc Microservices

Lập trình frontend cho các dự án phát triển sản phẩm

Tốt nghiệp chuyên ngành Công nghệ thông tin và các chuyên ngành liên quan khác.

Có từ 2 năm kinh nghiệm trở lên lập trình Java Full Stack

Sử dụng thành thạo Git hoặc SVN.

Hiểu biết các Framework: Spring, Hibernate.

Có hiểu biết tốt về Design pattern, OOP, REST API.

Có kinh nghiệm & hiểu biết về xây dựng hệ thống Microservice.

Có tư duy logic tốt, khả năng tự tìm hiểu & giải quyết vấn đề tốt

Có kiến thức về cơ sở dữ liệu quan hệ Mariadb, MySQL.

duties:
The role at a glance

Get to Know the Team

Data Engineers in Grab get to work on one of the largest and fastest growing data lakes of any company in South East Asia. We operate in a challenging, fast paced and ever changing environment that will push you to grow and learn.

Our mission? Provide self-service data ingestion platforms with intuitive interface for all users at Grab and affiliates to ingest any data with business value at configurable freshness SLOs, cost effectively and reliably to data lake with intelligent automations to minimize the ongoing maintenance effort throughout the lifecycle of the pipeline.

Get to Know the Role

You will support the mission of the team by maintaining and extending the platform capabilities through implementation of new features to support new ingestion use cases, automations to reduce the effort and incorporating new technologies to drive efficiency. You will go the extra mile to support platform users to get their job done reliably with minimum effort.

You will work onsite in HCMC and report to the Engineering Manager, who is based in Singapore.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

- Maintain and extend the python backend APIs and automations used by the ingestion platform.
- Maintain and extend the scala spark applications we use for data ingestion.
- Design and Implement improvements to the existing architecture to support new use cases or improve efficiency.
- Follow testing & SRE best practices to ensure the stability of the system.

Skills you need

What Essential Skills You Will Need

- Able to commit to a full-time internship (40 hours per week) in 6 months and work onsite at Grab HCMC office.
- Undergraduate in Software Engineering, Computer Science. We are also happy to hire students from other quantitative fields who are passionate about programming & and have built some cool software applications in the past.
- Proficiency in Python or Scala.
- Familiarity with data pipelines and related technology such as Airflow, Spark, S3, Relational DBs, Kafka, Flink and SQL.
- Experience implementing backend APIs.
- Familiarity with AWS & Terraform.

What we offer

About Grab And Our Workplace

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

- We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
- With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
- Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
- We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
- Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For At Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. As an equal opportunity employer, we consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

Chúng tôi mong muốn tìm kiếm những tài năng nhiệt huyết, sẵn sàng cùng nghiên cứu và quảng bá để khai phá tương lai.

Lập trình viên sẽ đảm nhận toàn bộ quá trình phát triển backend, từ các lightweight server tích hợp trong sản phẩm đến việc liên kết với cloud, bao gồm thiết kế và tối ưu hóa hệ thống, quản lý luồng dữ liệu và tăng cường bảo mật.

Nhiệm vụ chính
• Thiết kế và triển khai kiến trúc server tối ưu cho môi trường AIoT và Embedded.
• Thiết kế, tối ưu hóa database để thu thập, xử lý và lưu trữ dữ liệu.
• Phát triển hệ thống dựa trên multi-thread/multi-process cho xử lý và streaming video thời gian thực.
• Thiết kế, triển khai và tăng cường bảo mật cho server API dựa trên REST API, WebSocket.
• Xây dựng, vận hành và bảo trì server trên môi trường cloud như AWS.
• Tối ưu hóa hiệu suất và lightweight server (tối ưu hóa bộ nhớ/CPU, cải thiện latency).

Yêu cầu ứng viên
Kỹ năng cần thiết
• Kinh nghiệm thiết kế và tối ưu hóa kiến trúc server.
• Hiểu biết về lập trình multi-thread, multi-process.
• Kinh nghiệm thiết kế và vận hành database như MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB.
• Kinh nghiệm phát triển server REST API và WebSocket.
• Kinh nghiệm về tăng cường bảo mật và xử lý xác thực.

Ưu tiên
• Kinh nghiệm phát triển server AIoT, Embedded.
• Kinh nghiệm xây dựng dịch vụ dựa trên nền tảng cloud như AWS.
• Kinh nghiệm phát triển hệ thống xử lý video thời gian thực (Streaming, Encoding, Decoding, v.v.).
• Kinh nghiệm với nhiều ngôn ngữ lập trình khác nhau như C/C++, Python, Node.js.

Quyền lợi
• Lương: Thỏa thuận.
• Tham gia các hoạt động Team Building.
• Hỗ trợ thiết bị laptop khi cần thiết.
• Môi trường làm việc trẻ trung năng động, chuyên nghiệp, kích thích sự sáng tạo.

title: Senior Rust Developer
duties:
About Us
We’re building next-generation decentralized infrastructure to power applications at the edge of connectivity and compute. Our platform enables contributors to share bandwidth, compute, and storage – creating a trust-minimized, permissionless network backbone for the future of the internet.
We’re looking for a Senior Rust Developer with deep understanding of networking concepts and a passion for low-level systems programming. You'll be a core contributor to our protocol stack, working on high-performance services, peer-to-peer systems, and distributed runtime environments.

Location: Remote / Hybrid
Type: Full-time
Experience Level: Senior
Salary: Competitive, with equity options available

What You'll Do
- Architect and implement performant network protocols, proxies, and overlay services in Rust.
- Build P2P systems, NAT traversal techniques (e.g., STUN, TURN, hole punching), and custom messaging layers.
- Contribute to our edge runtime, handling bandwidth-sharing, node discovery, and transport layer logic.
- Develop and maintain safe, efficient async systems using tokio, async-std, or similar frameworks.
- Collaborate with distributed systems engineers, cryptographers, and DevOps on protocol design and deployment strategy.
- Mentor junior developers and participate in architecture reviews and code audits.

Yêu cầu ứng viên
- Strong understanding of networking concepts: TCP/UDP, DNS, TLS, WebRTC, gRPC, NAT, Anycast, etc.
- Experience with asynchronous programming and concurrency patterns in Rust.
- Deep knowledge of systems-level concepts like memory management, multithreading, and I/O performance.
- Experience building distributed or peer-to-peer systems.
- Proficient in debugging, profiling, and performance tuning.

Quyền lợi
- Gross Salary: $1300-$2000
- Paid social insurance premiums, project bonuses, monthly and quarterly bonuses for employees, other benefits, and holiday bonuses.
- Working in a dynamic environment with many interesting projects, developing and applying the latest technologies.
- Fast growing company with many opportunities for growth and advancement
- Supported internal courses/training to improve professional skills.
- Other benefits: periodic team building, annual travel, vacation...
- Many activities: weekly football club, year-round football tournament, table tennis, ...

Bonus Points For
- Experience with VPNs, proxies, or custom overlay networks
- Experience with edge computing, IoT, or embedded systems.
- Understanding of libp2p, QUIC, Noise protocol, or similar stacks.

Why Join Us
- Work on cutting-edge decentralized infrastructure with real-world impact.
- Join a tight-knit, high-caliber team pushing boundaries of distributed tech.
- Token incentives and equity for long-term contributors.

Địa điểm làm việc
- Hồ Chí Minh: 105 Cô Giang, Quận 1

Thời gian làm việc
- Thứ 2 đến thứ 7 cách tuần, 8h30-18h, nghỉ trưa 1h30m

Cách thức ứng tuyển
- Ứng viên nộp hồ sơ trực tuyến bằng cách bấm Ứng tuyển ngay dưới đây.

• Our products are an end-to-end innovative platform and help build multi-agentic AI apps, instantly. • Ability to prioritize tasks and meet project deadlines.

• Ability to read and understand English technical documentation.
• Responsible, proactive, and willing to learn.

• 1–2 years of experience in Software Testing, Quality Assurance (QA).

• Familiarity with using AI tools to support software testing and QA tasks.

duties:
Position: Junior/Middle Software Engineer
Location: Le Van Luong, Thanh Xuan, Hanoi
Salary: Up to USD 2,500 gross/month + 13th-month salary
Work Setup: Hybrid (Work from home every Friday)
Company Type: Global technology company with international presence

About the Role
Join a dynamic team that’s on a mission to help enterprises unlock the full potential of data and AI. Our platform enables both technical and non-technical users to create secure, reusable, and compliant data solutions at scale. Recognized by industry analysts and backed by leading investors, we are rapidly growing and evolving our core product into a modern, AI-powered cloud solution.

We value a high-performing culture built on collaboration, integrity, and continuous learning. Our team is spread globally and united by shared values:
- Aim High
- Customer First
- One Team
- Candid & Caring
- Challenge with Fun

The Opportunity
Our engineering team is driving a major transformation — migrating from a traditional on-premise model to a fully managed multi-cloud SaaS platform. The goal is to serve some of the world’s largest enterprises with a scalable, secure, and intuitive data management experience.

As a Software Engineer, you will contribute to this transformation by building, improving, and scaling our cloud-based enterprise web applications.

Your Responsibilities
- Build a robust and scalable cloud-native web application with self-service capabilities.
- Improve and modernize the architecture of our SaaS platform, enhancing performance, security, and deployment efficiency.
- Collaborate with feature teams to meet enterprise-grade SLAs and security standards.
- Design user-friendly, impactful features that help enterprise clients manage their data more effectively.
- Support the gradual decoupling of monolithic components into microservices for faster, independent delivery.
- Take ownership of the full development cycle — from design to production.

What You’ll Work On
- Design systems that handle high volumes of data across cloud environments and various data sources.
- Contribute to architectural discussions with a focus on scalability, modularity, and quality.
- Write clean, testable, and maintainable code using best practices.
- Deploy and operate your code in modern cloud environments.
- Bring knowledge of multi-tenant architectures, distributed systems, and messaging technologies like RabbitMQ.

Preferred Tech Stack
- Languages & Frameworks: Java, Spring Boot, Kotlin, Python, .NET, GraphQL
- Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Helm, GitLab CI/CD
- Databases: Aurora, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Minio
- Frontend: TypeScript, React/Vue, Apollo, MobX, Nx
- Big Data: Spark, Redshift, Snowflake

Ideal Candidate Profile
- Enjoys solving complex problems and optimizing system performance.
- Has a keen interest in cloud security and SaaS development.
- Open to learning and mentoring within the team.
- Comfortable with end-to-end ownership, including deployment and operational excellence.
- Strong sense of responsibility and proactivity in a collaborative team setting.

Work Equipment
- Laptop provided

Benefits & Perks
- Full salary during probation
- 13th-month salary
- 15 days of paid annual leave
- Full coverage for social and health insurance (maximized)
- Premium healthcare plan
- Company-sponsored English classes
- Access to leading industry conferences
- Online learning (Udemy and more)
- Monthly team dinners

We’re Hitachi Digital Services, a global digital solutions and transformation business with a bold vision of our world’s potential. We’re people-centric and here to power good. Our employees collaborate with teams in Japan, India, Portugal, and the US, servicing customers worldwide and working on a huge variety of projects. The Bridge Software Engineer who will manage projects or work closely with Project Manager to monitor and control the project; and work closely with the team to understand the project’s insights. - Understand the clients and maintain a good business relationship with them.

- Bachelor’s degree with a major in software development, information technology or related fields.

- At least 3 years of working experience in BrSE position, hands-on experience of writing technical document in Japanese, giving presentations, and working directly with Japanese customers.
- Have software development skills (design, coding, test, etc.), and good programming skill/knowledge of Full-stack development (Java, React, Angular, CICD..).
- Have knowledge UI/UX Figma is an advantage.
- Good at requirement analysis, critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
- Well-organized, creative, and capable of performing multiple tasks simultaneously.
- Proficiency in English is a plus.

About Us

location: Thành Pho Ho Chí Minh, Ho Chi Minh-Ville, Viêt Nam
duties:
Location Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

FORVIA HELLA is a listed, international automotive supplier. Coming together with Faurecia in the FORVIA Group, we build the world's seventh largest supplier of automotive technologies. As a global market leader in high-growth areas, FORVIA employs 157,000 people worldwide. FORVIA HELLA therein stands for high-performance lighting technology and automotive electronics. At the same time, we cover a broad service and product portfolio for the spare parts and workshop business as well as for manufacturers of special vehicles with our Business Group Lifecycle Solutions. With around 37,500 employees at over 125 locations, the Company is active worldwide and generated adjusted sales of € 8.1 billion on a preliminary basis in the fiscal year 2023.

YOUR TASKS

In the business division Electronics, you will be working with the software development team for electronics control units.

▪ Design, develop & test product-specific software of automotive electronics module & system over the entire product development cycle;

▪ Apply model-based development on a distributed embedded system;

▪ Work on SW-architecture, write, test and debug code according to software requirement specification and the defined process;

▪ Discuss with customer about specific solution for electronics modules & system, including function implementation and system interface;

▪ Complete software module test report and integration test report according to test result;

▪ Primarily responsible of software modules of HELLA products;

▪ Other job assigned by Department Manager.

Your Qualifications

▪ Minimum bachelor degree in computer science, engineering, or related field.

▪ 2-5 years experience in Embedded System.

▪ Embedded development tool especially Rhapsody, Polyspace, WindIdea, Davinci, DOORs, PTC…

▪ Be proficient with C programming language, firmware, bare-metal programming.

▪ Be familiar with embedded microcontroller 16-/32-bit microprocessor is a plus.

▪ Write and review Software specifications, Architecture and Design documents for the system.

▪ Experience with simulation and development tools, e.g. Vector CANoe, etc

▪ Real Time Operating System OSEK Programming Experience Preferred

▪ Knowledge on Communication & Diagnostic protocols: CAN, LIN, Ethernet and TCP/IP protocols and UDS.

Required Skills

▪ Knowledge and skills related to AUTOSAR, CAN, MEM, UDS, RTOS.

▪ Experienced with Flash Bootloader

▪ Good communication in English and presentation skills.

▪ Familiarity with Agile methodology is an advantage.

Even if you do not meet all our requirements, do not hesitate to apply to us, because the further development of our employees is very important to us and opens up a wide range of opportunities for you in our company.

FORVIA HELLA stands for the variety of all employees. Inclusion and diversity are firmly anchored in our company culture. We are continuously looking for new team players and welcome applications from all interested parties, regardless of their ethical and social background, age, religion, gender, disability, sexual orientation or identity.

Please send us your application via our career portal, stating your salary requirements and earliest possible starting date, with the reference number req16448.

HELLA Vietnam Co., Ltd.

Salary: open to negotiation

OVERVIEW
Join our company, a leader in SaaS solutions for the Payments and Compliance industries. The company is a Texas-based fintech and managed consultancy firm that creates custom SaaS applications and other software-based solutions for the payments, banking, and processing industry. Founded in 1999, the company offers business intelligence, risk management, compliance, and customer intelligence platforms. With offices in Dallas, Washington DC, and Vietnam, the company is a fast-paced, global organization that strives to improve efficiency in compliance, risk, and customer service operations. The company’s clients include banks, processors, payment facilitators, merchant service providers, independent sales organizations, and government entities. A career at the company promises a great challenge, culture, and opportunities to forge your own path.

DESCRIPTION
We are looking for a talented and motivated Full Stack Developer (.NET ReactJS) to join our dynamic team. As a Full Stack Developer, you will work on developing and maintaining web applications using .NET, SQL Server, and React. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions that meet our clients' needs.

Core Responsibilities:
1. Develop and maintain web applications using .NET, React, and SQL Server.
2. Ensure the quality and performance of applications through testing and code reviews.
3. Follow best practices for software development, including coding standards, code reviews, and version control using Azure DevOps.
4. Work within the SAFe Agile framework to deliver projects on time and within scope.

Functional Responsibilities:
1. Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, coding, testing, and deployment.
2. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features.
3. Assist in continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes using Azure DevOps.

JOB REQUIREMENTS
Technical Skills:
1. Excellent English communication (preferable IELTS 7.5).
2. Proficiency in .NET, React, and SQL Server (at least 3+ years in both .NET and React).
3. Strong understanding of web development principles and best practices.
4. Experience with Azure DevOps for version control and CI/CD processes.
5. Familiarity with the SAFe Agile methodology.
6. Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Things that will separate you from the rest:
1. Experience with Node.js.
2. Experience with other front-end frameworks/libraries such as Vue.js and Angular.
3. Knowledge of cloud services and infrastructure, especially Azure.
4. Experience with RESTful API design and development.
5. Understanding microservices and event driven architecture.

Education or Certifications:
1. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

INTERVIEW PROCESS
1. HackerRank test tại nhà
2. Phỏng vấn technical bằng tiếng Anh với Managers tại văn phòng
3. Phỏng vấn online với PGĐ + Country Manager

Responsibilities

1. Xây dựng, triển khai:
- Xây dựng, vận hành các components trong MLOps platform / Develop and operate components within the MLOps platform.
- Phối hợp cùng data scientist để xây dựng, vận hành Feature Store / Partner with data scientists to build and operate Feature Store.
- Phối hợp cùng các đơn vị liên quan để thực hiện phát triển dữ liệu mới cho trung tâm AIC, phục vụ phát triển use-case mới / Collaborate with relevant units to develop/acquire new data sources for AIC to facilitate developing new use-case.
- Hỗ trợ thực hiện kiểm định mô hình / Support the validation of machine learning models.
- Hỗ trợ xây dựng kiến trúc triển khai cho use-case. Tận dụng Cloud Services và nền tảng dữ liệu lớn để tái cấu trúc và tối ưu hóa code trong môi trường tích hợp / Develop deployment architecture for machine learning model, leverage on premise and cloud based big data platforms to refactor and optimize code for production.
- Xây dựng các pipelines phục vụ tự động hóa đóng gói và triển khai mô hình / Automate data and machine learning engineering processes.
- Theo dõi chất lượng mô hình sau triển khai; hỗ trợ cải thiện chất lượng mô hình / Monitor model quality post-deployment; support initiatives to improve model quality.

2. Nghiên cứu và học hỏi các kỹ thuật phân tích nâng cao mới
- Nghiên cứu các phương pháp hiện đại trong học máy/AI (machine learning/AI) / Conduct research on modern methods for machine learning/AI and engineering.
- Chủ động phân tích và khai thác các nguồn dữ liệu hiện có/mới để hỗ trợ các phân tích mang lại hiệu quả/tác động cao hơn / Proactively analyze and utilize existing/new data sources to support more impactful analyses.

3. Phối hợp với các Đơn vị trong VPBtrong các bài toán phân tích nâng cao
- Phối hợp với các trung tâm/phòng ban khác trong EDA cũng như các Đơn vị K để hiểu rõ nghiệp vụ, từ đó hỗ trợ họ khai thác/ứng dụng học máy hiệu quả hơn / Working with other centers/departments in EDA as well as Business Units to understand business problems to support them in better utilizing machine learning.
- Hỗ trợ các trung tâm/phòng ban khác trong việc cung cấp/thực hiện các phân tích dự đoán và mô tả khi cần thiết / Support other centers/departments in providing predictive and prescriptive analyses when needed.

4. Đào tạo
- Đào tạo các thành viên khác trong nhóm EDA về học máy / Training other EDA team members on machine learning.

Qualifications

1. Trình độ Học vấn
- Đại học hoặc cao hơn chuyên nghành toán, thống kê, kinh tế, ngân hàng hoặc các chuyên nghành phân tích dữ liệu / Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science or other Quantitative discipline.

2. Kiến thức/ Chuyên môn Có Liên Quan
- Thành thạo với SQL và chuyển đổi dữ liệu / Familiar with SQL and experience with data transformation.
- Thành thạo ngôn ngữ phân tích dữ liệu Python hoặc R / Strong proficiency in at least one programming language Python/R.

title: Junior Game Developer
duties:
Join The Game!
Leader in the development and publishing of multiplatform games, Gameloft® has established itself as a pioneer in the industry, creating innovative gaming experiences for 25 years. Gameloft creates games for all digital platforms, from mobile to cross-platform titles for PC and consoles. Gameloft operates its own established franchises such as Asphalt®, Dragon Mania Legends, March of Empires, and Dungeon Hunter, and also partners with major rights holders including LEGO®, Universal, Illumination, Hasbro®, Fox Digital Entertainment, Lamborghini®, and Ferrari®. Gameloft distributes its games in over 100 countries and employs 3,000 people worldwide. Every month, 1 billion unique users can be reached by advertisers in Gameloft games with Gameloft for brands, a leading B2B offering dedicated to brands and agencies. Gameloft is a Vivendi company.
Job Description:
- Develop, implement, and maintain game features using Game Engines (Unity, Roblox, Cocos Creator, Unreal).
- Deliver and ensure high-quality game features.
- Write efficient, clean, and reusable code to enhance gameplay and user experience.
- Collaborate with game designers, artists and other team members to bring game concepts to life.
- Analyzing existing features of the game and making changes to meet current needs.
Qualifications:
- Proficiency in C#, Lua, JavaScript, Unity, Roblox.
- Familiarity with AI (Copilot) is a plus.
- Familiarity with mobile 2D/3D game development.
- Good understanding of gameplay mechanics, UI, design patterns.
- Familiarity with version control systems like Git.
- Familiarity with VR/AR development, mobile optimization, CI/CD is a plus.
- Ability to read, write, and communicate in English.
- Good problem-solving mindset and communication skills.

Additional Information
Recruitment Process:
1) Screening call;
2) Test;
3) Interview(s);
4) Offer.

Work Location and Hours:
- Work location 26 Ung Van Khiem, Binh Thanh District, Ho Chi Minh City.
- Work hours 0830 AM - 0600 PM, Monday - Friday.

Why Join Gameloft?
- You want to work in an exceptional industry and create games downloaded more than 1 billion times per year.
- You want to be part of a talented and supportive team of pioneers who have a passion for creating video games.
- You want to contribute to a vibrant and dynamic atmosphere.
- You want to join a global company and meet great people around the world.
- You will work on an employment contract with competitive remuneration and benefits package.
- You are looking for a fun place to work in the heart of the city.

What We Offer:
- A hybrid working model (3 days WFO and 2 days WFH).
- A dynamic workplace environment, with over 18 nationalities, where hundreds of world-renowned game titles were born.
- A range of well-being events and policies to support employees physically, mentally, and emotionally.
- An open-space office, a cafeteria, a terrace and a Gaming Area.
- Various training packages, including internal training, sponsorship training, and e-learning (iLearn, Udemy,...).
- Opportunities to collaborate and train with Gameloft worldwide experts and develop yourselves.
- An attractive monthly salary alongside Tet and other performance bonuses.
- Minimum 12 days of paid annual leave, plus 5 days of paid sick leave, Christmas leave, Birthday leave,...
- 100% coverage of mandatory insurance and extra healthcare insurance.
- A monthly allowance to support lunch meals and working-from-home electricity and Internet bills.
- Other benefits from one of the best employers in Vietnam.

What's more?
- Want to know more? Visit our websites:

- LinkedIn page
- Facebook page
