skills: Python; Java; AWS; GCP; Azure; Docker; Kubernetes; Terraform; PostgreSQL; MySQL; MongoDB; Kafka
duties:
Join us in revolutionizing how businesses interact with data! We're building a cutting-edge platform that augments Business Intelligence with Agentic AI at a $400M/year revenue Vireo from our AI tech hub in Vietnam. Imagine a chat interface that doesn't just fetch data, but allows users to interact with structured information intuitively, receive deep-dive analyses, and get actionable business suggestions – all powered by intelligent agents. Our ultimate vision is to replace traditional Data Analysis and BI with a smarter, more proactive AI-driven solution. If you're passionate about building the future of data analytics, this is your opportunity.

Key Responsibilities

- Architect and Scale Core Systems: Lead the design, implementation, and optimization of highly scalable, fault-tolerant backend services and non-blocking APIs using Python (FastAPI) or Java (Vert.x, Quarkus). Ensure services handle high throughput with minimal latency.
- End-to-End Product Delivery: Drive the full lifecycle of product features—from requirements gathering and prototyping through testing, deployment, and iteration—working closely with product managers, UX designers, and DevOps.
- Champion Asynchronous Patterns: Build and maintain event-driven, asynchronous processing pipelines (e.g., message queues, pub/sub) to support real-time data ingestion, processing, and integrations.
- Performance & Reliability: Establish and enforce best practices for monitoring, observability, and automated testing. Identify bottlenecks and implement caching, connection pooling, backpressure, and rate-limiting strategies to sustain 99.9%+ uptime.
- Comprehensive Service Monitoring: Design, deploy, and maintain end-to-end observability solutions using Prometheus for metrics collection and Grafana for visualization and alerting.
- AI & RAG Applications: Architect Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions and intelligent agents that solve real-world problems—integrating vector stores, LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI), and custom prompting frameworks.
- Mentorship & Collaboration: Provide technical leadership and mentorship to mid-level engineers, foster a culture of code quality, and collaborate across cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

- 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and operating production-grade, scalable applications.
- Expertise in Python & FastAPI or Java (Vert.x, Quarkus): Deep familiarity with asynchronous programming (async/await in Python or non-blocking event loops in Java), concurrency models, and profiling/tuning of services.
- API Design Mastery: Hands-on experience building RESTful, GraphQL, or gRPC APIs that support high request volumes; strong understanding of HTTP/2, WebSockets, and protocol optimizations.
- Cloud & Infrastructure: Proficient with AWS, GCP, or Azure; containerization with Docker; orchestration using Kubernetes/Helm; Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
- Data Storage & Caching: Solid background in relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis, DynamoDB) databases; designing data schemas for performance and scalability.
- Asynchronous Ecosystems: Experience with message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS), task queues (Celery, AWS Lambda) or Java equivalents, and stream-processing frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications

- RAG & Agent Development: Practical experience implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines, vector search (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate), and building autonomous agents with LangChain or similar frameworks.
- AI/ML Collaboration: Familiarity with embedding-based search, prompt engineering, chaining, and orchestration of multi-LLM workflows.
- Observability & Security: Strong grasp of logging, tracing (OpenTelemetry), metrics (Prometheus/Grafana), and security best practices (OAuth2, JWT, encryption).
- Leadership & Communication: Excellent verbal and written English skills; demonstrated ability to influence technical direction and collaborate effectively across teams.

title: 100523 - Senior Software Engineer I
location: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
duties:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

Digital Evidence Management Systems are key to officer efficiency and Axon’s mobile applications, View and Capture, play critical roles in evidence acquisition. Axon View interacts with body-worn cameras to display live camera streams, or to view and tag previously-collected evidence. Axon Capture collects digital evidence (photos, videos, audio) and uploads to evidence.com for later processing.

As a senior mobile developer on our team, you will be a key part of our next generation of mobile applications. You’ll ensure our codebases interact with platform SDKs related to photos, videos, audio, file management, networking, WiFi and bluetooth. You’ll write code that interacts with custom-made devices, such as Axon Body-Worn Cameras. You’ll ensure our codebase is performant and meets the highest data privacy standards.

You are a Senior Mobile App Developer

You’ve created mobile applications for years. You know the platform inside and out and you remember how it has changed over the years. You’re familiar with key frameworks and technologies important to our applications (Networking, Bluetooth, WiFi, Photo, Video).

You drive engineering efforts to completion. You evaluate, plan, estimate, communicate and collaborate. You ramp up quickly, solve problems and resolve ambiguity. You are ready to candidly and respectfully share your wisdom and knowledge for the betterment of our team, our code and our product.

Your Day-to-Day

Design, implement and maintain features within Axon View, Axon Capture, and related shared libraries.
Participate in Scrum ceremonies.
Collaborate within the Scrum team to ensure we hit our sprint goals, collaborate with other groups to ensure we build and ship the “right” thing.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelors in Computer Science
5+ years shipping high-quality iOS applications
Strongly competent in Swift
Strong track record of delivering solid code on a schedule
Experience that demonstrates learning & application of the latest native technology: Swift UI, Swift Package Manager, iOS 16 & WWDC releases
Excellent communication
United States Citizenship

Preferred Qualifications

SDKs: experience related to Bluetooth, WiFi, Networking, Camera (Photo/Video), Audio, File Management, connecting to and interacting with third party hardware, UI
CI/CD: experience creating and managing automation and integration
Toolchain: Cocoapods, Swift Package Manager
Objective-C, and Swift / Objective-C compatibility

Nice-to-have

Monitoring & Alerting experience

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

duties:
Mô tả công việc
• Tham gia thiết kế và triển khai các ứng dụng hiệu năng cao bằng Microservice phục vụ cho các nhu cầu kinh doanh của Ngân hàng như: khách hàng, tài khoản, vay vốn, tiết kiệm, chuyển tiền, thanh toán hóa đơn, ví điện tử, gửi tin nhắn...

• Làm việc onsite tại bank.

Yêu cầu ứng viên
Kiến thức:
- Tốt nghiệp Đại học trở lên chuyên ngành CNTT hoặc các ngành tương đương hoặc có các chứng chỉ tương đương được công nhận bởi các tổ chức uy tín
Kinh nghiệm:
- 2 năm kinh nghiệm làm việc thực tế tại các tổ chức CNTT
- Nắm rõ quy trình xây dựng và triển khai phần mềm
- Sử dụng thành thạo Java core, có kinh nghiệm phát triển trên framework Spring Boot.
- Có hiểu biết về cơ sở dữ liệu: SQL, noSQL
- Có hiểu biết về việc sử dụng các công cụ quản trị như: Jija, Git,...
Ưu tiên:
- Ưu tiên kinh nghiệm làm việc trong lĩnh vực tài chính / ngân hàng
- Ưu tiên ứng viên có kinh nghiệm về phát triển ứng dụng theo dạng Cloud Native như: Microservice, CICD, DepOps, Containerization...
- Ưu tiên Nhân sự đã từng tham gia triển khai các dự án theo mô hình Agile/Scrum
- Ưu tiên nhân sự có kinh nghiệm về xử lý bất đồng bộ, xử lý đa nhiệm, event sourcing, có kinh nghiệm về các hệ thống Message Queue (Kafka, RabbitMQ), có hiểu biết về xử lý cache, job.
Ngoại ngữ:
- Có khả năng đọc viết tiếng Anh (cơ bản) nghe nói (nếu có thể).

- Kỹ năng giao tiếp và làm việc nhóm tốt
- Sẵn sàng làm việc ngoài giờ hành chính
- Tinh thần trách nhiệm, ham học hỏi

• Thu nhập hấp dẫn, cạnh tranh.
• Được hưởng chế độ BHXH, BHYT, BHTN.
• Được tham gia các chương trình đào tạo, huấn luyện của Công ty.
• Môi trường làm việc chuyên nghiệp, thân thiện, năng động.

title: Lập Trình Viên C++
duties:
Là một Công ty hoạt động trong lĩnh vực Y tế số, chúng tôi coi nhân sự là trung tâm của mọi hành động. Ominext đang nỗ lực xây dựng một môi trường sống hạnh phúc, chú trọng tới phát triển chuyên môn và chăm sóc sức khỏe cho từng Cán bộ nhân viên, người thân của họ! Gia nhập Ominext ngay hôm nay để tận hưởng các ưu đãi đặc quyền dành riêng cho người Omi.

Với vai trò là Lập trình viên C++, ứng viên sẽ thực hiện các công việc:
- Cùng team dự án tìm hiểu phân tích yêu cầu, nghiên cứu công nghệ và review source code những sản phẩm trên nền tảng công nghệ C++.
- Phát triển và bảo trì ứng dụng sử dụng C++ Builder.
- Thiết kế giao diện người dùng cho ứng dụng.
- Tối ưu hóa mã nguồn để đảm bảo hiệu suất tốt nhất.
- Thực hiện kiểm tra và gỡ lỗi (debug) ứng dụng.

Yêu cầu ứng viên:
- Tốt nghiệp Cao đẳng/Đại học chuyên ngành Công nghệ thông tin hoặc chuyên ngành liên quan.
- Có tối thiểu 2 năm kinh nghiệm làm việc với C++
- Thành thạo lập trình hướng đối tượng (OOP) và các nguyên lý thiết kế phần mềm.
- Ưu tiên ứng viên có kinh nghiệm lập trình với C++ và C++ Builder hoặc tương đương (ví dụ như WinForm, Java Swing, ...)
- Có kinh nghiệm làm việc với SQL Server, MySQL, ...
- Ưu tiên ứng viên có kinh nghiệm làm việc với VCL
- Kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết vấn đề tốt.
- Khả năng làm việc độc lập và theo nhóm.
- Có khả năng gỡ lỗi (debug).

Quyền lợi:
- Môi trường làm việc lý tưởng, được tôn trọng:
- Được làm việc trong một môi trường đạt được tiêu chuẩn cao về sự hài lòng của nhân viên.
- Thời gian làm việc thoải mái: Thứ 2 – Thứ 6, flexible check in (Linh hoạt 8h/ngày, check in tiêu chuẩn 8h-8h45).
- Chính sách làm việc remote linh hoạt 2 ngày/tháng. Áp dụng ngay từ thời gian thử việc.
- Chính sách đăng ký OT linh hoạt: OT remote và OT offline.
- Chính sách Your times: nghỉ có hưởng lương lên tới 12 ngày trong năm và các ngày nghỉ lễ theo luật Lao động.
- Văn phòng làm việc với không gian mở, khu pantry miễn phí đồ uống.)
- No Dresscode: trang phục đi làm lịch sự, thoải mái, tôn trọng cá nhân.
- Tập trung hỗ trợ sự phát triển cá nhân:
- Mentor 1-1, sát sao tận tình.
- Được tư vấn, đồng hành và hỗ trợ phát triển sự nghiệp cùng với hệ thống career path (phát triển theo hướng chuyên gia hoặc hướng quản lý) đã được nghiên cứu, thử nghiệm trong nhiều năm.
- Tham gia khóa học tiếng Nhật, tiếng Anh miễn phí.
- Cơ hội tham gia nhiều dự án đa dạng, team size từ 10MM - 150MM.
- Quy trình phát triển phần mềm chặt chẽ, theo các mô hình: Agile, Scrum, Waterfall.
- Cơ hội thăng tiến lên các vị trí quản lý như: Team Leader, Techlead,...
- Quan tâm đặc biệt tới nhân viên:
- Mức lương: Hấp dẫn, cạnh tranh với thị trường.
- Thưởng hiệu quả sản xuất kinh doanh 2 lần/năm. Thưởng nóng, thưởng lễ tết, lương tháng 13.
- Xét tăng lương/thăng chức 2 lần/năm.
- Trợ cấp tiếng Nhật 12 tháng liên tục lên tới 5.000.000 VNĐ/ tháng.
- Hỗ trợ 100% chi phí thi chứng chỉ CNTT theo chính sách công ty.
- Chế độ chăm sóc phụ nữ: nghỉ có hưởng lương 1h/ngày nghỉ sau sinh cho nhân viên nữ có con dưới 12 tháng.
- Bảo hiểm chăm sóc sức khỏe cao cấp miễn phí dành riêng cho Omizen Care.
- Tủ thuốc miễn phí chăm sóc sức khỏe cá nhân tại Văn phòng làm việc.
- Khám sức khỏe thường niên tại phòng khám, bệnh viện hàng đầu Việt Nam cùng các chế độ BHXH theo quy định của nhà nước.
- Được tham gia các CLB để nâng cao sức khỏe, tinh thần: CLB bóng đá, CLB cầu lông, CLB bóng bàn,...
- Du lịch thường niên, hoạt động team building hàng quý/năm.

Địa điểm làm việc: Tòa nhà 6th Element, khu đô thị Tây Hồ Tây, quận Tây Hồ, Hà Nội

Thời gian làm việc: Thứ 2 - Thứ 6 (từ 08:00 đến 17:15)
Cách thức ứng tuyển: Ứng viên nộp hồ sơ trực tuyến bằng cách bấm Ứng tuyển ngay dưới đây.

title: Senior/Lead Backend Engineer (Golang)
location: 3rd Floor, Rivera Park Building, 7/28 Thanh Thai, District 10, Ho Chi Minh
skills: React; Kafka; Docker; GCP; AWS; SQL; MySQL; PostgreSQL; Spark
duties:
About GHN

"Giao Hàng Nhanh (GHN) is one of Vietnam’s leading logistics companies, proudly delivering exceptional services with the commitment: “Smarter, Faster, More Cost-Effective.” GHN empowers millions of businesses to optimize their operations while creating thousands of jobs for the Vietnamese workforce.

Founded with the mission to revolutionize the logistics industry and guided by a technology-driven vision, GHN continuously integrates advanced technological solutions into every delivery. This enables streamlined operations, enhanced delivery performance, and a fast, safe, and efficient customer experience - serving a wide range of clients including E-commerce platforms, retailers, and individual consumers.

With a nationwide network spanning all 63 provinces and cities, a forward-thinking innovation strategy, and robust logistics infrastructure, GHN continues to affirm its position as a pioneer in Vietnam’s rapidly growing E-commerce and logistics sector."

As a Senior/Lead Backend Engineer at GHN, you will play a critical role in designing and developing scalable backend systems that power Vietnam's leading logistics platform. You’ll work on high-impact projects that optimize core operations—from pickup to delivery—while driving technical excellence, system reliability, and innovation across teams.

Responsibilities

Design & Develop Logistics Solutions: Build and enhance scalable backend systems that power core logistics operations, including first-mile pickup, last-mile delivery, warehousing, sorting, and freight transportation.

API Development: Design and implement robust, secure, and well-documented open APIs to support seamless integration with internal systems and external partners, enabling a more connected logistics ecosystem.

Performance & Reliability: Continuously monitor and improve system performance. Proactively troubleshoot and resolve production issues, conduct root cause analysis, and contribute to system refactoring efforts to enhance reliability, maintainability, and scalability.

Code Quality & Best Practices: Write clean, modular, and testable code that adheres to engineering best practices. Actively participate in code reviews, knowledge sharing, and documentation to maintain high standards across the codebase.

Agile Collaboration: Work in a fast-paced Agile environment, collaborating closely with product managers, frontend developers, QA engineers, DevOps, and other stakeholders to deliver high-impact features and improvements.

Your skills and experience

Requirement:

Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent.
At least 4+ years of experience in full lifecycle project development using Golang.
Extensive experience in software design, architecture, development integration.
Solid knowledge of event processing models, parallel programming, multi-threading, enterprise integration pattern, Socket, Web Service, and REST.
Proficient in relational databases, and familiar with at least one NoSQL DB.
Distributed Caching such as Redis.
Familiar with Microservices, event-driven architecture.
Good cross-team communication skills.

The following skills would be nice to have:

Experience creating React-based UIs.
Experience with big-data technologies such as Apache Kafka, and OLAP.
Knowing how to work with Docker, K8S or cloud services, e.g GCP, AWS... is a big plus.

Backend Developer:

Requirement:

Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent.
2+ years of experience with full lifecycle of project development using Golang.
Good knowledge of event processing models, parallel programming, multi-threading, enterprise integration pattern, Socket, Web Service, and REST.
Familiar with at least one SQL DB such as MySQL, PostgreSQL.
Experience with distributed caching technologies such as Redis.
Familiar with Microservices, event-driven architecture.
Good cross-team communication skill.

The following skills would be nice to have:

Experience with big-data technologies such as Spark, Airflow.
Knowing how to work with Docker, K8S or cloud services, e.g GCP, AWS... is a big plus.

Why you'll love working here

13th-month salary, performance bonuses, and KPI bonuses.
Health insurance, Social insurance, and Unemployment insurance.
Medical insurance.
Annual health checkup.
Annual salary reviews.
Annual team building/company trip.
Ongoing internal and external training opportunities.

duties:

- Thiết kế/lập trình các module, thiết kế giao tiếp cho hệ thống tải lớn hàng trăm triệu người dùng (sử dụng cả Java).

- Stringee là công ty công nghệ cung cấp nền tảng quản trị doanh nghiệp hợp nhất – Cogover, giúp số hóa toàn diện hoạt động quản trị và vận hành doanh nghiệp. Cogover ứng dụng công nghệ No-code/Low-code và AI, cho phép doanh nghiệp tự xây dựng và tùy chỉnh hệ thống qua thao tác kéo - thả và cấu hình đơn giản, mà không cần lập trình.
- Hiện tại, Stringee cung cấp 3 bộ sản phẩm chính:
- Quản trị khách hàng: CRM, Service, CDP
- Quản trị nội bộ: HRM, Recruit, Marketing, Process, Site, Finance
- Số hóa giao tiếp: Communication APIs
- Với hơn 3,000 doanh nghiệp sử dụng, 70 triệu người dùng cuối, và nhiều khách hàng lớn như Viettel, Mobifone, VNDIRECT, Techcombank, TPBank,... Stringee là một trong những nền tảng số Make in Vietnam tiên phong trong chuyển đổi số.
- Stringee từng đạt giải Nhân tài Đất Việt 2018, Top 10 Sao Khuê 2023, và được Bộ TT&TT công nhận là Nền tảng số xuất sắc Make in Vietnam.

- Thành thạo Java.
- Nắm rất vững lập trình hướng đối tượng, Design Pattern.
- Có kinh nghiệm về unit test và integration test.
- Hiểu về lập trình đa luồng, non-blocking IO, xử lý bất đồng bộ,...
- Đã từng làm việc với Socket, TCP/IP, các thư viện như SpringBoot, Netty, Apache MINA là lợi thế.
- Đã từng làm việc với RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, Kafka, Docker, K8S,... là lợi thế.
- Có khả năng làm việc với Linux.

Quyền lợi
- Lương từ 1000 - 2500 USD (phụ thuộc vào năng lực và kinh nghiệm của bạn, chúng tôi không bao giờ đãi ngộ thấp hơn khả năng của bạn).

- Môi trường chuyên nghiệp với các đối tác nước ngoài.
- Đóng bảo hiểm và các chế độ khác theo Luật lao động; khám sức khoẻ định kỳ hàng năm.

Aperia is a Texas-based fintech and managed consultancy firm that creates custom SaaS applications and other software-based solutions for the payments, banking, and processing industry. Founded in 1999, Aperia offers business intelligence, risk management, compliance, and customer intelligence platforms. With offices in Dallas, Washington DC, and Vietnam, Aperia is a fast-paced, global organization that strives to improve efficiency in compliance, risk, and customer service operations. Aperia's clients include banks, processors, payment facilitators, merchant service providers, independent sales organizations, and government entities. A career at Aperia promises a great challenge, culture, and opportunities to forge your own path.

We are looking for a talented and motivated Full Stack Developer (.NET ReactJS) to join our dynamic team. As a Full Stack Developer, you will work on developing and maintaining web applications using .NET, SQL Server, and React. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions that meet our clients' needs.

Core Responsibilities
Develop and maintain web applications using .NET, React, and SQL Server.
Ensure the quality and performance of applications through testing and code reviews.
Follow best practices for software development, including coding standards, code reviews, and version control using Azure DevOps.
Work within the SAFe Agile framework to deliver projects on time and within scope.

Functional Responsibilities
Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, coding, testing, and deployment.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features.
Assist in continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes using Azure DevOps.

Technical Skills
Excellent English communication
Proficiency in .NET, React, and SQL Server.
Strong understanding of web development principles and best practices.
Experience with Azure DevOps for version control and CI/CD processes.
Familiarity with the SAFe Agile methodology.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Things that will separate you from the rest
Experience with Node.js
Experience with other front-end frameworks/libraries such as Vue.js Angular
Knowledge of cloud services and infrastructure, especially Azure.
Experience with RESTful API design and development.
Understanding microservices and event driven architecture.

Education or Certifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

Full-Time

Schedule
Monday to Friday

Work Location
The Six8 Building, 24-26 Phan Dinh Giot, 2 Ward, Tan Binh District, Ho Chi Minh City.

Health insurance

title: IT Governance Officer
location: Level 5 - 6, East Tower,  Lumiere Riverside, 277 Vo Nguyen Giap,  An Phu Ward, Thu Duc City, HCMC., Thu Duc City, Ho Chi Minh
duties:
The IT Governance Officer will execute and maintain IT internal controls over processes in compliance with company standards. Monitors and troubleshoots together with the Cybersecurity team in threat detection. Oversees IT operational potential risks to deploy controls in place appropriately. Plans and executes remediations for risk findings. Assists the IT service delivery team with day-to-day work.

Key Responsibilities:
Monitor and troubleshoot with the line manager and cybersecurity team or vendor on threat protection and cyberattacks.
Monitors and investigates phishing emails reported from staff, if it is required to block url/domain and/or email of the sender.
Maintains security policy up to date to make sure hardening policy is applied strictly on MacOS and Windows Devices as well as the logon policy standard.
Investigates and works with end users to resolve any security breaches, which would be escalated to cyber cybersecurity team for technical issues if required.
Monitors and collaborates with the cyber team to ensure timely remediation of vulnerabilities and misconfigurations.
Monitors and troubleshoots all failed/missed updates from weekly patching reports.
Assists the line manager in deploying all security features where required.
Reports monthly on device compliance status.
Maintains user matrix with roles and system access, together with engineering head advice that requires review and update yearly.
Processes quarterly access review and update with line managers and system owners.
Works together with the cybersecurity team to conduct an IT internal Pentest with the vendor, then schedules with the line manager to remediate any findings with high or medium potential risks.
Monitors and reports on the protection of data lost through outbound email rules as well as hard disk encryption for compliance
Maintain and improve System Access management processes on the core system, such as MS Entra ID.
Work closely with Cyber Security and IT Operations teams to ensure governance alignment.

Your skills and experience
Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
Minimum three years of experience working in related areas, including software installation, policy deployment, patch updates, and troubleshooting in Windows & MacOS environments.
Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, and Microsoft 365 portal.

Preferred Qualifications:
IT certifications (e.g., Network+, ITIL or Microsoft certifications).
Knowledge of cybersecurity principles and practices.
Experience with scanning and endpoint tools (e.g., Endpoint Central, Cisco Secure Endpoint, Tenable.io/Nessus)
Experience with internal and external IT audit

Why you'll love working here
You’ll love working with us if you are:
Passionate about technology.
Independent but also a good team player.
Comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity.
Focused on usability and speed.
Keen on presenting your ideas to your peers and management.
At TYME, opportunities are here for the taking. If you want to be part of our purpose and live and lead through our values, we can offer exciting development opportunities through expanded lateral roles, stretch assignments, or people leadership.

Some of our benefits:
Meal and parking allowances are covered by the company.
Full benefits and salary rank during probation.
Insurances such as Vietnamese labor law and premium health care for you and your family.
SMART goals and clear career opportunities (technical seminar, conference, and career talk) - we focus on your development.
Values-driven, international working environment, and agile culture.
Overseas travel opportunities for training and work-related.
Internal Hackathons and company events (team building, coffee run, etc.).
Pro-Rate and performance bonus.
15-day annual + 3-day sick leave per year from the company.
Work-life balance 40-hr per week from Mon to Fri.

title: DevOps Engineer (Linux, Docker, CI/CD)
skills: CI/CD; AWS; Azure; Docker; Kubernetes; JavaScript; Linux
duties:
Job description
- Thiết lập, quản lý và tối ưu hệ thống CI/CD cho các ứng dụng phát triển trên nền tảng NodeJS.
- Triển khai, giám sát và bảo trì hệ thống trên các nền tảng Cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
- Xây dựng, triển khai và quản lý hệ thống container hóa sử dụng Docker và Kubernetes.
- Theo dõi, phát hiện và xử lý kịp thời các sự cố hệ thống, đảm bảo hiệu suất hoạt động và an ninh bảo mật.
- Phối hợp chặt chẽ với các team Frontend, Backend và Product để tối ưu hiệu năng và hỗ trợ triển khai các tính năng mới.

Your skills and experience
- Có ít nhất 5 năm kinh nghiệm ở vị trí DevOps hoặc tương đương.
- Thành thạo NodeJS, hiểu sâu về JavaScript, npm/yarn.
- Kinh nghiệm làm việc thực tế với Docker, Kubernetes, và các công cụ CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
- Có kinh nghiệm quản trị hệ thống Linux, thành thạo Bash script.
- Có kinh nghiệm triển khai và quản lý các dịch vụ cloud như AWS (EC2, S3, RDS), Azure hoặc Google Cloud.
- Sử dụng thành thạo các công cụ monitoring và logging như Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack.
- Chủ động, trách nhiệm cao trong công việc, khả năng phân tích và xử lý vấn đề nhanh chóng, hiệu quả.
- Giao tiếp và làm việc nhóm tốt.

Why you'll love working here
- Mức lương cạnh tranh từ 20 – 30 triệu/tháng (thỏa thuận theo năng lực).
- Môi trường và thời gian làm việc linh hoạt.
- Chế độ phúc lợi hấp dẫn: du lịch hàng năm, team-building, bảo hiểm sức khỏe cao cấp, nghỉ phép năm.
- THỜI GIAN LÀM VIỆC: Thứ 2 – Thứ 6 (9h00 – 18h00), nghỉ Thứ 7 & Chủ Nhật.

duties:
Are you looking for a position that challenges you to grow, explore new areas and contribute in multiple ways within a fast-paced workplace? Would you like the opportunity to work with a great variety of people in Vietnam and Switzerland? Join us in one of our Vietnamese location in Ho Chi Minh City and become a member of our cross-border team with colleagues in Zurich (Switzerland).

About our company:
mesoneer is one of the leading Swiss software companies in the fields of digital onboarding, process automation and the integration of complex peripheral systems. Our approximately 120 employees in Switzerland and Vietnam digitize and simplify business processes with individual software solutions, modernize outdated applications and develop in-house SaaS solutions. We need you for our customers in the finance and insurance sector, public administration and other industries!

Company size: 120 employees
Website: https://www.mesoneer.io/en/
Fanpage: https://www.facebook.com/mesoneer
Linkedin: https://www.linkedin.com/company/mesoneer/about/

Why you’ll love working here:
- 13th-month salary bonus.
- Flexible working time policy.
- 12 Annual leaves, plus 5 core leave days each year.
- 5 Sick leaves and 3 Bereavement leaves for relatives each year.
- Annual Health check, PVI healthcare for employees and two family members.
- Full-salary-based social insurance.
- Annual salary review and based on performance and contribution.
- A laptop, lunch, and parking fees are provided.
- Kid allowance.
- Activities: Company party, Family Day, Company trip, Happy hour, Happy birthday, Team building, …
- Office located in the center with great accommodations (ergonomic chair, free drinks, snacks, game room, ...).

Your skills:
- 3+ years of experience in designing, developing, and maintaining projects using Java technologies.
- Have deep understanding about Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data,..) and other well-known Java libraries.
- Experienced in designing and building API for modern web applications using OpenAPI, OAuth2, JWT.
- Experienced in working with relational database systems, e.g., Oracle, PostgreSQL.
- Experienced in building front-end with modern web frameworks, especially Angular.
- Be able to work with and/or set up continuous integration/delivery using tools like Jenkins, GitHub Action.
- Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, OpenShift).
- Understand agile methodology and experienced in Scrum framework.
- High willingness to familiarize yourself with new challenges.
- Fluent in reading and writing English and able to communicate.

- Collaborate with other teammates and Product Owners to deliver good project results, and ensure quality, costs, and deadlines are met.
- Work closely with other team members to ensure projects have good quality and a stable development environment.
- Participate in the entire software development life cycle, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and support.
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
- Self-manage your time and work.
- Other tasks assigned by Leader.

title: Fulltime IOS
duties:
Mô tả công việc:
- Phát triển và duy trì các ứng dụng iOS chất lượng cao trên nền tảng Swift/Objective-C.
- Tham gia vào toàn bộ vòng đời phát triển ứng dụng: từ phân tích yêu cầu, thiết kế, coding, testing đến triển khai và bảo trì.
- Phối hợp chặt chẽ với team UI/UX, backend và các bộ phận liên quan để đảm bảo tính ổn định và trải nghiệm người dùng tối ưu.
- Tối ưu hiệu suất và khả năng mở rộng của ứng dụng.
- Sửa lỗi và cải tiến sản phẩm hiện tại theo phản hồi của người dùng và yêu cầu kinh doanh.
- Cập nhật công nghệ mới và đề xuất áp dụng vào dự án.

Yêu cầu ứng viên:
- Ưu tiên có kinh nghiệm phát triển ứng dụng iOS.
- Thành thạo Swift, có hiểu biết về Objective-C là lợi thế.
- Có kinh nghiệm làm việc với UIKit, CoreData, CoreAnimation, RESTful APIs, JSON, Push Notification...
- Hiểu rõ về mô hình MVC/MVVM, quản lý bộ nhớ, vòng đời ứng dụng iOS.
- Biết sử dụng Git và làm việc trong môi trường CI/CD.
- Có kinh nghiệm sử dụng CocoaPods, Swift Package Manager.
- Tư duy logic tốt, chủ động trong công việc, có trách nhiệm và tinh thần học hỏi.

Quyền lợi:
- Mức lương cạnh tranh, thưởng theo kết quả công việc.
- Môi trường làm việc chuyên nghiệp, thân thiện và sáng tạo.
- Cơ hội học hỏi và phát triển trong các dự án quốc tế.
- Bảo hiểm y tế, bảo hiểm xã hội và các phúc lợi khác theo quy định của công ty.
- Cơ hội tham gia các khóa đào tạo, nâng cao kỹ năng chuyên môn.

Địa điểm làm việc:
- Hồ Chí Minh: 25/1 Cửu Long Phường 2, Tân Bình

Thời gian làm việc:
- Thứ 2 - Thứ 6 (từ 08:00 đến 17:00)

Cách thức ứng tuyển:
- Ứng viên nộp hồ sơ trực tuyến bằng cách bấm Ứng tuyển ngay dưới đây.

duties:
Company Description

Carousell Group is the leading multi-category platform for secondhand in Greater Southeast Asia on a mission to make secondhand the first choice. Founded in August 2012 in Singapore, the Group has a leading presence in seven markets under the brands Carousell, Carousell Media Group, Cho Tot, Laku6, LuxLexicon, Mudah.my, OneShift, REFASH and Revo Financial, serving tens of millions of monthly active users. Carousell is backed by leading investors including Telenor Group, Rakuten Ventures, Naver, STIC Investments, 500 Global and Peak XV Partners (formerly known as Sequoia Capital India).

As a team of passionate individuals working together to solve meaningful problems, there is so much more for you to discover in a career with Carousell. Our culture is made up of hiring, developing, and promoting people who embody our values of HEART, which is an acronym for Humility, Empathy, Accountability, Relentlessly resourceful and Teamwork. Together as an organisation, we make magic happen.

About Cho Tot

Established in 2012, Chotot.com is the first re-commerce platform in Vietnam pioneering classified 4.0 with more than 1 billion page views every month. On average, 9 out of 10 Vietnamese people are aware of Cho Tot when asking about selling and buying in any category. With the motto “Muốn Là Có” (“A Way to Your Wants”), we leverage technology to build a simple, efficient, and reliable platform that meets all the wants and needs in all stages of your life. There are more than 60 categories on Chotot.com, meaning whether you are looking for a house, a car, a job, a pet, or a piece of vegetable, you can find them on our site. Whether you are passing things you once loved or giving them to people in need, we are here to assist.

At Cho Tot, you will be part of our young and dynamic team in a fast-moving and fun-loving environment. You will receive opportunities to reach all the potentials you can think of in your career ladder. Cho Tot provides a competitive salary and full benefits. More importantly, we are a family within the company to support each other to learn, grow and immerse in new experiences every day. Every member of our family will be there with you on your path of passion to deliver the best online classified site to serve Vietnamese people. Being part of a bigger global organization, at Cho Tot you will also be given opportunities to collaborate with global distributed teams across the world to tackle and provide solutions for some of the most challenging problems in the emerging internet business space. Since 2019, Cho Tot is part of Carousell.

Job Description

Cho Tot team is expanding to continuously innovate our marketplace ecosystem to better serve Vietnamese via advanced technology. We are looking for talented and passionate individuals to join our foundation software, engineering team. You will be one of the few key talents who build and run services that are used by tens of millions of Vietnamese people. You will need to tackle highly scaled distributed systems, work in a highly automated devops environment on top of many open source, CNCF software. You will be supported by our solid SRE team to really craft the software and run the product that you are proud of and other engineers admire.

What you will do:

- Solve engineering problems to enable a smart Marketplace ecosystem of products and services.
- Design, Build, Run and improve backend services and framework of creating microservices.
- Manage individual project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables.
- Improve engineer efficiency with common libraries, tooling, and platform.

What’s in it for you?

- Join plenty of Sharing and Learning activities as part of our initiatives to contribute to the tech community in Vietnam
- Get 15 days of annual leave and 5 days of sick leave per year
- Health insurance for employee and their family members
- Get 13th month salary and annual performance bonus
- Participate in regular team building activities and company parties
- Get opportunities to attend training courses abroad

Qualifications

What you will need:

- Experience working with one or more from the following: web application development, Unix/Linux environments, distributed systems, machine learning, networking, developing large software systems.
- At least 3 years of experience in Golang or confident that you can pick it up in no time.
- Solid production experience with one or more general-purpose programming languages including but not limited to C/C++, Python, Java, Javascript ES6.
- Experience with two or more data systems but not limited to Postgres, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Redis, Kafka, Cassandra.
- Experience with Docker, Kubernetes.
- Familiar with Microservices, event-driven architecture.
- BA or MA degree in engineering, computer science, or another technical related field. Or formerly competitive programmer.

Additional Information

Thank you for taking your time to read our job description and thank you in advance if you decide to apply for this position. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within 2 weeks since application, otherwise we might meet when another chance arises.

By proceeding with your application, you are adhering to our PDPA policies. In case you are interested to know more, read about our Candidates Personal Data Privacy Statement.

duties:
We are building an environment where personal development is a focus. We want all members to grow with the company through hands-on projects and industry best practices. Our clients have extremely high expectations and that sets a bar for our quality of work.

We’re looking for a QC Engineer (Tester) for our organization. For this role, we need people who are eager to take ownership and love learning new things.

We are growing at a brisk pace and we want you to be part of our success.

What you'll be doing:
- Evaluate and clarify product requirements. Participate in reviewing product design and work with the development team to incorporate test ability requirements.
- Design test plans, test cases, and test procedures to ensure accuracy, stability, and security of the product.
- Work with developers to analyze and find the root cause of bugs.
- Web and mobile application validation.
- Quality-driven and proactive to do what is necessary to achieve deadlines in a dynamic environment with frequent priority and changes.
- Support on building and maintaining frameworks to help performance tests, automate tests and expand test coverage in an Agile development environment (plus).

Your skills and experience:
What You Are Good at
- Strong in functional/non-functional testing:
- Test technique: Equivalence partitioning, Boundary value, Decision table, generate test cases from use cases.
- Have adhoc-testing skills
- Experience in Performance and Security testing is a plus
- Experience in web, mobile testing and api testing.
- Experience in technical problem solving; root cause analysis; and data gathering, analysis, and reporting within a system/software quality assurance discipline.
- Process strong analytical skills, with excellent problem-solving abilities
- Learn new techniques and technologies quickly.

Having any of the below experience/knowledge is a plus:
- Familiarity with automated testing tools and frameworks for client-server applications.
- Experience in writing code to test UIs, APIs, and frontend systems.
- Experience in API testing, performance testing, security testing, usability testing.

Why you'll love working here:
- Above industry standard salaries.
- Friendly working environment and flexible working hours.
- 13th salary, insurance and team building activities.
- We work hand-in-hand with our clients to fully invest in their product development and build solutions together for their target market.
- We fully invest in our team, we will help you build yourself up in any area you feel you need development, be it in English, learning a new design tool, developing your design thinking and more. We want to make sure that you’re always learning and developing yourself whilst a part of our team.
- We respect both Product and Technology equally, ensuring all of the Products we work on have features with true market potential and ensuring all of the team contribute to, understand and believe in what they are developing.
- We respect you and your personal hours, we keep sustainable pace by working standard 8 hour days from Monday to Friday, ensuring we only plan for what we can achieve.
- We are fully agile, working with set sprint goals and working at our rate of velocity.
- You will have ownership over your role, giving you the opportunity to experiment and try new processes to better improve your day-to-day responsibilities. We are always open to improving our processes.

location: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
duties:
Primrose Capital Management is a quantitative digital asset management company with an expertise in trading emerging and frontier markets. Our heritage and experience stems from being a first mover in digital asset derivatives and decades spent at some of the world's most renowned quantitative hedge funds. Opportunities in this space are often complex and multifaceted. We believe that the diversity of our people, along with data and technology as the linchpin of all we do, are key to navigating this sphere. Responsibilities:
Lead the design, architecture, and development of enterprise-level systems
Develop tools, reports, and data feeds to meet the business needs of the trading, operations, and risk teams
Ensure software quality, performance, cost-efficiency, and operational resilience
Actively contribute to cross-company technology initiatives to support business and operational objectives
Collaborate with business leaders and front-office trading teams to effectively implement and maintain systems
Work closely with the local technology team in Vietnam to deliver high-quality technology solutions that support Primrose's business functions
Ensure thorough and up-to-date documentation for all systems and processes
Provide mentorship and share expertise with junior team members

Requirements:
6+ years of experience as a software engineer, with a strong focus on backend development
Bachelor's or postgrad degree from a renowned University in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Experienced in working with a variety of technologies in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
Proven experience in software design and architecture, with work on cloud infrastructure, like AWS or other cloud platforms
In-depth knowledge of Java; experience with Spring Boot is a plus
Solid experience with messaging queue systems, such as Kafka
Good knowledge of database design and management; experience with PostgreSQL is a plus
Experience in writing and implementing unit, integration, and functional tests
Well-versed in DevOps practices; ability to set up CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and automated deployment
Good English communication skills
AWS certification is a plus

Benefits:
The Environment We Offer
As a growing firm with a tightly-knit team, we respect and listen to all our employees. You will get the chance to make an impact by having your voice heard by everyone, including the management.
Our employees enjoy a high level of autonomy at work. We focus on substance, not form - as long as you can perform, you will be recognized and rewarded. We are also dedicated to supporting our staff and ensuring they develop holistically to maximize their potential in the long-term.
We also provide flexible working arrangement as required and a casual and fun environment to boot!

Ensure software quality, performance, cost-efficiency, and operational resilience
Actively contribute to cross-company technology initiatives to support business and operational objectives

skills: AWS; Azure; GCP; MySQL; Kafka; React; Python; Node.JS
duties:
Top 3 reasons to join us
• Global product & excellent team
• Focus on quality & personal growth
• 3 remote days per week

Job description
What You’ll Be Doing
• Act as the Security Champion for the organization, promote awareness, alignment, and adoption of secure development practices across engineering teams.
• Lead security design reviews and advise engineering teams on best practices for building secure, privacy-conscious solutions.
• Conduct internal security audits, lead awareness initiatives, and deliver training to ensure compliance with company security policies.
• Manage Mobile Device Management (MDM) and various SaaS platforms to maintain secure and compliant environments.
• Enforce a Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) within development teams.
• Support ISO 27001 readiness and ongoing compliance efforts by collaborating with leadership and cross-functional teams to implement required controls.
• Provide ad-hoc security guidance for client projects when needed, focusing on frameworks, reviews, and process alignment rather than daily delivery.
Your skills and experience
Must Have
• Minimum of 3 years of experience in a Security Engineer role.
• Strong understanding of security and compliance principles across both development and cloud environments.
• Familiarity with secure development standards and frameworks, including:
• OWASP Top 10 and common threat modeling methodologies
• ISO 27001:2022 security controls
• Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) principles
• Experience in supporting internal compliance efforts, conducting internal audits, and aligning teams with policy requirements.
• Knowledge of industry standards and regulations such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, CSA (Cloud Security Alliance), HIPAA, and PCI-DSS.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Nice to Have
• Experience ensuring compliance with data privacy laws such as CCPA, HIPAA, and GDPR.
• Knowledge of client-facing security requirements and defining security compliance processes per project.
• Hands-on experience with vulnerability scanning tools (e.g., Nessus, OpenVAS) and strong skills in analyzing scanning reports.
• Understanding of cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, and GCP)
• Familiar with working with API designing standards and databases such as: GraphQL, RestAPI, Postgres, MySQL, Kafka,..
• Understanding and working knowledge of Cloud-native application security concepts.
Why you'll love working here
Who We Are
CodeLink is an innovative and design-focused development agency. We focus on user-centric design and agile development to bring the product vision of our clients to life. We handle the end-to-end development of products, developing the product vision through product understanding, designing experiences through UX design, refining these flows with modern UI design, and developing products through iterative agile development.
We work with both early-stage product teams and teams with existing products from a wide range of countries and industries. We focus on modern technologies and work directly with our clients. We design using design-thinking principles on tools such as Sketch, Figma, Zeplin, and more, and develop products leveraging our tech stack of React, React Native, Rails, Python, and Node.JS.
Our Core Values
1. Take full ownership of delivery
We take ownership of our client projects and ensure that we deliver what we are in charge of to the best possible outcome.
2. Deliver our highest level of quality
We take pride in the high quality that we deliver and work at a sustainable pace to ensure we can always deliver on that quality.
3. Stay consistent in plans and processes
We keep open and transparent communication with our teammates and our client whilst following agile development practices.
4. Have empathy for all those we work with
We show empathy and respect to all those we work with to gain a deeper understanding without any judgment or assumption.
5. Continuously improve and grow
We aim high with a growth mindset and see every day as an opportunity to develop ourselves, our processes, and our products.
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us
• Use cutting-edge & proven technologies
• Work directly with international clients
• Open environment with a focus on learning
Why You’ll Love Working With Us
We work hand-in-hand with our clients to fully invest in their product development and build solutions together for their target market.
• We fully invest in our team, we will help you build yourself up in any area you feel you need development, be it in English, learning a new design tool, developing your design thinking, and more. We want to make sure that you’re always learning and developing yourself whilst a part of our team.
• We respect both Product and Technology equally, ensuring all of the Products we work on have features with true market potential and ensuring all of the team contribute to, understand, and believe in what they are developing.
• We are very selective with our clients, we only work on awesome products we believe in and that show strong market potential.
• We respect you and your personal hours, we keep a sustainable pace by working standard 8 hour days from Monday to Friday, ensuring we only plan for what we can achieve.
• We are fully agile and only work with Clients who work the same, working with set sprint goals and working at our rate of velocity.
• You will have ownership over your role, giving you the opportunity to experiment and try new processes to better improve your day-to-day responsibilities. We are always open to improving our processes.
Company Benefits
• An open and dynamic working environment with no dress code and the freedom to be yourself.
• Modern open-space office with comfortable workspace, a PS4 games room, and chill-out areas.
• Salary review twice a year with opportunities for promotions and spot awards.
• Yearly Training Budget up to 5 million VND per staff.
• Culture of recognition with monthly rewards for those with the most kudos.
• All office benefits and full salary during probation.
• Flexible starting time up to 10 AM working Monday - Friday with no overtime and a long lunch break.
• Two days remote every week taken on any days you choose so you can work from wherever you like.
• Full Vietnamese holidays off with 12 annual leave days per year with all days not taken paid out in cash.
• Yearly company trip, monthly team all-hands activities, welcome lunches for new members, the monthly budget for team celebrations.
• Celebrations for special days in the year, such as Women’s Day, YEP, Christmas.
• Gold level Health Insurance coverage from Bao Viet Insurance and a yearly complete Health Check.
• Employee-led clubs within the company; games teams, sports teams, etc.
• Buddy system, tech, and product talks, mentoring, and paid-for training for any skills you’d like to develop.
• Weekly agile sessions and professional coaching.
• Meal allowance, parking allowance, petrol allowance, and unlimited snacks and coffee every day.
• Options for a full MAC or PC set-up are completely provided.
Where We Work
HCMC Head Office: Level 8, Vina Building, 131 Xo Viet Nghe Tinh, Ward 17, Binh Thanh District, HCMC
Hanoi Office: Ba Dinh District, Ha Noi City
Da Nang Office: Hai Chau District, Da Nang City.

- Develop & Test
- Demo & Launch
- Maintain & Update new features

- Strong knowledge and experience in using any programming language (PHP/Javascript is an advantage)
- Knowledge or experience in using Restful API, MySQL, HTML5, CSS3, Javascript, jQuery, AJAX, JSON

- Desire to participate in building the product "B2B SaaS - Make in Vietnam"

- Flexible evaluation of salary increase (1-2 times/year) commensurate with work results

- Team building, vacation in a year, and other engagement activities

title: Middle/Senior Fullstack (Java, Python & Frontend) Developer
skills: Java; Python; Angular; MySQL; PostgreSQL; MongoDB; Docker; Git; CI/CD; Kubernetes
duties:
Mô tả công việc:
- Phát triển và duy trì các ứng dụng web với kiến trúc fullstack, sử dụng Java hoặc Python cho backend và các framework hiện đại cho frontend.
- Thiết kế và xây dựng các RESTful API để giao tiếp giữa các dịch vụ.
- Xây dựng giao diện người dùng động và phản hồi tốt bằng các framework như ReactJS, Angular hoặc VueJS.
- Quản lý cơ sở dữ liệu quan hệ và/hoặc NoSQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis).
- Đóng gói ứng dụng bằng Docker để đảm bảo môi trường phát triển và triển khai nhất quán.
- Thiết lập và giám sát tình trạng hệ thống bằng các công cụ logging và alerting hiện đại.
- Làm việc trong môi trường Agile/Scrum với các công cụ quản lý dự án như JIRA.
- Phối hợp chặt chẽ với các team khác (BA, QA, DevOps, khách hàng...) để đảm bảo chất lượng và tiến độ sản phẩm.

Yêu cầu ứng viên:
- Tốt nghiệp Đại học, cao đẳng chuyên nghành Công nghệ thông tin, hoặc các chuyên ngành liên quan.
- Có từ 3–6 năm kinh nghiệm phát triển phần mềm, trong đó ít nhất 2 năm kinh nghiệm với Java hoặc Python.
- Thành thạo một trong các kết hợp công nghệ sau:
+ Java (Spring Boot, v.v) + Frontend (ReactJS / Angular / Vue)
+ Java + Python (Flask / FastAPI / Django)
+ Python + Frontend (ReactJS / Angular / Vue)
- Hiểu rõ về RESTful API, kiến trúc microservices, authentication/authorization.
- Có kinh nghiệm làm việc với cơ sở dữ liệu quan hệ (MySQL, PostgreSQL) và/hoặc NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis).
- Có kỹ năng viết unit test, sử dụng Git, CI/CD.
- Kỹ năng giao tiếp và làm việc nhóm tốt.

Ưu tiên:
- Có kinh nghiệm làm việc trong các dự án outsource hoặc khách hàng Hàn Quốc.
- Có kinh nghiệm với DevOps (Docker, Kubernetes) là một lợi thế.
- Kỹ năng làm việc nhóm tốt, chủ động và tinh thần trách nhiệm cao.
- Ưu tiên ứng viên có khả năng giao tiếp tiếng Anh cơ bản trở lên.

Quyền lợi:
- Mức lương: Thỏa thuận theo năng lực khi phỏng vấn.
- Chế độ phúc lợi:
+ Lương tháng 13+ và xét tăng lương 2 lần/năm.
+ Thưởng theo dự án, thưởng lễ/tết, thưởng giới thiệu nhân sự, thưởng hiệu quả công việc...
+ Phụ cấp thâm niên từ 2 năm làm việc.
+ Tham gia các hoạt động đào tạo nội bộ và bên ngoài, phát triển lộ trình nghề nghiệp rõ ràng.
+ Nghỉ thứ 7, Chủ nhật và 12 ngày phép/năm.
+ Tham gia các câu lạc bộ thể thao – văn hóa – nghệ thuật do công ty tài trợ (bóng đá, cầu lông, bơi lội, âm nhạc, game, tiếng Anh...).
+ Chăm sóc sức khỏe: Khám sức khỏe định kỳ, bảo hiểm sức khỏe chất lượng cao Rikkei Care.
+ Văn hoá thoải mái: Âm nhạc hàng ngày, trái cây tươi, team building thường xuyên, du lịch trong và ngoài nước.

Địa điểm làm việc:
- Hà Nội: Tòa Vinacomin Dương Đình Nghệ, Cầu Giấy.

Thời gian làm việc:
- Đăng ký linh hoạt 8:00 - 9:00 đến 17:00 - 18:00 từ Thứ 2 - Thứ 6.

Cách thức ứng tuyển:
- Ứng viên nộp hồ sơ trực tuyến bằng cách bấm Ứng tuyển ngay dưới đây.

title: Senior Front-end Developer (ReactJS, NextJS, English required)
skills: React; TypeScript; JavaScript; CSS; Git; AWS
duties:
Job description 1. Frontend development: analyze requirements and implement responsive and interactive web applications using React and modern frontend technologies (e.g., Redux, Webpack, TypeScript). 2. Collaboration and Agile practices: collaborate with other developers to integrate applications with other systems. Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprints, stand-ups) and contribute to project planning and execution. 3. Code quality and best practices: write clean and maintainable code following engineering best practices (unit testing, source control, continuous integration, design patterns, etc.). Conduct code reviews and provide feedback to peers. 4. Performance optimization: optimize web application performance (e.g., code splitting, lazy loading, caching). Conduct performance testing and tuning to ensure fast load times and smooth interactions. 5. Cross-functional collaboration: collaborate with developers, testers, marketing, product management, and customers to create new solutions, facilitate feedback, and achieve design decisions. 6. Effort estimation: estimate the level of effort during sprint planning, contribute to the technical roadmap and continuous improvement. 7. Leadership: assist other team members with design challenges and coding issues; and evaluate their performance.

Desired Skills and Experience 1. 4+ years’ experience in front-end development and design patterns. 2. Expert knowledge of React, Redux, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3. Experience with CSS pre-processors (Sass, Less, Stylus) and post-processors (PostCSS). 3. Hands-on skills in caching, optimizing and securing front-end applications. 4. Familiar with task runners and the build process: Webpack / Gulp. 5. Testing practices: experience with BDD and TDD. 6. Experience with large SaaS applications (preferably decoupling monoliths) and microservice architecture. 7. Familiar with source control management: Git 8. Good communication in English. 9. Problem-solving skills. 10. Communication and collaboration skills: able to work independently and in a team environment.

Nice-to-have skills: 1. Experience in back-end development (preferably with Laravel/Symfony frameworks). 2. Exposure to working with JSON. 3. OpenAPI, and Swagger. 4. Exposure to DevOps practices and AWS landscape. 5. Exposure to one or more of Solr, Redis, or Elasticsearch.

Why Ekino? 1. High-ownership working environment: You will take full responsibility and control of your missions contributing to the team’s success. 2. Continuous skill improvement with new technologies, challenging projects, on-the-job coaching, and training programs. 3. Annual performance review & bonus: recognize your efforts and identify development/ improvement needs. 4. Clear career path: define your career development with long-term vision. 5. Be secured in your mind with employee’s care: private healthcare insurance package, medical check-up, support allowance… 6. Great-place-to-work activities (company trip, sport clubs…): enhance teamwork spirit and facilitate your work-life harmony.

Thank you for your time and enthusiasm in our career opportunities. Please kindly note that shortlisted candidates will be contacted within 3 weeks of application. Alternatively, we will reach out to you when another suitable chance arises in the future.

Our company

We’re Hitachi Digital Services, a global digital solutions and transformation business. Our expertise, innovation and technology unlocks potential – we take theme park fans on magical rides, conserve natural resources, protect rainforests, and save lives. We automate, modernize, optimize, and accelerate. Our people are trusted transformers, with deep engineering expertise, focused on a sustainable future for all.

Hitachi Digital Services Vietnam is part of a 300 strong global delivery network, supporting Hitachi Digital Services around the globe. Our employees collaborate with teams in India, Portugal, and the US, servicing customers worldwide and working on a huge variety of projects. From cloud migration to digital modernization and advanced analytics, offering operational excellence, agile delivery, and plenty of energy to work on huge transformation projects for our customers.

The role

Design, build, and manage scalable and efficient ETL/ELT pipelines.

Develop and maintain data architectures (e.g., databases, data lakes, data warehouses).

Work with structured and unstructured data from multiple sources.

Optimize data delivery and ensure data quality, security, and governance.

Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and other stakeholders to understand data needs.

What you’ll bring

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Strong experience with SQL and relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL).

Proficiency in data processing frameworks and languages (e.g., Python, Spark, Scala).

Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) and services (e.g., S3, Redshift, BigQuery).

Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and tools (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, DBT).

Familiarity with data orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, Luigi).

Fluent in English communication

- Có kinh nghiệm thiết kế hệ thống backend phức tạp, API, microservices, database scaling.
- Kinh nghiệm DevOps, CI/CD, Cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) là lợi thế.
- Kỹ năng giao tiếp, quản lý team, tinh thần trách nhiệm cao.
- Ưu tiên từng làm việc với các mô hình Agile/Scrum.

- Nghỉ phép: 12 ngày/năm, nghỉ lễ theo lịch nhà nước

- Có cơ hội tiếp xúc với chuyên gia trong lĩnh vực công nghệ và kinh tế.
- Có cơ hội phát triển bản thân và thăng tiến
- Môi trường năng động, thân thiện, tự do, thoải mái
- Thường xuyên được tham gia team building, hoạt động nội bộ.
- Thời gian làm việc: Từ 8h - 17h, từ Thứ 2 - Thứ 6.

title: Technical Scrum Master (Agile)
location: Level 5 - 6, East Tower, Lumiere Riverside, 277 Vo Nguyen Giap, An Phu Ward, Thu Duc City, HCMC., Thu Duc City, Ho Chi Minh
duties:
Are you a Technical Scrum Master that can still code and test when your team requires it? Do you have experience in product development and desire to build high performing teams? If so read on.

About our Team
Our team is responsible for creating a brand of new digital financial platforms and apps that are highly reliable and scalable using modern engineering practices. You will be joining a project which talented software engineers in our Digital Bank Build team who is responsible for designing, building and maintaining the new digital banking platform and the customer channels. As part of the team, you will be responsible for implementing software features, involve in technical designs and writing tests to ensure the high quality delivery of the product. The teams operate in Scrum and DevOps model.

About the job
We are looking for an experienced and versatile Technical Scrum Master who will be responsible for building a new scrum team for the delivery of one of our new fintech products.

The Scrum Master critical responsibility is for the team and for optimal flow of work to DONE. Scrum Masters are expected to do this by setting the pace for delivery and being proactive in planning and forecasting for upcoming deliverables. To be successful in the role you should demonstrate pragmatism in your approach and be sensitive to the environment that we operate in, using your skills and knowledge to appropriately influence the delivery approach.

We are seeking a motivated individual with:
- Excellent English speaking and written skills. (Mandatory)
- Foster an open, honest and transparent relationship with key stakeholders
- Excellent presentation and facilitation, coaching and mentorship skills
- Strong stakeholder management and communications experience
- Strong ability to influence cross-functional teams and leadership
- Demonstrate assertiveness, being the voice of reason and authority
- Must be enthusiastic and bring high-energy to the delivery team
- Responsible for continuous delivery and management of technical debt
- Previous experience leading small teams while still being hands-on

Your skills and experience
- At least 2+ years recent experience as a Scrum Master.
- Accountable for the quality of agile ceremonies including daily scrums, sprint planning, showcases and retrospectives
- Ability to provide constructive and timely feedback to delivery team members and stakeholders
- Conflict resolution within/between delivery team and stakeholders
- Ability to negotiate priorities and timelines with stakeholders
- Setting the pace/cadence for delivery and motivating teams to succeed
- Ensuring the delivery team commits to their definition of done
- Visual representation and management of work in the sprint e.g. card walls and burn-up charts
- Management of the Master Story List (MSL), ensuring it is adequately maintained, stories are up to date and ready to play into a sprint

Knowledge of at least 3 of the following areas:
- Mobile: iOS or Android
- Web: HTML5, CSS3, Angular JS, Javascript
- Microsoft .Net (C#, ASP, Framework), SQL Server
- Quality Assurance, Automation Testing
- Web Security, OWASP
- Java, Oracle
- DevOps, Continuous Delivery

Why you'll love working here
At TYME opportunities are here for the taking. If you want to be part of our purpose and live and lead through our values, we can offer exciting development opportunities through expanded lateral roles, stretch assignments or people leadership.

Some of our benefits:
- Meal and parking allowance covered by company.
- Full benefits and salary rank during probation.
- Insurances as Vietnamese labor law and premium health care for you and your family.
- SMART goals and clear career opportunities (technical seminar, conference and career talk) - we focus on your development.
- Values driven, international working environment and agile culture.
- Overseas travel opportunities for training and working related.
- Internal Hackathons and company's events (team building, coffee run, blue card...)
- Pro-Rate and performance bonus.
- 15-day annual + 3-day sick leave per year from company.
- Work-life balance 40-hr per week from Mon to Fri.

In this role, you will work closely with Product Managers and Designers to build scalable systems ready for large-scale traffic, optimize both User Experience and Developer Experience, boost team productivity, and mentor junior-middle engineers. The primary focus will be on frontend development using Next.js, however, you may also contribute partially to server-side development involving Ruby on Rails. We enthusiastically welcome applications from motivated individuals passionate about creating outstanding products.

Responsibilities
- Develop and Deliver products with high responsibility, availability, scalability, security, and maintainability.
- Work with a product manager, a designer, and backend engineers to implement product features.
- Provide technical direction and validate technical solutions to ensure quality and scalability in React & Next.js development.
- Resolve any technical issues, risks, and challenges, escalating as necessary and providing solutions.
- Contribute to create a sophisticated development team, applying Agile/Scrum methodologies to deliver projects successfully.
- Support the growth of junior to mid-level engineers through hands-on teaching and coaching, thereby maximizing the team's output.

Requirements
Must-Have Skills:
- 6+ years of experience in web development with React, with at least 3+ years of experience in web development with Next.js.
- 3+ years of experience leading a team of 4+ engineers to successfully build, deliver, and operate projects while fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture using Agile methodologies.
- Strong understanding of JavaScript/HTML/CSS fundamentals.
- Comprehensive knowledge of web security best practices.
- Familiarity with RESTful APIs and backend integration.
- Experience with frontend testing frameworks (Jest, Mocha, etc…)
- Experience in designing system architecture.
- Experience in designing and maintaining UI components (Storybook, Visual Regression Test, etc…)
- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and Docker.
- Strong product mindset with a solid sense of ownership and accountability.
- Excellent verbal communication skills in English.

Nice-to-Have Skills
- Hands-on expertise in application performance monitoring and optimization.
- Experience in designing and building backend applications, especially using Ruby on Rails.
- Previous experience working in a multi-cultural environment.
- Knowledge of automation testing and end-to-end testing frameworks.

Tech Stack
- Fronted: TypeScript, Next.js
- Backend: Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Golang
- Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka
- Repositories: GitHub
- Project management: Asana, Jira
- Monitoring: Datadog, Rollbar
- CI/CD: CircleCI, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions
- Analytics: BigQuery, Google Analytics
- Communication Tools: Zoom, Slack, Figma, Miro

Caring Mental & Physical Recreation

- Foreign language & International technology-related certifications sponsoring

IT Governance:

- Develop and conduct security awareness training programs tailored to the local context

- Understand and implement control requirements and regulations from the information security department and the legal department in the headquarters.
Corporate Security:
- Oversee network, endpoint and device security
- Collaborate with teams in Japan to optimize operational efficiency while maintaining security
- Aligning with the group direction to develop and implement security-conscious productivity solutions.

- Experience in risk management and security operations
- Proven track record in implementing security programs and policies
- Understanding of information security frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST, etc.)
- Strong logical thinking, leadership, and stakeholder management skills
- Good communication skills in English.

- Self-motivated and able to work independently

- Ability to balance security requirements with business needs.

duties:
★ Mô Tả Công Việc

• Phát triển và triển khai chatbot có khả năng tìm kiếm thông tin và tạo ra nội dung từ các mô hình ngôn ngữ lớn.

• Tích hợp các mô hình AI vào ứng dụng di động (Android/iOS).
• Thiết kế và tối ưu hóa pipeline xử lý dữ liệu cho chatbot và các tính năng AI khác.
• Phân tích và cải thiện hiệu suất của hệ thống chatbot cũng như các hệ thống tích hợp mô hình AI khác.
• Cập nhật và triển khai các công nghệ mới nhất trong AI và Machine Learning vào dự án.
• Phối hợp để đảm bảo sự tương thích và hiệu suất của các mô hình AI.

★ Yêu Cầu

• Hiểu khái niệm cơ bản về các mô hình Generative AI như GANs, VAEs, và mô hình Diffusion.
• Hiểu cơ bản về các công cụ lưu trữ và quản lý dữ liệu như cơ sở dữ liệu SQL/NoSQL và lưu trữ đám mây.
• Có kiến thức về việc sử dụng các nền tảng AI cloud như AWS, Azure, Google Cloud.
• Hiểu các cấu trúc dữ liệu cơ bản như mảng, danh sách liên kết.
• Nắm các thuật toán cơ bản như sắp xếp (Bubble Sort, Insertion Sort), tìm kiếm tuần tự.
• Hiểu biết về các mô hình phát triển phần mềm cơ bản như Waterfall, Agile.
• Áp dụng các mô hình có sẵn từ các thư viện để giải quyết vấn đề cụ thể.
• Sử dụng các mô hình AI có sẵn từ thư viện và triển khai vào môi trường thử nghiệm đơn giản.
• Fine-tune các mô hình đơn giản cho các ứng dụng cụ thể (ví dụ: điều chỉnh mô hình GPT-3 cho bài toán cụ thể).
• Xác định và sửa lỗi đơn giản trong mã nguồn với sự hướng dẫn.
• Sử dụng các kỹ thuật debug cơ bản để tìm nguyên nhân vấn đề.
• Biết cách sử dụng GitHub để quản lý mã nguồn, tạo pull request, merge code và cơ bản về workflow CI/CD với Jenkins.
• Làm việc được với Docker ở cấp độ cơ bản (Ví dụ: build, push, run).
• Có khả năng tham gia thảo luận nhóm, lắng nghe và đưa ra ý kiến cơ bản.
• Đảm bảo hoàn thành công việc được giao đúng hạn với sự hướng dẫn từ người khác.

duties:
The Front-End Developer is responsible to write software applications from design specifications; Plans, executes and documents unit tests; Reports status and issues; Documents detailed designs; Accountable for unit test leakage; Contributes to system architecture and design decisions.

Develop and maintain websites and real-time front-end systems across multiple platforms: PC, Mobile, Tablet.
Optimize website performance, ensure standardization and SEO best practices, and help build the company's brand image.
Convert UI/UX design files (PSD, Figma, XD, etc.) into responsive and modern HTML/CSS interfaces.
Write clean, well-documented, and tested JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS code.
Integrate with RESTful APIs and collaborate closely with UI/UX designers, backend developers, and team members.
Ensure cross-browser and cross-device compatibility for all front-end features.
Participate in improving workflows and sharing knowledge with the team.

Yêu cầu ứng viên:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
Have at least 5 years of experience in a Front-end Developer.
Proficient in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (TypeScript is a plus).
Solid understanding of at least one modern front-end framework: ReactJS (with Redux), VueJS (with Vuex), or AngularJS (with NgRx, Akita, etc.).
Proficient in using state management tools (e.g., Redux for React, Vuex for Vue, NgRx for Angular) to handle complex application state.
Good grasp of OOP and basic Design Patterns.
Experience handling cross-browser compatibility issues.
Familiar with RESTful APIs and integrating data from backend services.
Experience with Git and modern build tools (Webpack, Babel, etc.) is a plus.
Knowledge of task management tools (Jira, Trello, Asana, etc.) is a plus.
Creative thinker with strong problem-solving skills and a proactive, responsible attitude.
Able to work independently and as part of a team.
Good reading and writing skills in English.

Quyền lợi:

The attractive salary (Negotiation).
2-month probation period with 100% salary.

title: Bridge Software Engineer (BrSE)
duties:
Role Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled Bridge Software Engineer (BrSE) to act as the key communication link between Japanese clients and local development teams. The role involves translating business requirements into technical solutions, ensuring seamless collaboration, and delivering high-quality projects on time.

Job Responsibilities

Communication Management:
- Serve as the primary liaison between Japanese clients and development teams, ensuring clear and effective communication.
- Translate client requirements into actionable tasks for development teams.
- Provide regular updates to stakeholders regarding project progress and challenges.

Project Coordination:
- Define project scope, timelines, and deliverables in collaboration with project managers.
- Monitor and manage project schedules, ensuring adherence to deadlines and quality standards.
- Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.

System Design and Development Support:
- Create, review, and manage system design documents, including both basic and detailed designs.
- Support the technical team in implementing client requirements, ensuring alignment with project goals.

Testing and Quality Assurance:
- Plan and oversee testing activities, including Unit Testing, Integration Testing, and Stress Testing.
- Ensure deliverables meet quality standards and align with client expectations.

Technical Leadership:
- Utilize tools such as Jira, Backlog, and Git for task management and version control.
- Provide hands-on support in programming languages like Java, .NET (WPF), or SQL Server as needed.
- Address and resolve technical challenges efficiently.

Domain Expertise (Preferred):
- Offer insights into Banking/Finance domains, such as Risk Management or Financial Derivatives.
- Leverage expertise in frameworks like Basel Capital Accord, LCR, NSFR, or IRRBB.

Continuous Improvement:
- Proactively identify process improvements to enhance project efficiency and quality.
- Stay updated with industry trends and emerging technologies to drive innovation.

Job Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
- Japanese language skills equivalent to N1 level are mandatory.
- Minimum 5 years of experience as a Bridge Software Engineer (BrSE) or in a related role.
- Technical Skills:
- Strong understanding of system design and documentation.
- Hands-on experience in at least one programming language (e.g., Java, .NET, or SQL Server).
- Proficiency in tools like Jira, Backlog, and Git for project and task management.
- Project Management Skills:
- Familiarity with Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
- Experience in testing processes, including Unit Testing, Integration Testing, and Stress Testing.
- Preferred Skills (Optional):
- Background in Banking/Financial domains, including Credit Risk Management, Market Risk Management, or Liquidity Risk Management.
- Knowledge of specialized financial frameworks, such as Basel Accord, IRRBB, LCR, or NSFR.

DXC Technology (NYSE: DXC) is the world’s leading independent, end-to-end IT services company, helping clients harness the power of innovation to thrive on change. Created by the merger of CSC and the Enterprise Services business of Hewlett Packard Enterprise, DXC Technology serves nearly 6,000 private and public sector clients across 70 countries. The company’s technology independence, global talent and extensive partner alliance combine to deliver powerful next-generation IT services and solutions. DXC Technology is recognized among the best corporate citizens globally. For more information, visit www.dxc.technology.

Chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm ứng viên nhiệt huyết và đam mê công việc để gia nhập đội ngũ nhân viên trẻ tuổi và tài năng của công ty FSEL với yêu cầu như sau:
Tham gia phát triển các sản phẩm phục vụ cho hàng trăm nghìn khách hàng về các dịch vụ học trực tuyến E-learning.

Tham gia tất cả các giai đoạn phát triển phần mềm được yêu cầu từ lập kế hoạch, ước tính, thiết kế và phát triển việc thực hiện.
Tham gia vào các quy trình Agile như Scrum hoặc Kanban.

Tốt nghiệp Đại học chuyên ngành Công nghệ Thông tin, Kỹ thuật phần mềm hoặc các ngành liên quan.
Có từ 4 năm kinh nghiệm lập trình thực tế với .NET, đặc biệt là .NET Core hoặc ASP.NET MVC/Web API.
Thành thạo C#, .NET Framework, .NET Core, ASP.NET (Core), MVC, Web API, Entity Framework (Core) và SQL Server.
Có kinh nghiệm thiết kế phần mềm và xây dựng kiến trúc hệ thống.
Làm việc tốt với các hệ quản trị cơ sở dữ liệu SQL/NoSQL như: MS SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB.
Ưu tiên ứng viên quen thuộc với các công nghệ front-end như React, Angular hoặc VueJS.
Hiểu biết vững về lập trình hướng đối tượng (OOP), các mẫu thiết kế (design patterns), nguyên lý SOLID, và kiến trúc phần mềm sạch (clean architecture).
Có kinh nghiệm làm việc với nền tảng cloud như Azure hoặc AWS.
Hiểu và áp dụng được quy trình CI/CD, DevOps, và công nghệ container như Docker, Kubernetes.
Có kinh nghiệm làm việc trong môi trường phát triển phần mềm theo mô hình Agile/Scrum.
Kỹ năng giải quyết vấn đề và giao tiếp tốt.

Quyền lợi:
Mức lương (gross): up to 40 triệu/tháng.
Thưởng sinh nhật, thưởng các dịp Lễ, Tết trong năm.
Chế độ BHXH, BHYT, BHTN đầy đủ ngay sau khi ký HĐ chính thức.
Khám sức khoẻ định kỳ hàng năm.
Trang bị máy tính hiện đại phục vụ công việc.
Quỹ Team Building lên tới 2.400.000 VNĐ/người/năm.
Du lịch nghỉ dưỡng hàng năm.
Trà chiều với bánh, hoa quả và đồ ăn vặt miễn phí hàng tuần.
Cơ hội tiếp cận với các doanh nghiệp, dự án lớn, xu hướng công nghệ và nền tảng mới nhất.
Được tham gia các lớp đào tạo, khóa học chuyên môn để phát triển kỹ năng.
Làm việc trong môi trường chuyên nghiệp, năng động, trẻ trung & trải nghiệm các hoạt động văn hóa doanh nghiệp đặc sắc.
